> 165	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 166	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 167	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 168	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 169	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 170	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 171	        }
> 172	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 173	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 174	    }
> 175	
> 176	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {
> 177	        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(
> 178	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));
> 179	    }
> 180	
> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }
> 205	
> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }
> 225	
> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }
> 235

> 237	        return hasText(chunk.parentId()) ? chunk.parentId() : chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder();
> 238	    }
> 239	
> 240	    private String codeKey(CodeChunk chunk) {
> 241	        return hasText(chunk.id()) ? chunk.id()
> 242	                : chunk.filePath() + ':' + chunk.symbolName() + ':' + chunk.startLine();
> 243	    }
> 244	
> 245	    private void collect(RagOutcome<?> outcome, List<RagWarning> warnings,
> 246	                         List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 247	        warnings.addAll(outcome.warnings());
> 248	        diagnostics.addAll(outcome.stageDiagnostics());
> 249	    }
> 250	
> 251	    private void recordOutcome(RagOutcome<?> outcome, String documentId, String version) {
> 252	        for (RagStageDiagnostic diagnostic : outcome.stageDiagnostics()) {
> 253	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 254	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 255	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 256	        }
> 257	    }
> 258	
> 259	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 260	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 261	    }
> 262	
> 263	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 264	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 265	    }
> 266	}

> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {

> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);

> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);

> 43	    }

> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141

> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }
> 148	}

> 23	    /** 注入 REST 客户端与 BGE 服务配置。 */
> 24	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties) {
> 25	        this.client = client;
> 26	        this.properties = properties;
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */
> 53	    private record Scored(ChunkRecord chunk, double score) {
> 54	    }
> 55	}

> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {

> 18	/** Repository and Git scanner supporting every enabled language adapter. */
> 19	@Component
> 20	@Primary
> 21	public class MultiLanguageCodeScanner implements CodeScanner {
> 22	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MultiLanguageCodeScanner.class);
> 23	    private final CodeLanguageRegistry registry;
> 24	
> 25	    public MultiLanguageCodeScanner(CodeLanguageRegistry registry) {
> 26	        this.registry = registry;
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    @Override
> 30	    public ScanResult scan(RagProperties.Code config) throws IOException {
> 31	        Path root = Path.of(config.repositoryPath()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
> 32	        String commit = git(root, List.of("rev-parse", "HEAD"), false);
> 33	        List<Path> files;
> 34	        try (var stream = Files.walk(root)) {
> 35	            files = stream.filter(Files::isRegularFile)
> 36	                    .filter(path -> supports(path.toString()))
> 37	                    .filter(path -> include(root, path, config))
> 38	                    .sorted(Comparator.comparing(path -> normalize(root.relativize(path).toString())))
> 39	                    .toList();
> 40	        }
> 41	        Aggregate aggregate = new Aggregate(registry.capabilityDiagnostics());
> 42	        for (Path file : files) {
> 43	            String relative = normalize(root.relativize(file).toString());
> 44	            parse(config, commit, relative, Files.readString(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8), aggregate);
> 45	        }
> 46	        return aggregate.result(config.projectId(), commit.isBlank() ? "unknown" : commit, files.size());
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    @Override
> 50	    public ScanResult scanFiles(RagProperties.Code config, String commitSha, List<String> paths) throws IOException {
> 51	        Path root = Path.of(config.repositoryPath()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
> 52	        Aggregate aggregate = new Aggregate(registry.capabilityDiagnostics());
> 53	        int scanned = 0;
> 54	        for (String path : paths) {
> 55	            String relative = normalize(path);
> 56	            if (!supports(relative)) continue;
> 57	            Path resolved = root.resolve(relative).normalize();
> 58	            if (!resolved.startsWith(root) || !include(root, resolved, config)) continue;
> 59	            String text = git(root, List.of("show", commitSha + ":" + relative), true);
> 60	            if (text == null) continue;
> 61	            scanned++;
> 62	            parse(config, commitSha, relative, text, aggregate);
> 63	        }
> 64	        return aggregate.result(config.projectId(), commitSha, scanned);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    @Override
> 68	    public boolean supports(String path) {
> 69	        return registry.supports(path);
> 70	    }
> 71	
> 72	    private void parse(RagProperties.Code config, String commit, String path, String text, Aggregate aggregate) {
> 73	        if (text == null || text.indexOf('\0') >= 0
> 74	                || text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > config.resolvedMaxFileBytes()) {
> 75	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 76	                    "FILE_SKIPPED", "Binary or oversized source file"));
> 77	            return;
> 78	        }
> 79	        try {
> 80	            ParsedCodeFile parsed = registry.adapter(path).orElseThrow().parse(
> 81	                    config.projectId(), commit, path, text);
> 82	            aggregate.chunks.addAll(parsed.chunks());
> 83	            aggregate.symbols.addAll(parsed.symbols());
> 84	            aggregate.calls.addAll(parsed.calls());
> 85	            aggregate.diagnostics.addAll(parsed.diagnostics());
> 86	        }
> 87	        catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError exception) {
> 88	            log.warn("Code parsing failed for {}: {}", path, exception.getMessage(), exception);
> 89	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 90	                    "PARSE_FAILED", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 91	        }
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private String git(Path root, List<String> arguments, boolean missingAllowed) throws IOException {
> 95	        List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
> 96	        command.add("git");
> 97	        command.addAll(arguments);
> 98	        Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(root.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(false).start();
> 99	        byte[] output = process.getInputStream().readAllBytes();
> 100	        byte[] error = process.getErrorStream().readAllBytes();
> 101	        try {
> 102	            int exit = process.waitFor();
> 103	            if (exit == 0) return new String(output, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).stripTrailing();
> 104	            if (missingAllowed) return null;
> 105	            log.warn("Git command failed in repository {} with exit {}: {}", root.getFileName(), exit,
> 106	                    new String(error, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).strip());
> 107	            return "";
> 108	        }
> 109	        catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 110	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 111	            throw new IOException("Git command interrupted", exception);
> 112	        }
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    private boolean include(Path root, Path file, RagProperties.Code config) {
> 116	        String relative = "/" + normalize(root.relativize(file).toString());
> 117	        if (config.excludes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains)) return false;
> 118	        return config.includes().isEmpty() || config.includes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains);
> 119	    }
> 120	
> 121	    private String normalize(String path) {
> 122	        return path.replace('\\', '/');
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private static final class Aggregate {
> 126	        private final List<CodeChunk> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 127	        private final List<CodeSymbol> symbols = new ArrayList<>();
> 128	        private final List<CodeCall> calls = new ArrayList<>();
> 129	        private final List<CodeScanDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 130	
> 131	        private Aggregate(List<CodeScanDiagnostic> capabilities) {
> 132	            diagnostics.addAll(capabilities);
> 133	        }
> 134	
> 135	        private ScanResult result(String project, String commit, int files) {
> 136	            return new ScanResult(project, commit, files, chunks, symbols, calls, diagnostics);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	}

> 52	        Aggregate aggregate = new Aggregate(registry.capabilityDiagnostics());

> 72	    private void parse(RagProperties.Code config, String commit, String path, String text, Aggregate aggregate) {
> 73	        if (text == null || text.indexOf('\0') >= 0
> 74	                || text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > config.resolvedMaxFileBytes()) {
> 75	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 76	                    "FILE_SKIPPED", "Binary or oversized source file"));
> 77	            return;
> 78	        }
> 79	        try {
> 80	            ParsedCodeFile parsed = registry.adapter(path).orElseThrow().parse(
> 81	                    config.projectId(), commit, path, text);
> 82	            aggregate.chunks.addAll(parsed.chunks());
> 83	            aggregate.symbols.addAll(parsed.symbols());
> 84	            aggregate.calls.addAll(parsed.calls());
> 85	            aggregate.diagnostics.addAll(parsed.diagnostics());
> 86	        }
> 87	        catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError exception) {
> 88	            log.warn("Code parsing failed for {}: {}", path, exception.getMessage(), exception);
> 89	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 90	                    "PARSE_FAILED", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 91	        }
> 92	    }

> 94	    private String git(Path root, List<String> arguments, boolean missingAllowed) throws IOException {
> 95	        List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
> 96	        command.add("git");
> 97	        command.addAll(arguments);
> 98	        Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(root.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(false).start();
> 99	        byte[] output = process.getInputStream().readAllBytes();
> 100	        byte[] error = process.getErrorStream().readAllBytes();
> 101	        try {
> 102	            int exit = process.waitFor();
> 103	            if (exit == 0) return new String(output, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).stripTrailing();
> 104	            if (missingAllowed) return null;
> 105	            log.warn("Git command failed in repository {} with exit {}: {}", root.getFileName(), exit,
> 106	                    new String(error, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).strip());
> 107	            return "";
> 108	        }
> 109	        catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 110	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 111	            throw new IOException("Git command interrupted", exception);
> 112	        }
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    private boolean include(Path root, Path file, RagProperties.Code config) {
> 116	        String relative = "/" + normalize(root.relativize(file).toString());
> 117	        if (config.excludes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains)) return false;
> 118	        return config.includes().isEmpty() || config.includes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains);
> 119	    }
> 120	
> 121	    private String normalize(String path) {
> 122	        return path.replace('\\', '/');
> 123	    }

> 130	
> 131	        private Aggregate(List<CodeScanDiagnostic> capabilities) {
> 132	            diagnostics.addAll(capabilities);
> 133	        }
> 134	
> 135	        private ScanResult result(String project, String commit, int files) {
> 136	            return new ScanResult(project, commit, files, chunks, symbols, calls, diagnostics);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.code.CodeRelation.Resolution;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.model.CodeIntelligenceResponse;
> 6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 7	
> 8	import java.util.ArrayDeque;
> 9	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 10	import java.util.HashSet;
> 11	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	import java.util.Set;
> 15	
> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;
> 22	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 23	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 24	
> 25	    public CodeIntelligenceService(SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store, RagProperties properties,
> 26	                                   GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 27	        this.store = store;
> 28	        this.properties = properties;
> 29	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 30	    }
> 31	
> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141	
> 142	    private record NodeDepth(CodeSymbol symbol, int depth) {
> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }
> 148	}

> 84	            return null;
> 85	        }
> 86	        Optional<RagProperties.ProjectConfig> project = projectRegistry.find(result.projectId());
> 87	        if (project.isEmpty()) {
> 88	            return null;
> 89	        }
> 90	        String side = hasText(result.side()) ? result.side() : project.get().side();
> 91	        double confidence = clampConfidence(result.confidence());
> 92	        return new QueryRouting(result.projectId(), normalizeSide(side), confidence, "llm");
> 93	    }
> 94	
> 95	    private QueryRouting fallbackRouting() {
> 96	        RagProperties.ProjectConfig defaultProject = projectRegistry.defaultProject();
> 97	        return new QueryRouting(defaultProject.id(), normalizeSide(defaultProject.side()), 0.0, "fallback");
> 98	    }
> 99	
> 100	    private String formatProjects() {
> 101	        return projectRegistry.all().stream()
> 102	                .map(project -> "- id=%s, name=%s, group=%s, side=%s".formatted(
> 103	                        project.id(), project.name(), project.group(), project.side()))
> 104	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n"));
> 105	    }
> 106	
> 107	    private String normalizeSide(String side) {
> 108	        if (!hasText(side)) {
> 109	            return "both";
> 110	        }
> 111	        String normalized = side.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
> 112	        return switch (normalized) {
> 113	            case "server", "client", "both" -> normalized;
> 114	            default -> "both";
> 115	        };
> 116	    }
> 117	
> 118	    private double clampConfidence(double confidence) {
> 119	        if (Double.isNaN(confidence) || Double.isInfinite(confidence)) {
> 120	            return 0.0;
> 121	        }
> 122	        return Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, confidence));
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 126	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 127	    }
> 128	
> 129	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 130	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 131	    }
> 132	
> 133	    private record LlmRoutingResult(String projectId, String side, double confidence) {
> 134	    }
> 135	}

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.code.CodeRelation.Resolution;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.model.CodeIntelligenceResponse;
> 6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 7	
> 8	import java.util.ArrayDeque;
> 9	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 10	import java.util.HashSet;
> 11	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	import java.util.Set;
> 15	
> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;
> 22	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 23	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 24	
> 25	    public CodeIntelligenceService(SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store, RagProperties properties,
> 26	                                   GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 27	        this.store = store;
> 28	        this.properties = properties;
> 29	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 30	    }
> 31	
> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141	
> 142	    private record NodeDepth(CodeSymbol symbol, int depth) {
> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

> 11	/**
> 12	 * 稀疏向量化器：基于字符级分词与哈希映射生成归一化稀疏向量。
> 13	 */
> 14	@Component
> 15	public class SparseVectorizer {
> 16	
> 17	    /**
> 18	     * 将文本转换为稀疏向量（indices + values），用于 Qdrant 稀疏检索。
> 19	     */
> 20	    public SparseVector vectorize(String text) {
> 21	        Map<Integer, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 22	        for (String token : tokenize(text)) {
> 23	            int index = token.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff;
> 24	            weights.merge(index, 1.0f, Float::sum);
> 25	        }
> 26	        float norm = (float) Math.sqrt(weights.values().stream().mapToDouble(v -> v * v).sum());
> 27	        List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 28	        List<Float> values = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 29	        weights.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()).forEach(entry -> {
> 30	            indices.add(entry.getKey());
> 31	            values.add(norm == 0 ? entry.getValue() : entry.getValue() / norm);
> 32	        });
> 33	        return new SparseVector(indices, values);
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    /** 中英文混合分词：汉字按单字/双字切分，英文按词切分。 */
> 37	    private List<String> tokenize(String text) {
> 38	        String normalized = text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^\\p{IsHan}a-z0-9]+", " ");
> 39	        List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
> 40	        for (String word : normalized.split("\\s+")) {
> 41	            if (word.isBlank()) continue;
> 42	            if (word.matches(".*\\p{IsHan}.*")) {
> 43	                for (int i = 0; i < word.length(); i++) {
> 44	                    tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 1));
> 45	                    if (i + 1 < word.length()) tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 2));
> 46	                }
> 47	            }
> 48	            else if (word.length() > 1) {
> 49	                tokens.add(word);
> 50	            }
> 51	        }
> 52	        return tokens;
> 53	    }
> 54

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.cache.BoundedTtlCache;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 5	import org.springframework.ai.embedding.EmbeddingModel;

> 9	import java.time.Duration;
> 10	import java.util.ArrayList;

> 12	
> 13	/**
> 14	 * 以受控批次生成向量。批次失败时自动二分降级，避免并发请求压垮本地嵌入服务。
> 15	 */
> 16	@Component
> 17	public class EmbeddingBatcher {
> 18	
> 19	    static final int DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32;
> 20	
> 21	    private final EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;
> 22	    private final BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache;
> 23	    private final String modelFingerprint;
> 24	
> 25	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel) {
> 26	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(Duration.ZERO, 0));
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    @Autowired
> 30	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, RagProperties properties) {
> 31	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(
> 32	                Duration.ofSeconds(properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheTtlSeconds()),
> 33	                properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheMaxEntries()));
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache) {
> 37	        this.embeddingModel = embeddingModel;
> 38	        this.cache = cache;
> 39	        this.modelFingerprint = embeddingModel.getClass().getName();
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 43	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 44	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 45	            return List.of();
> 46	        }
> 47	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 48	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 49	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 50	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 51	        }
> 52	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 56	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 57	        List<String> misses = new ArrayList<>();
> 58	        List<Integer> missIndexes = new ArrayList<>();
> 59	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 60	            String key = key(texts.get(index));
> 61	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 62	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 63	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 64	            } else {
> 65	                misses.add(texts.get(index));
> 66	                missIndexes.add(index);
> 67	            }
> 68	        }
> 69	        if (!misses.isEmpty()) {
> 70	            List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(misses, absoluteStart);
> 71	            for (int index = 0; index < embedded.size(); index++) {
> 72	                float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 73	                int resultIndex = missIndexes.get(index);
> 74	                cache.put(key(texts.get(resultIndex)), vector.clone());
> 75	                result.set(resultIndex, vector);
> 76	            }
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private String key(String text) {
> 82	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 86	        try {
> 87	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 88	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 89	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 90	            }
> 91	            return vectors;
> 92	        }
> 93	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 94	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 95	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 96	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 97	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 98	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 99	                        exception);
> 100	            }
> 101	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 102	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 103	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 104	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 105	            return vectors;
> 106	        }
> 107	    }
> 108	}
> ```

> 62	    private List<List<Map<String, Object>>> buildPointBatches(List<ChunkRecord> chunks, int batchSize) {
> 63	        List<List<Map<String, Object>>> batches = new ArrayList<>();
> 64	        for (int start = 0; start < chunks.size(); start += batchSize) {
> 65	            int end = Math.min(start + batchSize, chunks.size());
> 66	            batches.add(buildPoints(chunks.subList(start, end)));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return batches;
> 69	    }

> 73	            client.put().uri("/collections/{collection}/points?wait=true", collection)
> 74	                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
> 75	                    .body(Map.of("points", points))
> 76	                    .retrieve().toBodilessEntity();

> 81	    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildPoints(List<ChunkRecord> chunks) {
> 82	        List<String> childTexts = chunks.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList();
> 83	        List<float[]> denseVectors = embeddingBatcher.embedAll(childTexts);
> 84	        List<Map<String, Object>> points = new ArrayList<>(chunks.size());
> 85	        for (int index = 0; index < chunks.size(); index++) {
> 86	            ChunkRecord chunk = chunks.get(index);
> 87	            SparseVectorizer.SparseVector sparse = sparseVectorizer.vectorize(chunk.childText());
> 88	            points.add(Map.of(
> 89	                    "id", chunk.id(),
> 90	                    "vector", Map.of("dense", denseVectors.get(index),
> 91	                            "sparse", Map.of("indices", sparse.indices(), "values", sparse.values())),
> 92	                    "payload", Map.of(
> 93	                            "documentId", chunk.documentId(), "version", chunk.version(), "filename", chunk.filename(),
> 94	                            "parentId", chunk.parentId(), "parentText", chunk.parentText(), "childText", chunk.childText(),
> 95	                            "contentHash", chunk.contentHash(), "parentOrder", chunk.parentOrder(), "childOrder", chunk.childOrder())));
> 96	        }
> 97	        return points;
> 98	    }

> 180	    public List<ChunkRecord> scrollVersion(String collection, String documentId, String version) {

> 185	            Map<String, Object> request = new LinkedHashMap<>();

> 192	                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(request).retrieve()
> 193	                    .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 194	            Map<String, Object> page = map(response == null ? null : response.get("result"));
> 195	            result.addAll(toRecords(list(page.get("points"))));

> 201	    /** 轮询等待 Qdrant 服务就绪，超时则抛出异常。 */
> 202	    public void waitUntilReady(Duration timeout) {
> 203	        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + timeout.toNanos();
> 204	        RuntimeException lastFailure = null;
> 205	        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
> 206	            try {
> 207	                client.get().uri("/collections").retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 208	                return;
> 209	            }
> 210	            catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 211	                lastFailure = exception;
> 212	                sleepMillis(1_000);
> 213	            }
> 214	        }
> 215	        throw new IllegalStateException("Qdrant 未就绪: " + properties.qdrant().baseUrl(), lastFailure);
> 216	    }

> 218	    /** 确保指定 collection 存在，不存在则按嵌入维度自动创建。 */
> 219	    private void ensureCollection(String collection) {
> 220	        if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 221	            return;
> 222	        }
> 223	        synchronized (this) {
> 224	            if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 225	                return;
> 226	            }
> 227	            RuntimeException lastFailure = null;
> 228	            for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 10; attempt++) {
> 229	                try {
> 230	                    client.get().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 231	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 232	                    return;
> 233	                }
> 234	                catch (HttpClientErrorException.NotFound exception) {
> 235	                    Map<String, Object> body = Map.of(
> 236	                            "vectors", Map.of("dense", Map.of("size", embeddingModel.dimensions(), "distance", "Cosine")),
> 237	                            "sparse_vectors", Map.of("sparse", Map.of("modifier", "idf")));
> 238	                    client.put().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
> 239	                            .body(body).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 240	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 241	                    return;
> 242	                }
> 243	                catch (ResourceAccessException exception) {
> 244	                    lastFailure = exception;
> 245	                    sleepMillis(1_000L * attempt);
> 246	                }
> 247	            }
> 248	            throw new IllegalStateException("无法连接 Qdrant collection: " + collection, lastFailure);
> 249	        }
> 250	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.code.CodeRelation.Resolution;

> 6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 7	
> 8	import java.util.ArrayDeque;
> 9	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 10	import java.util.HashSet;
> 11	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	import java.util.Set;
> 15	
> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;
> 22	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 23	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 24	
> 25	    public CodeIntelligenceService(SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store, RagProperties properties,
> 26	                                   GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 27	        this.store = store;
> 28	        this.properties = properties;
> 29	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 30	    }
> 31	
> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141	
> 142	    private record NodeDepth(CodeSymbol symbol, int depth) {
> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }
> 148	}

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.security.UnauthenticatedException;
> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
> 9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 12	
> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 53	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 54	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 55	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 56	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 57	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 58	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 59	            throw exception;
> 60	        }
> 61	    }
> 62	
> 63	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 64	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 65	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 66	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 67	        }
> 68	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 69	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 70	            return user;
> 71	        }
> 72	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 73	    }
> 74	
> 75	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 76	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 77	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 78	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 82	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private String safe(String value) {
> 86	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 87	    }
> 88	}

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.ProjectRegistry;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.code.GitDiffService.GitDiffResult;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.model.CodeChunk;
> 7	import com.example.requirementrag.model.IncrementalCodeIndexResponse;
> 8	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 9	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 10	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 11	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 12	
> 13	import java.io.IOException;
> 14	import java.util.List;
> 15	
> 16	/**
> 17	 * 基于 Git diff 的增量代码索引服务。
> 18	 */
> 19	@Service
> 20	public class IncrementalCodeIndexService {
> 21	
> 22	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(IncrementalCodeIndexService.class);
> 23	    private static final String ZERO_SHA = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000";
> 24	
> 25	    private final ProjectRegistry projectRegistry;
> 26	    private final CodeScanner scanner;
> 27	    private final CodeQdrantStore store;
> 28	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 29	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore graphStore;
> 30	
> 31	    @Autowired
> 32	    public IncrementalCodeIndexService(ProjectRegistry projectRegistry, CodeScanner scanner,
> 33	                                       CodeQdrantStore store, GitDiffService gitDiffService,
> 34	                                       SQLiteSymbolGraphStore graphStore) {
> 35	        this.projectRegistry = projectRegistry;
> 36	        this.scanner = scanner;
> 37	        this.store = store;
> 38	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 39	        this.graphStore = graphStore;
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    /** Compatibility constructor for pre-0.7 unit callers. */
> 43	    IncrementalCodeIndexService(ProjectRegistry projectRegistry, JavaCodeScanner scanner,
> 44	                                CodeQdrantStore store, GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 45	        this(projectRegistry, CodeKnowledgeService.legacy(scanner), store, gitDiffService, null);
> 46	    }
> 47	
> 48	    /**
> 49	     * 兼容 webhook 的后台入口：失败时记录日志，不让 webhook 线程直接退出。
> 50	     */
> 51	    public void index(String projectId, String oldSha, String newSha) {
> 52	        try {
> 53	            indexWithResult(projectId, oldSha, newSha);
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (Exception exception) {
> 56	            log.error("增量索引失败 {}: {}", projectId, exception.getMessage(), exception);
> 57	        }
> 58	    }
> 59	
> 60	    /**
> 61	     * 按 Git commit 范围执行增量索引，并返回可审计的数量摘要。
> 62	     * 只写入配置的版本化代码 collection，不写入本地向量库文件。
> 63	     */
> 64	    public IncrementalCodeIndexResponse indexWithResult(String projectId, String oldSha, String newSha)
> 65	            throws IOException, InterruptedException {
> 66	        if (isZeroSha(oldSha) || isZeroSha(newSha)) {
> 67	            log.info("跳过增量索引 {}: 无效 commit 范围 {}..{}", projectId, oldSha, newSha);
> 68	            return new IncrementalCodeIndexResponse(projectId, oldSha, newSha, 0, 0, 0);
> 69	        }
> 70	        RagProperties.ProjectConfig project = projectRegistry.require(projectId);
> 71	        RagProperties.Code codeConfig = project.toCodeConfig();
> 72	        GitDiffResult diff = gitDiffService.diff(projectId, oldSha, newSha);
> 73	        List<String> changedFiles = diff.changedPaths();
> 74	        List<String> sourceFiles = changedFiles.stream()
> 75	                .map(this::normalizePath)
> 76	                .filter(scanner::supports)
> 77	                .distinct()
> 78	                .toList();
> 79	        if (sourceFiles.isEmpty()) {
> 80	            log.info("增量索引 {}: 无受支持的源码文件变更", projectId);
> 81	            return new IncrementalCodeIndexResponse(projectId, oldSha, newSha, changedFiles.size(), 0, 0);
> 82	        }
> 83	
> 84	        String collection = projectRegistry.resolveCodeCollection(projectId);
> 85	        for (String filePath : sourceFiles) {
> 86	            store.deleteFileChunks(collection, projectId, filePath);
> 87	        }
> 88	
> 89	        CodeScanner.ScanResult changed = scanner.scanFiles(codeConfig, newSha, sourceFiles);
> 90	        List<CodeChunk> chunks = changed.chunks();
> 91	        store.upsertChunks(collection, chunks);
> 92	        if (graphStore != null) {
> 93	            CodeScanner.ScanResult snapshot = scanner.scan(codeConfig);
> 94	            if (newSha.equals(snapshot.commitSha())) {
> 95	                graphStore.replaceSnapshot(snapshot);
> 96	            }
> 97	            else {
> 98	                log.warn("跳过静态图谱快照 {}: 工作区 HEAD {} 与目标 commit {} 不一致",
> 99	                        projectId, snapshot.commitSha(), newSha);
> 100	            }
> 101	        }
> 102	        log.info("增量索引完成 {}: {} 个源码文件, {} 个 chunk", projectId, sourceFiles.size(), chunks.size());
> 103	        return new IncrementalCodeIndexResponse(projectId, oldSha, newSha,
> 104	                changedFiles.size(), sourceFiles.size(), chunks.size());
> 105	    }
> 106	
> 107	    private String normalizePath(String path) {
> 108	        return path.replace('\\', '/');
> 109	    }
> 110	
> 111	    private boolean isZeroSha(String sha) {
> 112	        return sha == null || sha.isBlank() || ZERO_SHA.equals(sha);
> 113	    }
> 114	}

> 62	    private List<List<Map<String, Object>>> buildPointBatches(List<ChunkRecord> chunks, int batchSize) {
> 63	        List<List<Map<String, Object>>> batches = new ArrayList<>();
> 64	        for (int start = 0; start < chunks.size(); start += batchSize) {
> 65	            int end = Math.min(start + batchSize, chunks.size());
> 66	            batches.add(buildPoints(chunks.subList(start, end)));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return batches;
> 69	    }

> 74	                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
> 75	                    .body(Map.of("points", points))

> 91	                            "sparse", Map.of("indices", sparse.indices(), "values", sparse.values())),
> 92	                    "payload", Map.of(

> 94	                            "parentId", chunk.parentId(), "parentText", chunk.parentText(), "childText", chunk.childText(),
> 95	                            "contentHash", chunk.contentHash(), "parentOrder", chunk.parentOrder(), "childOrder", chunk.childOrder())));
> 96	        }

> 205	        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) {

> 210	            catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 211	                lastFailure = exception;

> 122	    private List<List<Map<String, Object>>> buildPointBatches(List<CodeChunk> chunks, int batchSize) {
> 123	        List<List<Map<String, Object>>> batches = new ArrayList<>();
> 124	        for (int start = 0; start < chunks.size(); start += batchSize) {
> 125	            int end = Math.min(start + batchSize, chunks.size());
> 126	            batches.add(buildPoints(chunks.subList(start, end)));
> 127	        }
> 128	        return batches;
> 129	    }

> 131	    private void writePointBatches(String collection, List<List<Map<String, Object>>> batches) {

> 133	            client.put().uri("/collections/{collection}/points?wait=true", collection)
> 134	                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)

> 140	    private List<Map<String, Object>> buildPoints(List<CodeChunk> chunks) {
> 141	        List<String> retrievalTexts = chunks.stream().map(CodeQdrantStore::retrievalText).toList();
> 142	        List<float[]> denseVectors = embeddingBatcher.embedAll(retrievalTexts);
> 143	        List<Map<String, Object>> points = new ArrayList<>(chunks.size());
> 144	        for (int index = 0; index < chunks.size(); index++) {
> 145	            CodeChunk chunk = chunks.get(index);
> 146	            SparseVectorizer.SparseVector sparse = sparseVectorizer.vectorize(retrievalTexts.get(index));
> 147	            points.add(Map.of(
> 148	                    "id", chunk.id(),
> 149	                    "vector", Map.of("dense", denseVectors.get(index),
> 150	                            "sparse", Map.of("indices", sparse.indices(), "values", sparse.values())),
> 151	                    "payload", Map.of(
> 152	                            "projectId", chunk.projectId(),
> 153	                            "commitSha", chunk.commitSha(),
> 154	                            "filePath", chunk.filePath(),
> 155	                            "symbolType", chunk.symbolType(),
> 156	                            "symbolName", chunk.symbolName(),
> 157	                            "language", chunk.language(),
> 158	                            "startLine", chunk.startLine(),
> 159	                            "endLine", chunk.endLine(),
> 160	                            "text", chunk.text(),
> 161	                            "contentHash", chunk.contentHash())));
> 162	        }
> 163	        return points;
> 164	    }

> 166	    /**
> 167	     * 构造仅用于向量检索的代码文本。payload 仍保存原始源码，避免元数据污染引用摘录。
> 168	     * 符号与路径元数据放在正文前，防止长方法体稀释实现入口、类名和方法名信号。
> 169	     */
> 170	    static String retrievalText(CodeChunk chunk) {
> 171	        String filePath = safeText(chunk.filePath());
> 172	        String symbolType = safeText(chunk.symbolType());
> 173	        String symbolName = safeText(chunk.symbolName());
> 174	        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
> 175	        text.append("file path: ").append(filePath).append('\n');
> 176	        text.append("symbol type: ").append(symbolType).append('\n');
> 177	        text.append("symbol name: ").append(symbolName).append('\n');
> 178	        text.append("symbol terms: ").append(splitIdentifier(symbolName)).append('\n');
> 179	        text.append("code role: ").append(codeRole(filePath, symbolType, symbolName)).append('\n');
> 180	        text.append("source code:\n").append(safeText(chunk.text()));
> 181	        return text.toString();
> 182	    }

> 184	    private static String codeRole(String filePath, String symbolType, String symbolName) {
> 185	        String normalizedPath = filePath.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 186	        String normalizedName = symbolName.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 187	        if (normalizedPath.contains("/src/test/") || normalizedPath.contains("/test/")) {
> 188	            return "test verification 测试 验证";
> 189	        }
> 190	        if (normalizedPath.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedName.endsWith("impl")) {
> 191	            return "service implementation business logic 服务实现 业务逻辑 实现入口";
> 192	        }
> 193	        if (normalizedPath.contains("/controller/")) {
> 194	            return "controller api endpoint request entry 控制器 接口 请求入口";
> 195	        }
> 196	        if (normalizedPath.contains("/service/") || "interface".equalsIgnoreCase(symbolType)) {
> 197	            return "service contract interface 服务接口 契约";
> 198	        }
> 199	        if (normalizedPath.contains("/consumer/") || normalizedPath.contains("/listener/")) {
> 200	            return "message consumer listener event handler 消息消费 事件处理";
> 201	        }
> 202	        if (normalizedPath.contains("/repository/") || normalizedPath.contains("/mapper/")) {
> 203	            return "data access repository mapper 数据访问 持久化";
> 204	        }
> 205	        return "code symbol implementation 代码符号 实现";
> 206	    }
