> 219	    private void ensureCollection(String collection) {
> 220	        if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 221	            return;
> 222	        }
> 223	        synchronized (this) {
> 224	            if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 225	                return;
> 226	            }
> 227	            RuntimeException lastFailure = null;
> 228	            for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 10; attempt++) {
> 229	                try {
> 230	                    client.get().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 231	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 232	                    return;
> 233	                }
> 234	                catch (HttpClientErrorException.NotFound exception) {
> 235	                    Map<String, Object> body = Map.of(
> 236	                            "vectors", Map.of("dense", Map.of("size", embeddingModel.dimensions(), "distance", "Cosine")),
> 237	                            "sparse_vectors", Map.of("sparse", Map.of("modifier", "idf")));
> 238	                    client.put().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
> 239	                            .body(body).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 240	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 241	                    return;
> 242	                }
> 243	                catch (ResourceAccessException exception) {
> 244	                    lastFailure = exception;
> 245	                    sleepMillis(1_000L * attempt);
> 246	                }
> 247	            }
> 248	            throw new IllegalStateException("无法连接 Qdrant code collection: " + collection, lastFailure);

> 250	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;

> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;
> 22	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 23	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 24	
> 25	    public CodeIntelligenceService(SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store, RagProperties properties,
> 26	                                   GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 27	        this.store = store;
> 28	        this.properties = properties;
> 29	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 30	    }
> 31	
> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }

> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }

> 143	    }

> 204	     * 在有限 RRF 候选池内做确定性结构重排。原始名次仍是主信号，仅对明确的符号词和代码角色意图加分。

> 206	    static List<CodeChunk> rerankCandidates(String query, List<CodeChunk> candidates, int limit) {
> 207	        if (candidates.isEmpty() || limit <= 0) {
> 208	            return List.of();
> 209	        }
> 210	        List<RankedCodeChunk> ranked = new ArrayList<>(candidates.size());
> 211	        for (int index = 0; index < candidates.size(); index++) {
> 212	            CodeChunk chunk = candidates.get(index);
> 213	            ranked.add(new RankedCodeChunk(chunk, index, candidateScore(query, chunk, index, candidates.size())));
> 214	        }
> 215	        return ranked.stream()
> 216	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(RankedCodeChunk::score).reversed()
> 217	                        .thenComparingInt(RankedCodeChunk::originalRank))
> 218	                .limit(Math.min(limit, ranked.size()))
> 219	                .map(RankedCodeChunk::chunk)
> 220	                .toList();
> 221	    }

> 223	    private static double candidateScore(String query, CodeChunk chunk, int index, int candidateCount) {
> 224	        String normalizedQuery = safeText(query).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 225	        String normalizedSymbol = safeText(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 226	        String symbolTerms = splitIdentifier(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 227	        String path = safeText(chunk.filePath()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 228	        double score = 1.0 - (0.30 * index / Math.max(candidateCount - 1.0, 1.0));
> 229	
> 230	        if (!normalizedSymbol.isBlank() && compact(normalizedQuery).contains(compact(normalizedSymbol))) {
> 231	            score += 0.50;
> 232	        }
> 233	        int matchedTerms = 0;
> 234	        for (String term : symbolTerms.split("\\s+")) {
> 235	            if (term.length() >= 3 && normalizedQuery.contains(term)) {
> 236	                matchedTerms++;
> 237	            }
> 238	        }
> 239	        score += Math.min(matchedTerms * 0.12, 0.36);
> 240	
> 241	        boolean serviceImplementation = path.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedSymbol.endsWith("impl");
> 242	        boolean controller = path.contains("/controller/");
> 243	        boolean test = path.contains("/src/test/") || path.contains("/test/");
> 244	        if (asksForServiceImplementation(normalizedQuery)) {
> 245	            if (serviceImplementation) {
> 246	                score += 0.42;
> 247	            }
> 248	            else if (controller) {
> 249	                score -= 0.08;
> 250	            }
> 251	        }
> 252	        else if (asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery) && serviceImplementation) {
> 253	            score += 0.24;
> 254	        }
> 255	        if (asksForController(normalizedQuery) && controller) {
> 256	            score += 0.35;
> 257	        }
> 258	        if (asksForTest(normalizedQuery)) {
> 259	            score += test ? 0.35 : 0.0;
> 260	        }
> 261	        else if (test) {
> 262	            score -= 0.12;
> 263	        }
> 264	        if ("method".equalsIgnoreCase(chunk.symbolType()) && asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery)) {
> 265	            score += 0.04;
> 266	        }
> 267	        return score;
> 268	    }

> 206	    static List<CodeChunk> rerankCandidates(String query, List<CodeChunk> candidates, int limit) {
> 207	        if (candidates.isEmpty() || limit <= 0) {
> 208	            return List.of();
> 209	        }
> 210	        List<RankedCodeChunk> ranked = new ArrayList<>(candidates.size());
> 211	        for (int index = 0; index < candidates.size(); index++) {
> 212	            CodeChunk chunk = candidates.get(index);
> 213	            ranked.add(new RankedCodeChunk(chunk, index, candidateScore(query, chunk, index, candidates.size())));
> 214	        }
> 215	        return ranked.stream()
> 216	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(RankedCodeChunk::score).reversed()
> 217	                        .thenComparingInt(RankedCodeChunk::originalRank))
> 218	                .limit(Math.min(limit, ranked.size()))
> 219	                .map(RankedCodeChunk::chunk)
> 220	                .toList();
> 221	    }
> 223	    private static double candidateScore(String query, CodeChunk chunk, int index, int candidateCount) {
> 224	        String normalizedQuery = safeText(query).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 225	        String normalizedSymbol = safeText(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 226	        String symbolTerms = splitIdentifier(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 227	        String path = safeText(chunk.filePath()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 228	        double score = 1.0 - (0.30 * index / Math.max(candidateCount - 1.0, 1.0));
> 229	
> 230	        if (!normalizedSymbol.isBlank() && compact(normalizedQuery).contains(compact(normalizedSymbol))) {
> 231	            score += 0.50;
> 232	        }
> 233	        int matchedTerms = 0;
> 234	        for (String term : symbolTerms.split("\\s+")) {
> 235	            if (term.length() >= 3 && normalizedQuery.contains(term)) {
> 236	                matchedTerms++;
> 237	            }
> 238	        }
> 239	        score += Math.min(matchedTerms * 0.12, 0.36);
> 240	
> 241	        boolean serviceImplementation = path.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedSymbol.endsWith("impl");
> 242	        boolean controller = path.contains("/controller/");
> 243	        boolean test = path.contains("/src/test/") || path.contains("/test/");
> 244	        if (asksForServiceImplementation(normalizedQuery)) {
> 245	            if (serviceImplementation) {
> 246	                score += 0.42;
> 247	            }
> 248	            else if (controller) {
> 249	                score -= 0.08;
> 250	            }
> 251	        }
> 252	        else if (asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery) && serviceImplementation) {
> 253	            score += 0.24;
> 254	        }
> 255	        if (asksForController(normalizedQuery) && controller) {
> 256	            score += 0.35;
> 257	        }
> 258	        if (asksForTest(normalizedQuery)) {
> 259	            score += test ? 0.35 : 0.0;
> 260	        }
> 261	        else if (test) {
> 262	            score -= 0.12;
> 263	        }
> 264	        if ("method".equalsIgnoreCase(chunk.symbolType()) && asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery)) {
> 265	            score += 0.04;
> 266	        }
> 267	        return score;
> 268	    }

> 85	    private List<CodeChunk> searchCrossSide(String query, String projectId, int limit) {
> 86	        String resolvedProject = projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 87	        List<String> projectIds = new ArrayList<>();
> 88	        projectIds.add(resolvedProject);
> 89	        try {
> 90	            RagProperties.ProjectConfig current = projectRegistry.require(resolvedProject);
> 91	            String group = current.group();
> 92	            String side = current.side();
> 93	            if (group != null && !group.isBlank()) {
> 94	                projectRegistry.findByGroup(group).stream()
> 95	                        .filter(project -> !resolvedProject.equals(project.id()))
> 96	                        .filter(project -> side == null || side.isBlank() || !side.equals(project.side()))
> 97	                        .map(RagProperties.ProjectConfig::id)
> 98	                        .forEach(projectIds::add);
> 99	            }
> 100	        }
> 101	        catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
> 102	            log.warn("Cross-side search is using only the resolved project because project metadata is unavailable: {}",
> 103	                    resolvedProject, exception);
> 104	        }
> 105	        return projectIds.stream()
> 106	                .flatMap(pid -> safeSearch(query, pid, limit))
> 107	                .limit(limit)
> 108	                .toList();
> 109	    }

> 90	    public List<CodeChunk> hybridSearch(String collection, String query, String projectId, int limit) {
> 91	        ensureCollection(collection);
> 92	        float[] dense = embeddingModel.embed(query);

> 94	        int candidateLimit = Math.max(limit * CANDIDATE_MULTIPLIER, MIN_CANDIDATE_LIMIT);

> 96	        Map<String, Object> body = new LinkedHashMap<>();

> 99	                Map.of("query", Map.of("indices", sparse.indices(), "values", sparse.values()),
> 100	                        "using", "sparse", "limit", prefetchLimit, "filter", filter(projectId))));
> 101	        body.put("query", Map.of("fusion", "rrf"));
> 102	        body.put("limit", candidateLimit);
> 103	        body.put("with_payload", true);

> 105	                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(body).retrieve()
> 106	                .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 107	        return rerankCandidates(query, extractPoints(response), limit);
> 108	    }

> 94	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> enforceTotalLimit(McpToolResponse<T> response) {
> 95	        try {
> 96	            if (jsonMapper.writeValueAsString(response).length() <= properties.maxResponseCharacters()) {

> 105	                "Tool response exceeded the configured size limit", 0));
> 106	        return new McpToolResponse<>(response.resolved(), null, List.of(), response.quality(), warnings, true);

> 157	                            "sparse", Map.of("indices", sparse.indices(), "values", sparse.values())),

> 203	    /**
> 204	     * 在有限 RRF 候选池内做确定性结构重排。原始名次仍是主信号，仅对明确的符号词和代码角色意图加分。
> 205	     */
> 206	    static List<CodeChunk> rerankCandidates(String query, List<CodeChunk> candidates, int limit) {
> 207	        if (candidates.isEmpty() || limit <= 0) {
> 208	            return List.of();
> 209	        }
> 210	        List<RankedCodeChunk> ranked = new ArrayList<>(candidates.size());
> 211	        for (int index = 0; index < candidates.size(); index++) {
> 212	            CodeChunk chunk = candidates.get(index);
> 213	            ranked.add(new RankedCodeChunk(chunk, index, candidateScore(query, chunk, index, candidates.size())));
> 214	        }
> 215	        return ranked.stream()
> 216	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(RankedCodeChunk::score).reversed()
> 217	                        .thenComparingInt(RankedCodeChunk::originalRank))
> 218	                .limit(Math.min(limit, ranked.size()))
> 219	                .map(RankedCodeChunk::chunk)
> 220	                .toList();
> 221	    }

> 223	    private static double candidateScore(String query, CodeChunk chunk, int index, int candidateCount) {
> 224	        String normalizedQuery = safeText(query).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 225	        String normalizedSymbol = safeText(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 226	        String symbolTerms = splitIdentifier(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 227	        String path = safeText(chunk.filePath()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 228	        double score = 1.0 - (0.30 * index / Math.max(candidateCount - 1.0, 1.0));
> 229	
> 230	        if (!normalizedSymbol.isBlank() && compact(normalizedQuery).contains(compact(normalizedSymbol))) {
> 231	            score += 0.50;
> 232	        }
> 233	        int matchedTerms = 0;
> 234	        for (String term : symbolTerms.split("\\s+")) {
> 235	            if (term.length() >= 3 && normalizedQuery.contains(term)) {
> 236	                matchedTerms++;
> 237	            }
> 238	        }
> 239	        score += Math.min(matchedTerms * 0.12, 0.36);
> 240	
> 241	        boolean serviceImplementation = path.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedSymbol.endsWith("impl");
> 242	        boolean controller = path.contains("/controller/");
> 243	        boolean test = path.contains("/src/test/") || path.contains("/test/");
> 244	        if (asksForServiceImplementation(normalizedQuery)) {
> 245	            if (serviceImplementation) {
> 246	                score += 0.42;
> 247	            }
> 248	            else if (controller) {
> 249	                score -= 0.08;
> 250	            }
> 251	        }
> 252	        else if (asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery) && serviceImplementation) {
> 253	            score += 0.24;
> 254	        }
> 255	        if (asksForController(normalizedQuery) && controller) {
> 256	            score += 0.35;
> 257	        }
> 258	        if (asksForTest(normalizedQuery)) {
> 259	            score += test ? 0.35 : 0.0;
> 260	        }
> 261	        else if (test) {
> 262	            score -= 0.12;
> 263	        }
> 264	        if ("method".equalsIgnoreCase(chunk.symbolType()) && asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery)) {
> 265	            score += 0.04;
> 266	        }
> 267	        return score;
> 268	    }

> 344	        synchronized (this) {

> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.rerank;

> 9	/**
> 10	 * 带降级能力的 BGE 重排器装饰器，服务不可用时回退为原始顺序。
> 11	 */
> 12	public class ResilientBgeReranker implements BgeReranker {
> 13	
> 14	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ResilientBgeReranker.class);
> 15	
> 16	    private final BgeReranker delegate;
> 17	
> 18	    /** 包装实际重排器实现。 */
> 19	    public ResilientBgeReranker(BgeReranker delegate) {
> 20	        this.delegate = delegate;
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    /** 委托重排，失败时记录警告并按混合检索原始顺序截取 topK。 */
> 24	    @Override
> 25	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
> 27	            return List.of();
> 28	        }
> 29	        try {
> 30	            return delegate.rerank(query, candidates, topK);
> 31	        }
> 32	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 33	            log.atWarn().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "bge_rerank_fallback")
> 34	                    .log("BGE reranker unavailable, using hybrid order");
> 35	            return candidates.stream().limit(topK).toList();
> 36	        }
> 37	    }

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""

> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()

> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);

> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;

> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;

> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 53	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 54	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 55	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 56	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 57	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 58	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 59	            throw exception;
> 60	        }
> 61	    }

> 63	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 64	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 65	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 66	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 67	        }
> 68	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 69	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 70	            return user;
> 71	        }
> 72	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 73	    }

> 78	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 79	    }

> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});

> 48	        }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.rerank;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.ChunkRecord;
> 5	import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference;
> 6	import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
> 7	import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
> 8	import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
> 9	
> 10	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 11	import java.util.Comparator;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	
> 15	/**
> 16	 * 通过 HTTP 调用 BGE 重排 API 的实现。
> 17	 */
> 18	public class HttpBgeReranker implements BgeReranker {
> 19	
> 20	    private final RestClient client;
> 21	    private final RagProperties.Bge properties;
> 22	
> 23	    /** 注入 REST 客户端与 BGE 服务配置。 */
> 24	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties) {
> 25	        this.client = client;
> 26	        this.properties = properties;
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */
> 53	    private record Scored(ChunkRecord chunk, double score) {
> 54	    }
> 55	}

你的 **Ollama 本地 BGE 是正常的**。刚才的实测结果是：

- Ollama 服务：HTTP 200
- `bge-m3` 模型：已安装
- `/api/embed`：HTTP 200
- 成功生成 **1024 维向量**

所以问题不是 Ollama，也不是 `bge-m3` embedding 失败。

真正失败的是另一条独立链路：

```text
Ollama bge-m3
  → /api/embed
  → 生成向量，用于 Qdrant dense 召回
  → 当前正常

独立 BGE Reranker 服务
  → 8081 /rerank
  → 对召回候选进行交叉编码重排
  → 当前无法连接
```

项目在 `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/config/EmbeddingConfiguration.java` 中，把 Ollama 模型作为主 `EmbeddingModel`，这一部分确实在用你的本地 BGE。

但 `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/rerank/HttpBgeReranker.java` 并不调用 Ollama `/api/embed`。它访问单独配置的 reranker 地址，发送：

```json
{"query":"...","texts":["..."],"truncate":true}
```

并要求返回类似：

```json
[{"index":0,"score":0.92}]
```

当前配置中这两个服务也明确是不同端口：

- Ollama embedding：本机 `11434`，正常
- BGE reranker：本机 `8081/rerank`，无法连接

因此 `BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE` 的准确含义是：**独立的重排端点不可用**，而不是“Ollama BGE 不可用”。之前将其笼统描述为“BGE 服务未监听”不够准确，应当更正。

关键区别是：

- **Embedding 模型**：把查询和文档分别变成向量，用于召回。
- **Reranker 模型**：把查询和每个候选文档一起输入，直接给出相关性分数，用于重新排序。

虽然名字里都可能带 BGE，但它们不是同一种任务，也不是同一个 API。你现在的 `bge-m3` 解决的是第一项；项目还额外要求第二项。

可选修复方案：

1. **推荐：启动独立 reranker 服务**，让它提供当前代码要求的 `/rerank` 契约。
2. 修改 `HttpBgeReranker`，适配你实际拥有的 reranker API。
3. 如果暂时只使用 Ollama embedding，就显式关闭或跳过 BGE rerank 阶段，避免将正常的降级召回记成评测失败。

但不能简单把 `BGE_RERANK_URL` 改成 Ollama 的 `11434`：Ollama 的 `/api/embed` 返回向量，不会返回当前代码要求的候选 `index + score` 重排结果。

你确实已经安装了 reranker 模型，完整名称是：

`hans-tech/bge-reranker-v2-m3:260522`

但实测表明，问题不是“模型没安装”，而是 **当前 Ollama 没有把它作为 reranker API 暴露出来**：

- Ollama 版本：`0.11.10`
- 模型已安装：是
- 模型架构：BERT，约 568M 参数
- Ollama 声明能力：只有 `completion`
- 调用 `/api/embed`：HTTP 200，但得到的是 1024 维向量
- 调用 `/api/generate`：HTTP 200，但输出无意义的重复文本
- 调用 `/api/rerank`：HTTP 404

因此，**安装成功 ≠ 当前项目可以调用它完成重排**。

项目的 `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/rerank/HttpBgeReranker.java` 需要一个真正的重排接口：

```http
POST /rerank
```

请求类似：

```json
{"query":"查询内容","texts":["候选一","候选二"],"truncate":true}
```

返回类似：

```json
[{"index":0,"score":0.93},{"index":1,"score":0.12}]
```

而当前 Ollama：

1. 只监听本机 `11434`；
2. 项目配置的 reranker 在另一个本机端口 `8081/rerank`；
3. Ollama 本身的 `/api/rerank` 返回 404；
4. `/api/embed` 返回的是向量，不是 cross-encoder 的候选相关性分数。

所以 `BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE` 的真实原因是：**8081 上没有兼容项目契约的 reranker 服务，且当前 Ollama API 不能直接替代它。**

另外，不能只把 `BGE_RERANK_URL` 改为 Ollama 的 `11434`。即使改了，项目请求 `/rerank` 仍会得到 404。也不能把 `/api/embed` 当成 `/rerank`，否则使用的不是该模型真正的交叉编码排序输出。

可行方案有两个：

- **正确方案：** 用支持 sequence-classification/reranking 的运行时启动这个 BGE reranker，在 `8081/rerank` 提供兼容接口。可考虑 llama.cpp reranking server 或独立 Python/Transformers reranker 服务。
- **临时方案：** 显式关闭 BGE rerank，将 Ollama 的 `bge-m3` 仅用于向量召回，并把评测状态标为“未启用重排”，而不是“模型不可用”。

结论：**你的模型已经装对了；不行的是服务/API 接入方式，不是模型缺失。** 当前这个 Ollama 模型实际上被当作 embedding/completion 模型运行，没有提供项目所需的 reranker score 接口。下一步应启动一个兼容的 `8081/rerank` 服务，或者修改项目以接入实际支持 reranking 的运行时。之前文档中笼统写成“BGE 服务未监听”应修正为“独立 reranker endpoint 未提供，Ollama embedding 接口与 rerank 契约不兼容”。

> 我该怎么解决这个问题呢

我先检查本机是否已有可运行 GGUF reranker 的 `llama-server`，并核对项目当前任务规范；如果具备条件，我会直接把独立重排服务接通并做最小验证。

> 18	    public static Integer firstDocumentRank(List<RetrievalEvaluationCase.GoldDocument> goldDocuments,
> 19	                                            List<ChunkRecord> candidates,
> 20	                                            int cutoff) {
> 21	        Integer best = null;
> 22	        for (RetrievalEvaluationCase.GoldDocument gold : goldDocuments) {
> 23	            StringBuilder accumulatedText = new StringBuilder();
> 24	            for (int index = 0; index < Math.min(cutoff, candidates.size()); index++) {
> 25	                ChunkRecord candidate = candidates.get(index);
> 26	                if (!sameDocumentLabel(gold, candidate)) {

> 28	                }
> 29	                accumulatedText.append('\n').append(candidate.parentText()).append('\n').append(candidate.childText());
> 30	                if (containsAll(accumulatedText.toString(), gold.mustContain())) {
> 31	                    int rank = index + 1;
> 32	                    best = best == null ? rank : Math.min(best, rank);
> 33	                    break;
> 34	                }
> 35	            }
> 36	        }
> 37	        return best;
> 38	    }

> 16	 * 通过 HTTP 调用 BGE 重排 API 的实现。

> 18	public class HttpBgeReranker implements BgeReranker {
> 19	
> 20	    private final RestClient client;
> 21	    private final RagProperties.Bge properties;
> 22	
> 23	    /** 注入 REST 客户端与 BGE 服务配置。 */
> 24	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties) {
> 25	        this.client = client;
> 26	        this.properties = properties;
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */
> 53	    private record Scored(ChunkRecord chunk, double score) {
> 54	    }
> 55	}

> 226	                        doubt.question(),

> 228	                        doubt.status(),

> 234	    /** 确保模块名带 [历史版本] 前缀且避免重复添加。 */
> 235	    private String prefixPriorModule(String module) {
> 236	        if (module == null || module.isBlank()) {
> 237	            return "[历史版本]";
> 238	        }
> 239	        if (module.startsWith("[历史版本]")) {
> 240	            return module;
> 241	        }
> 242	        return "[历史版本] " + module;
> 243	    }
> 244	
> 245	    /** 按模块关键词过滤分块；无匹配时返回原列表。 */
> 246	    private List<ChunkRecord> filterByModule(List<ChunkRecord> chunks, String module) {
> 247	        if (module == null || module.isBlank()) {
> 248	            return chunks;
> 249	        }
> 250	        String expected = module.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
> 251	        List<ChunkRecord> matched = chunks.stream()
> 252	                .filter(chunk -> chunk.parentText().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(expected))
> 253	                .toList();
> 254	        return matched.isEmpty() ? chunks : matched;
> 255	    }
> 256	
> 257	    /** 按版本路径前缀过滤分块，确保只取指定版本目录下的文件。 */
> 258	    private List<ChunkRecord> filterByVersionPath(List<ChunkRecord> chunks, String version) {
> 259	        if (version == null || version.isBlank() || chunks == null || chunks.isEmpty()) {
> 260	            return chunks == null ? List.of() : chunks;
> 261	        }
> 262	        String prefix = version.trim().replace('\\', '/') + "/";
> 263	        return chunks.stream()
> 264	                .filter(chunk -> chunk.filename() != null && chunk.filename().replace('\\', '/').startsWith(prefix))
> 265	                .toList();
> 266	    }
> 267	
> 268	    /** 去重、排序并可选覆盖模块名，规范化 LLM 输出批次。 */
> 269	    private DoubtBatch normalize(DoubtBatch batch, String requestedModule) {
> 270	        if (batch == null || batch.doubts() == null) {
> 271	            return new DoubtBatch(List.of());
> 272	        }
> 273	        Map<String, RequirementDoubt> unique = batch.doubts().stream()
> 274	                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
> 275	                .filter(doubt -> doubt.question() != null && !doubt.question().isBlank())
> 276	                .map(doubt -> requestedModule == null || requestedModule.isBlank() ? doubt : new RequirementDoubt(
> 277	                        requestedModule, doubt.feature(), doubt.question(), doubt.type(), doubt.status(), doubt.sourceLocation()))
> 278	                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 279	                        doubt -> normalizeQuestion(doubt.question()),
> 280	                        Function.identity(),
> 281	                        (left, right) -> left,
> 282	                        LinkedHashMap::new));
> 283	
> 284	        List<RequirementDoubt> sorted = unique.values().stream()
> 285	                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(RequirementDoubt::module, Comparator.nullsLast(String::compareTo))
> 286	                        .thenComparing(RequirementDoubt::feature, Comparator.nullsLast(String::compareTo)))
> 287	                .toList();
> 288	        return new DoubtBatch(sorted);
> 289	    }

> 291	    /** 截断至配置的最大存疑条数。 */
> 292	    private DoubtBatch limitQuestions(DoubtBatch batch, int maxQuestions) {
> 293	        if (batch == null || batch.doubts() == null) {
> 294	            return new DoubtBatch(List.of());
> 295	        }
> 296	        if (batch.doubts().size() <= maxQuestions) {
> 297	            return batch;
> 298	        }
> 299	        return new DoubtBatch(batch.doubts().subList(0, maxQuestions));

> 302	    /** 规范化问题文本用于去重比较（去标点、空白并转小写）。 */
> 303	    private String normalizeQuestion(String question) {
> 304	        return question.replaceAll("[\\s，。；：、？！?]", "").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
> 305	    }

> 307	    /** 拼接父块文本为 LLM 上下文，按 parentOrder 排序并截断至最大字符数。 */
> 308	    private String joinParents(List<ChunkRecord> documents) {
> 309	        String context = documents.stream()
> 310	                .collect(Collectors.toMap(ChunkRecord::parentId, Function.identity(), (a, b) -> a, LinkedHashMap::new))
> 311	                .values().stream()
> 312	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(ChunkRecord::parentOrder))
> 313	                .map(document -> "[" + document.filename() + ", parent=" + document.parentId() + "]\n" + document.parentText())
> 314	                .distinct()
> 315	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n\n"));
> 316	        return context.substring(0, Math.min(MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS, context.length()));
> 317	    }

> 13	
> 14	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ResilientBgeReranker.class);
> 15	
> 16	    private final BgeReranker delegate;
> 17	
> 18	    /** 包装实际重排器实现。 */
> 19	    public ResilientBgeReranker(BgeReranker delegate) {
> 20	        this.delegate = delegate;
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    /** 委托重排，失败时记录警告并按混合检索原始顺序截取 topK。 */
> 24	    @Override
> 25	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
> 27	            return List.of();
> 28	        }
> 29	        try {
> 30	            return delegate.rerank(query, candidates, topK);
> 31	        }
> 32	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 33	            log.atWarn().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "bge_rerank_fallback")
> 34	                    .log("BGE reranker unavailable, using hybrid order");
> 35	            return candidates.stream().limit(topK).toList();
> 36	        }
> 37	    }
> 38	}

> 165	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 166	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 167	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 168	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 169	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 170	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 171	        }
> 172	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 173	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 174	    }

> 176	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {

> 179	    }

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }

> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }

> 15	/**
> 16	 * 通过 HTTP 调用 BGE 重排 API 的实现。
> 17	 */
> 18	public class HttpBgeReranker implements BgeReranker {
> 19	
> 20	    private final RestClient client;
> 21	    private final RagProperties.Bge properties;
> 22	
> 23	    /** 注入 REST 客户端与 BGE 服务配置。 */
> 24	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties) {
> 25	        this.client = client;
> 26	        this.properties = properties;
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */
> 53	    private record Scored(ChunkRecord chunk, double score) {
> 54	    }
> 55	}

> 23	
> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }
> 116	
> 117	    private record RankedIds(List<String> ids) {
> 118	    }

> 36	            if (constantTimeEquals(candidate, configured.apiKey())) {

> 38	            }
> 39	        }
> 40	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 41	    }

> 43	    private boolean constantTimeEquals(String left, String right) {
> 44	        if (left == null || right == null) {
> 45	            return false;
> 46	        }
> 47	        return MessageDigest.isEqual(
> 48	                left.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
> 49	                right.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
> 50	    }
> 51	}

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }

> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51

> 21	/**
> 22	 * RAG 流水线可观测性：阶段计时、指标上报与结构化日志。
> 23	 */
> 24	@Component
> 25	public class RagObservability {
> 26	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RagObservability.class);
> 27	    private static final int MAX_RECENT_EVENTS = 200;
> 28	    private final ObservationRegistry observationRegistry;
> 29	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 30	    private final List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents = new ArrayList<>();
> 31	
> 32	    /** 注入 Micrometer 观测与指标注册表。 */
> 33	    public RagObservability(ObservationRegistry observationRegistry, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
> 34	        this.observationRegistry = observationRegistry;
> 35	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    /** 观测带返回值的操作，记录耗时、成功/失败日志与失败计数。 */
> 39	    public <T> T observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Supplier<T> action) {
> 40	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        Observation observation = Observation.createNotStarted("rag.stage", observationRegistry)
> 42	                .contextualName("rag " + stage)
> 43	                .lowCardinalityKeyValue("rag.stage", stage)
> 44	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.id", safe(documentId))
> 45	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.version", safe(version));
> 46	        try {
> 47	            T result = observation.observe(action);
> 48	            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 49	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 50	                    .addKeyValue("status", "success").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 51	                    .log("RAG stage completed");
> 52	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "success", elapsedMillis(started), ""));
> 53	            return result;
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 56	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 57	                    .tag("exception", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 58	            log.atError().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 59	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 60	                    .addKeyValue("status", "failure").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 61	                    .log("RAG stage failed");
> 62	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "failed",
> 63	                    elapsedMillis(started), exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 64	            throw exception;
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    /** 观测无返回值的操作。 */
> 69	    public void observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Runnable action) {
> 70	        observe(stage, documentId, version, () -> { action.run(); return null; });
> 71	    }
> 72	
> 73	    /** 记录已被调用方归类的阶段结果；公开诊断只保存稳定 warning code。 */
> 74	    public void outcome(String stage, String documentId, String version, RagOutcomeStatus status,
> 75	                        long durationMs, String warningCode, RuntimeException failure) {
> 76	        String normalizedStatus = status.name().toLowerCase();
> 77	        Counter.builder("rag.stage.outcomes").tag("stage", stage).tag("status", normalizedStatus)
> 78	                .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 79	        if (warningCode != null && !warningCode.isBlank()) {
> 80	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.warnings").tag("stage", stage).tag("code", warningCode)
> 81	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 82	        }
> 83	        var event = log.atInfo();
> 84	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED) {
> 85	            event = log.atWarn();
> 86	        } else if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) {
> 87	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 88	                    .tag("exception", failure == null ? "Unknown" : failure.getClass().getSimpleName())
> 89	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 90	            event = log.atError();
> 91	            if (failure != null) {
> 92	                event.setCause(failure);
> 93	            }
> 94	        }
> 95	        event.addKeyValue("event", "rag_outcome").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 96	                .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 97	                .addKeyValue("status", normalizedStatus).addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
> 98	                .addKeyValue("warningCode", safe(warningCode)).log("RAG stage outcome");
> 99	        remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), normalizedStatus,
> 100	                durationMs, warningCode == null ? "" : warningCode));
> 101	    }
> 102

> 105	        DistributionSummary.builder("rag.stage.items")
> 106	                .description("Number of items entering or leaving a RAG stage")

> 113	    }

> 71	    def __init__(self, config: RerankerConfig) -> None:

> 82	            import torch

> 84	        except ImportError as error:

> 87	            ) from error

> 89	        self.device = self._resolve_device(torch)
> 90	        LOGGER.info("Loading reranker model=%s device=%s", self.model_id, self.device)
> 91	        self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_id, trust_remote_code=True)
> 92	        self._model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
> 93	            self.model_id,
> 94	            trust_remote_code=True,
> 95	        )
> 96	        self._model.to(self.device)
> 97	        self._model.eval()
> 98	        self._torch = torch
> 99	        LOGGER.info("Reranker ready model=%s device=%s", self.model_id, self.device)
> 100	
> 101	    def _resolve_device(self, torch: Any) -> str:
> 102	        requested = self.config.device.strip().lower()
> 103	        if requested != "auto":
> 104	            return requested
> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
> 106	            return "mps"
> 107	        if torch.cuda.is_available():

> 111	    def score(self, query: str, texts: list[str], truncate: bool) -> list[float]:
> 112	        if self._model is None or self._tokenizer is None or self._torch is None:
> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():
> 117	            for start in range(0, len(texts), self.config.batch_size):
> 118	                batch = texts[start : start + self.config.batch_size]
> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {
> 120	                    "padding": True,
> 121	                    "truncation": truncate,
> 122	                    "return_tensors": "pt",
> 123	                }
> 124	                if truncate:
> 125	                    tokenization["max_length"] = self.config.max_length
> 126	                inputs = self._tokenizer([query] * len(batch), batch, **tokenization)
> 127	                inputs = {name: tensor.to(self.device) for name, tensor in inputs.items()}
> 128	                logits = self._model(**inputs, return_dict=True).logits.reshape(-1).float()
> 129	                if self.config.normalize:
> 130	                    logits = self._torch.sigmoid(logits)
> 131	                scores.extend(float(value) for value in logits.cpu().tolist())
> 132	        if len(scores) != len(texts):
> 133	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker returned an unexpected score count")
> 134	        return scores

> 137	def validate_request(payload: Any, max_texts: int) -> tuple[str, list[str], bool]:
> 138	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
> 139	        raise ValueError("request body must be a JSON object")
> 140	    query = payload.get("query")
> 141	    texts = payload.get("texts")

> 143	    if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip():
> 144	        raise ValueError("query must be a non-empty string")
> 145	    if not isinstance(texts, list) or not texts:
> 146	        raise ValueError("texts must be a non-empty array")
> 147	    if len(texts) > max_texts:

> 149	    if not all(isinstance(text, str) and text.strip() for text in texts):
> 150	        raise ValueError("every texts entry must be a non-empty string")
> 151	    if not isinstance(truncate, bool):
> 152	        raise ValueError("truncate must be a boolean")
> 153	    return query, texts, truncate

已按 **Python / Transformers 独立 reranker 服务**的方案完成，解决了 Ollama 本地 BGE reranker 无法直接用于 NEXUS 的问题。

## 最终架构

- **Ollama embedding**：继续负责向量召回，不受影响。
- **Transformers cross-encoder**：负责精排（rerank）。
- 精排模型：`BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3`
- 服务地址：`http://127.0.0.1:8081/rerank`
- Java 侧仍使用原有兼容契约，无需改调用方式。

之所以不直接用你安装的 `hans-tech/bge-reranker-v2-m3:260522`，是因为你当前 Ollama 版本及该模型暴露的是 completion 能力，不能提供 NEXUS 所需的 query-document cross-encoder `/rerank` 分数接口；`/api/embed` 返回 embedding，不能等价替代 rerank。
