> 1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
> 2	# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
> 3	"""
> 4	Workflow Phase Extraction.
> 5	
> 6	Extracts step-level content from .trellis/workflow.md and optionally filters
> 7	platform-specific blocks.
> 8	
> 9	Platform marker syntax in workflow.md:
> 10	
> 11	    [Claude Code, Cursor, ...]
> 12	    agent-capable content
> 13	    [/Claude Code, Cursor, ...]
> 14	
> 15	Provides:
> 16	    get_phase_index   - Extract the Phase Index section (no --step)
> 17	    get_step          - Extract a single step (#### X.X) section
> 18	    filter_platform   - Strip platform blocks that don't include the given name
> 19	"""
> 20	
> 21	from __future__ import annotations
> 22	
> 23	import re
> 24	
> 25	from .paths import DIR_WORKFLOW, get_repo_root
> 26	
> 27	
> 28	def _workflow_md_path():
> 29	    return get_repo_root() / DIR_WORKFLOW / "workflow.md"
> 30	
> 31	# Match a line that *is* a platform marker: "[A, B, C]" or "[/A, B, C]"
> 32	_MARKER_RE = re.compile(r"^\[(/?)([A-Za-z][^\[\]]*)\]\s*$")
> 33	
> 34	# Step heading: "#### 1.0 Title" or "#### 1.0 ..."
> 35	_STEP_HEADING_RE = re.compile(r"^####\s+(\d+\.\d+)\b.*$")
> 36	
> 37	# Phase Index starts here; Phase 1/2/3 step bodies follow; ends at Breadcrumbs.
> 38	_PHASE_INDEX_HEADING = "## Phase Index"
> 39	
> 40	
> 41	def _read_workflow() -> str:
> 42	    path = _workflow_md_path()
> 43	    if not path.exists():
> 44	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"workflow.md not found: {path}")
> 45	    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
> 46	
> 47	
> 48	def _parse_marker(line: str) -> tuple[bool, list[str]] | None:
> 49	    """Parse a platform marker line.
> 50	
> 51	    Returns:
> 52	        (is_closing, [platform_names]) if line is a marker, else None.
> 53	    """
> 54	    m = _MARKER_RE.match(line)
> 55	    if not m:
> 56	        return None
> 57	    is_closing = m.group(1) == "/"
> 58	    names = [p.strip() for p in m.group(2).split(",") if p.strip()]
> 59	    return is_closing, names
> 60	
> 61	
> 62	def get_phase_index() -> str:
> 63	    """Return the compact Phase Index summary from workflow.md.
> 64	
> 65	    SessionStart and no-step phase context use this small summary as their
> 66	    orientation payload. Detailed Phase 1/2/3 instructions are loaded with
> 67	    ``get_step`` on demand. ``[workflow-state:STATUS]`` tag blocks are
> 68	    consumed by the per-turn hook, so they're stripped from this output.
> 69	    """
> 70	    text = _read_workflow()
> 71	    lines = text.splitlines()
> 72	
> 73	    start: int | None = None
> 74	    end: int | None = None
> 75	    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
> 76	        stripped = line.strip()
> 77	        if start is None and stripped == _PHASE_INDEX_HEADING:
> 78	            start = i
> 79	            continue
> 80	        if start is not None and stripped == "## Phase 1: Plan":
> 81	            end = i
> 82	            break
> 83	
> 84	    if start is None:
> 85	        return ""
> 86	    if end is None:
> 87	        end = len(lines)
> 88	
> 89	    section = "\n".join(lines[start:end]).rstrip()
> 90	    # Strip [workflow-state:STATUS]...[/workflow-state:STATUS] blocks since
> 91	    # they're injected separately by inject-workflow-state.py per-turn.
> 92	    import re as _re
> 93	    tag_re = _re.compile(
> 94	        r"\[workflow-state:([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\]\s*\n.*?\n\s*\[/workflow-state:\1\]\n?",
> 95	        _re.DOTALL,
> 96	    )
> 97	    return tag_re.sub("", section).rstrip() + "\n"
> 98	
> 99	
> 100	def get_step(step_id: str) -> str:
> 101	    """Return the `#### X.X` section matching step_id (header + body).
> 102	
> 103	    Body ends at the next `####` or `---` or `##` heading (whichever comes first).
> 104	    """
> 105	    text = _read_workflow()
> 106	    lines = text.splitlines()
> 107	
> 108	    start: int | None = None
> 109	    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
> 110	        m = _STEP_HEADING_RE.match(line)
> 111	        if m and m.group(1) == step_id:
> 112	            start = i
> 113	            break
> 114	    if start is None:
> 115	        return ""
> 116	
> 117	    end: int = len(lines)
> 118	    for j in range(start + 1, len(lines)):
> 119	        line = lines[j]
> 120	        if line.startswith("#### "):
> 121	            end = j
> 122	            break
> 123	        if line.startswith("## "):
> 124	            end = j
> 125	            break
> 126	        # Horizontal rule at column 0
> 127	        if line.strip() == "---":
> 128	            end = j
> 129	            break
> 130	
> 131	    return "\n".join(lines[start:end]).rstrip() + "\n"
> 132	
> 133	
> 134	def _platform_matches(platform: str, block_names: list[str]) -> bool:
> 135	    """Case-insensitive fuzzy match: accept 'cursor', 'Cursor', 'claude-code', 'Claude Code'."""
> 136	    needle = platform.lower().replace("-", "").replace("_", "").replace(" ", "")
> 137	    for name in block_names:
> 138	        hay = name.lower().replace("-", "").replace("_", "").replace(" ", "")
> 139	        if needle == hay:
> 140	            return True
> 141	    return False
> 142	
> 143	
> 144	def resolve_effective_platform(platform: str, config: dict) -> str:
> 145	    """Map ``codex`` to a dispatch-mode-namespaced virtual platform name.
> 146	
> 147	    When ``--platform codex`` is passed, return ``"codex-inline"`` (default)
> 148	    or ``"codex-sub-agent"`` based on ``.trellis/config.yaml`` ``codex.dispatch_mode``.
> 149	    ``filter_platform`` then surfaces blocks whose marker lists include the
> 150	    namespaced name (e.g. ``[codex-sub-agent, ...]`` or ``[codex-inline, Kilo,
> 151	    Antigravity, Devin]``).
> 152	
> 153	    Default is ``inline`` because Codex sub-agents run with ``fork_turns="none"``
> 154	    isolation and can't inherit the parent session's task context — inline
> 155	    keeps the main agent in charge so context isn't lost. Invalid / missing
> 156	    values also fall back to inline.
> 157	
> 158	    Other platforms are returned unchanged.
> 159	    """
> 160	    if platform == "codex":
> 161	        mode = "inline"
> 162	        codex_cfg = config.get("codex") if isinstance(config, dict) else None
> 163	        if isinstance(codex_cfg, dict):
> 164	            cfg_mode = codex_cfg.get("dispatch_mode")
> 165	            if cfg_mode in ("inline", "sub-agent"):
> 166	                mode = cfg_mode
> 167	        return f"codex-{mode}"
> 168	    return platform
> 169	
> 170	
> 171	def filter_platform(content: str, platform: str) -> str:
> 172	    """Keep lines outside any `[...]` block + lines inside blocks that include platform.
> 173	
> 174	    Marker lines themselves are dropped from the output.
> 175	    """
> 176	    lines = content.splitlines()
> 177	    out: list[str] = []
> 178	
> 179	    in_block = False
> 180	    keep_block = False
> 181	
> 182	    for line in lines:
> 183	        marker = _parse_marker(line)
> 184	        if marker is not None:
> 185	            is_closing, names = marker
> 186	            if not is_closing:
> 187	                in_block = True
> 188	                keep_block = _platform_matches(platform, names)
> 189	            else:
> 190	                in_block = False
> 191	                keep_block = False
> 192	            continue  # drop the marker line itself
> 193	
> 194	        if in_block:
> 195	            if keep_block:
> 196	                out.append(line)
> 197	            continue
> 198	        out.append(line)
> 199	
> 200	    # Collapse runs of 3+ blank lines that may arise from dropped markers
> 201	    collapsed: list[str] = []
> 202	    blank_run = 0
> 203	    for line in out:
> 204	        if line.strip() == "":
> 205	            blank_run += 1
> 206	            if blank_run <= 2:
> 207	                collapsed.append(line)
> 208	        else:
> 209	            blank_run = 0
> 210	            collapsed.append(line)
> 211	
> 212	    return "\n".join(collapsed).rstrip() + "\n"
> ```

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.security.UnauthenticatedException;
> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
> 9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 12	
> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 53	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 54	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 55	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 56	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 57	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 58	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 59	            throw exception;
> 60	        }
> 61	    }
> 62	
> 63	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 64	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 65	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 66	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 67	        }
> 68	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 69	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 70	            return user;
> 71	        }
> 72	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 73	    }
> 74

> 184	    private KnowledgeConflictReport retrievalConflictReport(RetrievalBundle bundle) {
> 185	        List<KnowledgeClaim> claims = new ArrayList<>();
> 186	        for (ChunkRecord chunk : bundle.requirementEvidence()) {

> 188	                    : Objects.toString(chunk.filename(), "") + ":" + chunk.parentOrder();
> 189	            String value = hasText(chunk.contentHash()) ? chunk.contentHash() : chunk.parentText();
> 190	            claims.add(new KnowledgeClaim(null, bundle.resolvedProjectId(),
> 191	                    hasText(chunk.version()) ? chunk.version() : bundle.version(), "retrieval.requirement:" + identity,
> 192	                    Objects.toString(value, ""), SourceType.REQUIREMENT, Authority.PRIMARY,
> 193	                    new KnowledgeEvidence(hasText(chunk.id()) ? chunk.id() : identity, chunk.filename(),
> 194	                            chunk.filename(), "parentOrder=" + chunk.parentOrder(),
> 195	                            excerpt(chunk.parentText(), 260)), List.of()));
> 196	        }
> 197	        for (CodeChunk chunk : bundle.codeEvidence()) {
> 198	            String identity = hasText(chunk.id()) ? chunk.id()
> 199	                    : Objects.toString(chunk.filePath(), "") + ":"
> 200	                    + Objects.toString(chunk.symbolName(), "") + ":" + chunk.startLine();
> 201	            String value = hasText(chunk.contentHash()) ? chunk.contentHash() : chunk.text();
> 202	            claims.add(new KnowledgeClaim(null, hasText(chunk.projectId()) ? chunk.projectId() : bundle.resolvedProjectId(),
> 203	                    bundle.version(), "retrieval.code:" + identity, Objects.toString(value, ""),
> 204	                    SourceType.CODE, Authority.PRIMARY,
> 205	                    new KnowledgeEvidence(identity, chunk.symbolName(), chunk.filePath(),
> 206	                            chunk.filePath() + ":" + chunk.startLine(), excerpt(chunk.text(), 260)), List.of()));
> 207	        }
> 208	        return conflictService.analyze(bundle.resolvedProjectId(), bundle.version(), claims);
> 209	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.security.UnauthenticatedException;
> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
> 9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 12	
> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 53	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 54	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 55	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 56	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 57	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 58	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 59	            throw exception;
> 60	        }
> 61	    }
> 62	
> 63	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 64	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 65	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 66	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 67	        }
> 68	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 69	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 70	            return user;
> 71	        }
> 72	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 73	    }
> 74	
> 75	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 76	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 77	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 78	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 82	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private String safe(String value) {
> 86	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 87	    }
> 88	}

> ```python
> 279	    return status
> 280	
> 281	
> 282	def build_breadcrumb(
> 283	    task_id: Optional[str],
> 284	    status: str,
> 285	    templates: dict[str, str],
> 286	    source: str | None = None,
> 287	    breadcrumb_key: str | None = None,
> 288	) -> str:
> 289	    """Build the <workflow-state>...</workflow-state> block.
> 290	
> 291	    - Known status (tag present in workflow.md) → detailed template body
> 292	    - Unknown status (no tag, or workflow.md missing) → generic
> 293	      "Refer to workflow.md for current step." line
> 294	    - `no_task` pseudo-status (task_id is None) → header omits task info
> 295	    """
> 296	    lookup_key = breadcrumb_key or status
> 297	    body = templates.get(lookup_key)
> 298	    if body is None and lookup_key != status:
> 299	        body = templates.get(status)
> 300	    if body is None:
> 301	        body = "Refer to workflow.md for current step."
> 302	    header = f"Status: {status}" if task_id is None else f"Task: {task_id} ({status})"
> 303	    return f"<workflow-state>\n{header}\n{body}\n</workflow-state>"
> 304

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;

> 7	import com.example.requirementrag.wiki.WikiModels;
> 8	import com.example.requirementrag.wiki.WikiRepository;
> 9	import org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.McpResource;
> 10	import org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext;
> 11	import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
> 12	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 13	import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
> 14	
> 15	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 16	import java.util.Map;
> 17	
> 18	/** Authenticated resource-template facade for published Wiki feature pages. */
> 19	@Component
> 20	@ConditionalOnProperty(prefix = "app.mcp", name = "enabled", havingValue = "true", matchIfMissing = true)
> 21	public class NexusMcpResources {
> 22	    private final WikiRepository wikiRepository;
> 23	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy policy;
> 25	    private final JsonMapper jsonMapper;
> 26	
> 27	    public NexusMcpResources(WikiRepository wikiRepository, ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService,
> 28	                             McpResponsePolicy policy, JsonMapper jsonMapper) {
> 29	        this.wikiRepository = wikiRepository;
> 30	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 31	        this.policy = policy;
> 32	        this.jsonMapper = jsonMapper;
> 33	    }
> 34	
> 35	    @McpResource(
> 36	            name = "nexus_wiki_feature",
> 37	            title = "NEXUS Wiki feature page",
> 38	            uri = "nexus://wiki/{projectId}/{version}/{featureId}",
> 39	            description = "Published, version-scoped feature knowledge with bounded evidence metadata.",
> 40	            mimeType = "application/json")
> 41	    public String wikiFeature(McpSyncRequestContext context, String projectId, String version, String featureId) {
> 42	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(context);
> 43	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, Permission.PUBLIC_READ);
> 44	        String effectiveProject = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, projectId);
> 45	        WikiModels.Page page = wikiRepository.getPage(effectiveProject, version, featureId);
> 46	        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 47	        result.put("projectId", effectiveProject);
> 48	        result.put("version", page.version());
> 49	        result.put("featureId", page.featureId());
> 50	        result.put("title", policy.bounded(page.title()));
> 51	        result.put("status", page.status());
> 52	        result.put("summary", policy.bounded(page.summary()));
> 53	        result.put("productRules", page.productRules().stream().limit(20).map(policy::bounded).toList());
> 54	        result.put("processSteps", page.processSteps().stream().limit(20).map(policy::bounded).toList());
> 55	        result.put("acceptanceCriteria",
> 56	                page.acceptanceCriteria().stream().limit(20).map(policy::bounded).toList());
> 57	        result.put("evidence", page.evidence().stream().limit(40).map(policy::wikiEvidence).toList());
> 58	        try {
> 59	            return jsonMapper.writeValueAsString(result);
> 60	        }
> 61	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 62	            throw new IllegalStateException("Wiki resource serialization failed");
> 63	        }
> 64	    }
> 65	
> 66	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(McpSyncRequestContext context) {
> 67	        if (context != null && context.transportContext() != null) {
> 68	            Object value = context.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 69	            if (value instanceof UserContext user) return user;
> 70	        }
> 71	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 72	    }
> 73	}

> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;

> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();

> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();

> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 178	        int end = Math.min(lines.size(), endLine == null ? Math.min(lines.size(), start + 120) : endLine);
> 179	        if (start > end) {
> 180	            start = end;

> 184	            text.append(String.format("%5d  %s%n", line, lines.get(line - 1)));
> 185	        }
> 186	        return new SourceSnippet(filePath, start, end, text.toString());

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;

> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;

> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
> 9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 12	
> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {
> 53	            String code = tool.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) + "_UNAVAILABLE";
> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 70	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 90	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) {
> 99	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 100	    }
> 101	}

你前面关注的“每个工具的契约测试”已经实现。六个 MCP 工具均覆盖了：

- 入参校验

所以 **0.6 的代码和测试已经完成**。尚未完成的是工程流程收尾：`/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/.trellis/tasks/07-29-nexus-0-6-mcp-contract-matrix/prd.md` 中的验收框没有回填，任务未归档，也还没有把相关修改从混合工作区中选择性提交。

### 0.8 的真实情况
0.8 已完成两个验收项：

1. 开发方案 P95 相对顺序执行基线下降至少 30%；
2. 覆盖率门禁已经生效，低于阈值会导致构建失败。

Python/Transformers 版 `BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3` 服务也已经接入，并通过健康检查和响应契约检查。一次“拾光”真实校准结果显示：

- Document Recall@10：0.900 → 1.000
- Code Recall@10：0.500 → 1.000
- MRR@10：0.516 → 0.863
- Mixed both-hit：0.500 → 1.000
- P50：3777 ms → 2933 ms
- P95：8617 ms → 5888 ms

但这还不能正式满足路线图验收，因为它不是严格的 **0.7 与 0.8 在相同语料、相同 profile、相同黄金集条件下的对照评测**。当前仍缺：

1. 使用真实 Python/Transformers BGE reranker，对 document、code、mixed 三个 profile 重跑统一条件的 0.7→0.8 对照；
2. 将黄金评测集扩充至至少 50 条；
3. 把 Recall@10 等指标接入 CI，指标不达标时阻断构建。

### 推荐处理顺序
1. **先闭环 0.8 评测**：固定语料、黄金集、profile、top-k、reranker 配置和运行环境，完成可复现的 0.7→0.8 对照报告。
2. **扩充 50 条以上黄金集并接入 CI 门禁**：这是当前最关键的产品验收缺口。
3. **收尾 0.6 和 0.8 的 Trellis/Git 流程**：回填 PRD、更新 Spec、归档任务，并按文件或 hunk 选择性提交。
4. **再进入 0.9 企业化建设**：容器化、SSO/RBAC、审计、配额限流和仓库管理。
5. **最后执行 1.0 GA 验收**：连续 30 天运行、团队试点和运维演练。

> 94	            trust_remote_code=True,
> 95	        )
> 96	        self._model.to(self.device)

> 102	        requested = self.config.device.strip().lower()
> 103	        if requested != "auto":

> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():

> 111	    def score(self, query: str, texts: list[str], truncate: bool) -> list[float]:
> 112	        if self._model is None or self._tokenizer is None or self._torch is None:
> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():
> 117	            for start in range(0, len(texts), self.config.batch_size):
> 118	                batch = texts[start : start + self.config.batch_size]
> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {

> 121	                    "truncation": truncate,
> 122	                    "return_tensors": "pt",
> 123	                }
> 124	                if truncate:

> 126	                inputs = self._tokenizer([query] * len(batch), batch, **tokenization)
> 127	                inputs = {name: tensor.to(self.device) for name, tensor in inputs.items()}
> 128	                logits = self._model(**inputs, return_dict=True).logits.reshape(-1).float()
> 129	                if self.config.normalize:

> 131	                scores.extend(float(value) for value in logits.cpu().tolist())
> 132	        if len(scores) != len(texts):

> 134	        return scores

> 11	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

> 13	
> 14	import java.time.Duration;
> 15	import java.time.Instant;

> 17	import java.util.Collections;
> 18	import java.util.List;
> 19	import java.util.function.Supplier;
> 20	
> 21	/**
> 22	 * RAG 流水线可观测性：阶段计时、指标上报与结构化日志。
> 23	 */
> 24	@Component
> 25	public class RagObservability {
> 26	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RagObservability.class);
> 27	    private static final int MAX_RECENT_EVENTS = 200;
> 28	    private final ObservationRegistry observationRegistry;
> 29	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 30	    private final List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents = new ArrayList<>();
> 31	
> 32	    /** 注入 Micrometer 观测与指标注册表。 */
> 33	    public RagObservability(ObservationRegistry observationRegistry, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
> 34	        this.observationRegistry = observationRegistry;
> 35	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    /** 观测带返回值的操作，记录耗时、成功/失败日志与失败计数。 */
> 39	    public <T> T observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Supplier<T> action) {
> 40	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        Observation observation = Observation.createNotStarted("rag.stage", observationRegistry)
> 42	                .contextualName("rag " + stage)
> 43	                .lowCardinalityKeyValue("rag.stage", stage)
> 44	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.id", safe(documentId))
> 45	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.version", safe(version));
> 46	        try {
> 47	            T result = observation.observe(action);
> 48	            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 49	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 50	                    .addKeyValue("status", "success").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 51	                    .log("RAG stage completed");
> 52	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "success", elapsedMillis(started), ""));
> 53	            return result;
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 56	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 57	                    .tag("exception", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 58	            log.atError().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 59	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 60	                    .addKeyValue("status", "failure").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 61	                    .log("RAG stage failed");
> 62	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "failed",
> 63	                    elapsedMillis(started), exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 64	            throw exception;
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    /** 观测无返回值的操作。 */
> 69	    public void observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Runnable action) {
> 70	        observe(stage, documentId, version, () -> { action.run(); return null; });
> 71	    }
> 72	
> 73	    /** 记录已被调用方归类的阶段结果；公开诊断只保存稳定 warning code。 */
> 74	    public void outcome(String stage, String documentId, String version, RagOutcomeStatus status,
> 75	                        long durationMs, String warningCode, RuntimeException failure) {
> 76	        String normalizedStatus = status.name().toLowerCase();
> 77	        Counter.builder("rag.stage.outcomes").tag("stage", stage).tag("status", normalizedStatus)
> 78	                .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 79	        if (warningCode != null && !warningCode.isBlank()) {
> 80	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.warnings").tag("stage", stage).tag("code", warningCode)
> 81	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 82	        }
> 83	        var event = log.atInfo();
> 84	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED) {
> 85	            event = log.atWarn();
> 86	        } else if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) {
> 87	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 88	                    .tag("exception", failure == null ? "Unknown" : failure.getClass().getSimpleName())
> 89	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 90	            event = log.atError();
> 91	            if (failure != null) {
> 92	                event.setCause(failure);
> 93	            }
> 94	        }
> 95	        event.addKeyValue("event", "rag_outcome").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 96	                .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 97	                .addKeyValue("status", normalizedStatus).addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
> 98	                .addKeyValue("warningCode", safe(warningCode)).log("RAG stage outcome");
> 99	        remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), normalizedStatus,
> 100	                durationMs, warningCode == null ? "" : warningCode));
> 101	    }
> 102	
> 103	    /** 记录某阶段处理的条目数量分布。 */
> 104	    public void items(String stage, String kind, long count) {
> 105	        DistributionSummary.builder("rag.stage.items")
> 106	                .description("Number of items entering or leaving a RAG stage")
> 107	                .tag("stage", stage).tag("kind", kind).register(meterRegistry).record(count);
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 递增业务事件计数器。 */
> 111	    public void event(String type) {
> 112	        Counter.builder("rag.events").tag("type", type).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    /** 返回最近的 RAG 阶段事件，最新在前。 */
> 116	    public synchronized List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents() {
> 117	        List<RagStageEvent> copy = new ArrayList<>(recentEvents);
> 118	        Collections.reverse(copy);
> 119	        return copy;
> 120	    }
> 121	
> 122	    /** 计算自 started 起的毫秒耗时。 */
> 123	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 124	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 125	    }
> 126	
> 127	    /** 空值或空白字符串替换为 unknown，避免指标标签缺失。 */
> 128	    private String safe(String value) {
> 129	        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? "unknown" : value;
> 130	    }
> 131	
> 132	    /** 记录最近阶段事件，保留固定窗口。 */
> 133	    private synchronized void remember(RagStageEvent event) {
> 134	        recentEvents.add(event);
> 135	        if (recentEvents.size() > MAX_RECENT_EVENTS) {
> 136	            recentEvents.remove(0);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	}

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;

> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107

> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }

> 115	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;

> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {

> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }

> 87	class VisibleTextParser(HTMLParser):
> 88	    def __init__(self) -> None:
> 89	        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
> 90	        self.hidden = 0
> 91	        self.parts: list[str] = []
> 92	
> 93	    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs) -> None:
> 94	        if tag.lower() in {"script", "style", "noscript"}:
> 95	            self.hidden += 1
> 96	        elif tag.lower() in {"p", "div", "li", "br", "tr", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"}:
> 97	            self.parts.append("\n")
> 98	
> 99	    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
> 100	        if tag.lower() in {"script", "style", "noscript"} and self.hidden:
> 101	            self.hidden -= 1
> 102	        elif tag.lower() in {"p", "div", "li", "tr", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"}:
> 103	            self.parts.append("\n")
> 104	
> 105	    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
> 106	        if not self.hidden:
> 107	            self.parts.append(data)
> 108	
> 109	    def text(self) -> str:
> 110	        lines = [normalize(line) for line in "".join(self.parts).splitlines()]
> 111	        return "\n".join(line for line in lines if line)

> 114	def workbook_rows(path: Path) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]:
> 115	    with ZipFile(path) as archive:
> 116	        shared: list[str] = []
> 117	        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in archive.namelist():
> 118	            root = ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
> 119	            for item in root.findall(MAIN_NS + "si"):
> 120	                shared.append("".join(node.text or "" for node in item.iter(MAIN_NS + "t")))
> 121	        workbook = ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
> 122	        relationships = ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
> 123	        targets = {node.attrib["Id"]: node.attrib["Target"]
> 124	                   for node in relationships.findall(PKG_REL_NS + "Relationship")}
> 125	        result: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = {}
> 126	        sheets_element = workbook.find(MAIN_NS + "sheets")
> 127	        for sheet in [] if sheets_element is None else sheets_element:
> 128	            name = sheet.attrib["name"]
> 129	            target = targets[sheet.attrib[REL_NS + "id"]].lstrip("/")
> 130	            target = target if target.startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + target
> 131	            xml = ET.fromstring(archive.read(target))
> 132	            rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []
> 133	            for row in xml.iter(MAIN_NS + "row"):
> 134	                values: dict[str, str] = {}
> 135	                for cell in row.findall(MAIN_NS + "c"):
> 136	                    match = CELL_REF.match(cell.attrib.get("r", ""))
> 137	                    if not match:
> 138	                        continue
> 139	                    kind = cell.attrib.get("t")
> 140	                    raw = cell.find(MAIN_NS + "v")
> 141	                    inline = cell.find(MAIN_NS + "is")
> 142	                    value = ""
> 143	                    if kind == "s" and raw is not None:
> 144	                        value = shared[int(raw.text or "0")]
> 145	                    elif kind == "inlineStr" and inline is not None:
> 146	                        value = "".join(node.text or "" for node in inline.iter(MAIN_NS + "t"))
> 147	                    elif raw is not None:
> 148	                        value = raw.text or ""
> 149	                    value = normalize(value)
> 150	                    if value:
> 151	                        values[match.group(1)] = value
> 152	                if values:
> 153	                    rows.append(values)
> 154	            result[name] = rows
> 155	        return result

> 21	/**
> 22	 * RAG 流水线可观测性：阶段计时、指标上报与结构化日志。
> 23	 */
> 24	@Component
> 25	public class RagObservability {
> 26	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RagObservability.class);
> 27	    private static final int MAX_RECENT_EVENTS = 200;
> 28	    private final ObservationRegistry observationRegistry;
> 29	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 30	    private final List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents = new ArrayList<>();
> 31	
> 32	    /** 注入 Micrometer 观测与指标注册表。 */
> 33	    public RagObservability(ObservationRegistry observationRegistry, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
> 34	        this.observationRegistry = observationRegistry;
> 35	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    /** 观测带返回值的操作，记录耗时、成功/失败日志与失败计数。 */
> 39	    public <T> T observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Supplier<T> action) {
> 40	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        Observation observation = Observation.createNotStarted("rag.stage", observationRegistry)
> 42	                .contextualName("rag " + stage)
> 43	                .lowCardinalityKeyValue("rag.stage", stage)
> 44	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.id", safe(documentId))
> 45	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.version", safe(version));
> 46	        try {
> 47	            T result = observation.observe(action);
> 48	            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 49	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 50	                    .addKeyValue("status", "success").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 51	                    .log("RAG stage completed");
> 52	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "success", elapsedMillis(started), ""));
> 53	            return result;
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 56	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 57	                    .tag("exception", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 58	            log.atError().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 59	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 60	                    .addKeyValue("status", "failure").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 61	                    .log("RAG stage failed");
> 62	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "failed",
> 63	                    elapsedMillis(started), exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 64	            throw exception;
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    /** 观测无返回值的操作。 */
> 69	    public void observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Runnable action) {
> 70	        observe(stage, documentId, version, () -> { action.run(); return null; });
> 71	    }
> 72	
> 73	    /** 记录已被调用方归类的阶段结果；公开诊断只保存稳定 warning code。 */
> 74	    public void outcome(String stage, String documentId, String version, RagOutcomeStatus status,
> 75	                        long durationMs, String warningCode, RuntimeException failure) {
> 76	        String normalizedStatus = status.name().toLowerCase();
> 77	        Counter.builder("rag.stage.outcomes").tag("stage", stage).tag("status", normalizedStatus)
> 78	                .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 79	        if (warningCode != null && !warningCode.isBlank()) {
> 80	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.warnings").tag("stage", stage).tag("code", warningCode)
> 81	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 82	        }
> 83	        var event = log.atInfo();
> 84	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED) {
> 85	            event = log.atWarn();
> 86	        } else if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) {
> 87	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 88	                    .tag("exception", failure == null ? "Unknown" : failure.getClass().getSimpleName())
> 89	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 90	            event = log.atError();
> 91	            if (failure != null) {
> 92	                event.setCause(failure);
> 93	            }
> 94	        }
> 95	        event.addKeyValue("event", "rag_outcome").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 96	                .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 97	                .addKeyValue("status", normalizedStatus).addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
> 98	                .addKeyValue("warningCode", safe(warningCode)).log("RAG stage outcome");
> 99	        remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), normalizedStatus,
> 100	                durationMs, warningCode == null ? "" : warningCode));
> 101	    }
> 102	
> 103	    /** 记录某阶段处理的条目数量分布。 */
> 104	    public void items(String stage, String kind, long count) {
> 105	        DistributionSummary.builder("rag.stage.items")
> 106	                .description("Number of items entering or leaving a RAG stage")
> 107	                .tag("stage", stage).tag("kind", kind).register(meterRegistry).record(count);
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 递增业务事件计数器。 */
> 111	    public void event(String type) {
> 112	        Counter.builder("rag.events").tag("type", type).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    /** 返回最近的 RAG 阶段事件，最新在前。 */
> 116	    public synchronized List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents() {
> 117	        List<RagStageEvent> copy = new ArrayList<>(recentEvents);
> 118	        Collections.reverse(copy);
> 119	        return copy;
> 120	    }
> 121	
> 122	    /** 计算自 started 起的毫秒耗时。 */
> 123	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 124	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 125	    }
> 126	
> 127	    /** 空值或空白字符串替换为 unknown，避免指标标签缺失。 */
> 128	    private String safe(String value) {
> 129	        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? "unknown" : value;
> 130	    }
> 131	
> 132	    /** 记录最近阶段事件，保留固定窗口。 */
> 133	    private synchronized void remember(RagStageEvent event) {
> 134	        recentEvents.add(event);
> 135	        if (recentEvents.size() > MAX_RECENT_EVENTS) {
> 136	            recentEvents.remove(0);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	}

> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():

> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():

> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {

> 21	/**
> 22	 * RAG 流水线可观测性：阶段计时、指标上报与结构化日志。
> 23	 */
> 24	@Component
> 25	public class RagObservability {
> 26	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RagObservability.class);
> 27	    private static final int MAX_RECENT_EVENTS = 200;
> 28	    private final ObservationRegistry observationRegistry;
> 29	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 30	    private final List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents = new ArrayList<>();
> 31	
> 32	    /** 注入 Micrometer 观测与指标注册表。 */
> 33	    public RagObservability(ObservationRegistry observationRegistry, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
> 34	        this.observationRegistry = observationRegistry;
> 35	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    /** 观测带返回值的操作，记录耗时、成功/失败日志与失败计数。 */
> 39	    public <T> T observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Supplier<T> action) {
> 40	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        Observation observation = Observation.createNotStarted("rag.stage", observationRegistry)
> 42	                .contextualName("rag " + stage)
> 43	                .lowCardinalityKeyValue("rag.stage", stage)
> 44	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.id", safe(documentId))
> 45	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.version", safe(version));
> 46	        try {
> 47	            T result = observation.observe(action);
> 48	            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 49	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 50	                    .addKeyValue("status", "success").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 51	                    .log("RAG stage completed");
> 52	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "success", elapsedMillis(started), ""));
> 53	            return result;
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 56	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 57	                    .tag("exception", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 58	            log.atError().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 59	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 60	                    .addKeyValue("status", "failure").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 61	                    .log("RAG stage failed");
> 62	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "failed",
> 63	                    elapsedMillis(started), exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 64	            throw exception;
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    /** 观测无返回值的操作。 */
> 69	    public void observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Runnable action) {
> 70	        observe(stage, documentId, version, () -> { action.run(); return null; });
> 71	    }
> 72	
> 73	    /** 记录已被调用方归类的阶段结果；公开诊断只保存稳定 warning code。 */
> 74	    public void outcome(String stage, String documentId, String version, RagOutcomeStatus status,
> 75	                        long durationMs, String warningCode, RuntimeException failure) {
> 76	        String normalizedStatus = status.name().toLowerCase();
> 77	        Counter.builder("rag.stage.outcomes").tag("stage", stage).tag("status", normalizedStatus)
> 78	                .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 79	        if (warningCode != null && !warningCode.isBlank()) {
> 80	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.warnings").tag("stage", stage).tag("code", warningCode)
> 81	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 82	        }
> 83	        var event = log.atInfo();
> 84	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED) {
> 85	            event = log.atWarn();
> 86	        } else if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) {
> 87	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 88	                    .tag("exception", failure == null ? "Unknown" : failure.getClass().getSimpleName())
> 89	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 90	            event = log.atError();
> 91	            if (failure != null) {
> 92	                event.setCause(failure);
> 93	            }
> 94	        }
> 95	        event.addKeyValue("event", "rag_outcome").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 96	                .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 97	                .addKeyValue("status", normalizedStatus).addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
> 98	                .addKeyValue("warningCode", safe(warningCode)).log("RAG stage outcome");
> 99	        remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), normalizedStatus,
> 100	                durationMs, warningCode == null ? "" : warningCode));
> 101	    }
> 102	
> 103	    /** 记录某阶段处理的条目数量分布。 */
> 104	    public void items(String stage, String kind, long count) {
> 105	        DistributionSummary.builder("rag.stage.items")
> 106	                .description("Number of items entering or leaving a RAG stage")
> 107	                .tag("stage", stage).tag("kind", kind).register(meterRegistry).record(count);
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 递增业务事件计数器。 */
> 111	    public void event(String type) {
> 112	        Counter.builder("rag.events").tag("type", type).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    /** 返回最近的 RAG 阶段事件，最新在前。 */
> 116	    public synchronized List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents() {
> 117	        List<RagStageEvent> copy = new ArrayList<>(recentEvents);
> 118	        Collections.reverse(copy);
> 119	        return copy;
> 120	    }
> 121	
> 122	    /** 计算自 started 起的毫秒耗时。 */
> 123	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 124	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 125	    }
> 126	
> 127	    /** 空值或空白字符串替换为 unknown，避免指标标签缺失。 */
> 128	    private String safe(String value) {
> 129	        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? "unknown" : value;
> 130	    }
> 131	
> 132	    /** 记录最近阶段事件，保留固定窗口。 */
> 133	    private synchronized void remember(RagStageEvent event) {
> 134	        recentEvents.add(event);
> 135	        if (recentEvents.size() > MAX_RECENT_EVENTS) {
> 136	            recentEvents.remove(0);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	}

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }
> 116	
> 117	    private record RankedIds(List<String> ids) {
> 118	    }
> 119	}

> 14	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ResilientBgeReranker.class);
> 15	
> 16	    private final BgeReranker delegate;
> 17	
> 18	    /** 包装实际重排器实现。 */
> 19	    public ResilientBgeReranker(BgeReranker delegate) {
> 20	        this.delegate = delegate;
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    /** 委托重排，失败时记录警告并按混合检索原始顺序截取 topK。 */
> 24	    @Override
> 25	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
> 27	            return List.of();
> 28	        }
> 29	        try {
> 30	            return delegate.rerank(query, candidates, topK);
> 31	        }
> 32	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 33	            log.atWarn().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "bge_rerank_fallback")
> 34	                    .log("BGE reranker unavailable, using hybrid order");
> 35	            return candidates.stream().limit(topK).toList();
> 36	        }
> 37	    }

> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }

> 18	    public static Integer firstDocumentRank(List<RetrievalEvaluationCase.GoldDocument> goldDocuments,
> 19	                                            List<ChunkRecord> candidates,
> 20	                                            int cutoff) {
> 21	        Integer best = null;
> 22	        for (RetrievalEvaluationCase.GoldDocument gold : goldDocuments) {
> 23	            StringBuilder accumulatedText = new StringBuilder();
> 24	            for (int index = 0; index < Math.min(cutoff, candidates.size()); index++) {
> 25	                ChunkRecord candidate = candidates.get(index);
> 26	                if (!sameDocumentLabel(gold, candidate)) {
> 27	                    continue;
> 28	                }
> 29	                accumulatedText.append('\n').append(candidate.parentText()).append('\n').append(candidate.childText());
> 30	                if (containsAll(accumulatedText.toString(), gold.mustContain())) {
> 31	                    int rank = index + 1;
> 32	                    best = best == null ? rank : Math.min(best, rank);
> 33	                    break;
> 34	                }
> 35	            }
> 36	        }
> 37	        return best;
> 38	    }
