> 165	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 166	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 167	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 168	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 169	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 170	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 171	        }
> 172	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 173	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 174	    }
> 175	
> 176	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {
> 177	        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(
> 178	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));
> 179	    }
> 180	
> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }
> 205	
> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }
> 225	
> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }

> 245	    private void collect(RagOutcome<?> outcome, List<RagWarning> warnings,
> 246	                         List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {

> 251	    private void recordOutcome(RagOutcome<?> outcome, String documentId, String version) {
> 252	        for (RagStageDiagnostic diagnostic : outcome.stageDiagnostics()) {
> 253	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 254	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 255	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 256	        }
> 257	    }

> 259	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.observability;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.RagOutcomeStatus;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.RagStageEvent;
> 5	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Counter;
> 6	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.DistributionSummary;
> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.observation.Observation;
> 9	import io.micrometer.observation.ObservationRegistry;
> 10	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 11	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 12	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 13	
> 14	import java.time.Duration;
> 15	import java.time.Instant;
> 16	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 17	import java.util.Collections;
> 18	import java.util.List;
> 19	import java.util.function.Supplier;
> 20	
> 21	/**
> 22	 * RAG 流水线可观测性：阶段计时、指标上报与结构化日志。
> 23	 */
> 24	@Component
> 25	public class RagObservability {
> 26	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RagObservability.class);
> 27	    private static final int MAX_RECENT_EVENTS = 200;
> 28	    private final ObservationRegistry observationRegistry;
> 29	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 30	    private final List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents = new ArrayList<>();
> 31	
> 32	    /** 注入 Micrometer 观测与指标注册表。 */
> 33	    public RagObservability(ObservationRegistry observationRegistry, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
> 34	        this.observationRegistry = observationRegistry;
> 35	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    /** 观测带返回值的操作，记录耗时、成功/失败日志与失败计数。 */
> 39	    public <T> T observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Supplier<T> action) {
> 40	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        Observation observation = Observation.createNotStarted("rag.stage", observationRegistry)
> 42	                .contextualName("rag " + stage)
> 43	                .lowCardinalityKeyValue("rag.stage", stage)
> 44	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.id", safe(documentId))
> 45	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.version", safe(version));
> 46	        try {
> 47	            T result = observation.observe(action);
> 48	            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 49	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 50	                    .addKeyValue("status", "success").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 51	                    .log("RAG stage completed");
> 52	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "success", elapsedMillis(started), ""));
> 53	            return result;
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 56	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 57	                    .tag("exception", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 58	            log.atError().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 59	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 60	                    .addKeyValue("status", "failure").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 61	                    .log("RAG stage failed");
> 62	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "failed",
> 63	                    elapsedMillis(started), exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 64	            throw exception;
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    /** 观测无返回值的操作。 */
> 69	    public void observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Runnable action) {
> 70	        observe(stage, documentId, version, () -> { action.run(); return null; });
> 71	    }
> 72	
> 73	    /** 记录已被调用方归类的阶段结果；公开诊断只保存稳定 warning code。 */
> 74	    public void outcome(String stage, String documentId, String version, RagOutcomeStatus status,
> 75	                        long durationMs, String warningCode, RuntimeException failure) {
> 76	        String normalizedStatus = status.name().toLowerCase();
> 77	        Counter.builder("rag.stage.outcomes").tag("stage", stage).tag("status", normalizedStatus)
> 78	                .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 79	        if (warningCode != null && !warningCode.isBlank()) {
> 80	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.warnings").tag("stage", stage).tag("code", warningCode)
> 81	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 82	        }
> 83	        var event = log.atInfo();
> 84	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED) {
> 85	            event = log.atWarn();
> 86	        } else if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) {
> 87	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 88	                    .tag("exception", failure == null ? "Unknown" : failure.getClass().getSimpleName())
> 89	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 90	            event = log.atError();
> 91	            if (failure != null) {
> 92	                event.setCause(failure);
> 93	            }
> 94	        }
> 95	        event.addKeyValue("event", "rag_outcome").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 96	                .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 97	                .addKeyValue("status", normalizedStatus).addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
> 98	                .addKeyValue("warningCode", safe(warningCode)).log("RAG stage outcome");
> 99	        remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), normalizedStatus,
> 100	                durationMs, warningCode == null ? "" : warningCode));
> 101	    }
> 102	
> 103	    /** 记录某阶段处理的条目数量分布。 */
> 104	    public void items(String stage, String kind, long count) {
> 105	        DistributionSummary.builder("rag.stage.items")
> 106	                .description("Number of items entering or leaving a RAG stage")
> 107	                .tag("stage", stage).tag("kind", kind).register(meterRegistry).record(count);
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 递增业务事件计数器。 */
> 111	    public void event(String type) {
> 112	        Counter.builder("rag.events").tag("type", type).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    /** 返回最近的 RAG 阶段事件，最新在前。 */
> 116	    public synchronized List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents() {
> 117	        List<RagStageEvent> copy = new ArrayList<>(recentEvents);
> 118	        Collections.reverse(copy);
> 119	        return copy;
> 120	    }
> 121	
> 122	    /** 计算自 started 起的毫秒耗时。 */
> 123	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 124	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 125	    }
> 126	
> 127	    /** 空值或空白字符串替换为 unknown，避免指标标签缺失。 */
> 128	    private String safe(String value) {
> 129	        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? "unknown" : value;
> 130	    }
> 131	
> 132	    /** 记录最近阶段事件，保留固定窗口。 */
> 133	    private synchronized void remember(RagStageEvent event) {
> 134	        recentEvents.add(event);
> 135	        if (recentEvents.size() > MAX_RECENT_EVENTS) {
> 136	            recentEvents.remove(0);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	}

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {

> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));

> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。

> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }

> 35	    public static List<RetrievalEvaluationCase> loadResource(String resourcePath) {
> 36	        InputStream input = RetrievalEvaluationDataset.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(resourcePath);
> 37	        if (input == null) {
> 38	            throw new DatasetValidationException("Evaluation resource not found: " + resourcePath);
> 39	        }
> 40	        try (Reader reader = new InputStreamReader(input, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
> 41	            return parse(reader);
> 42	        } catch (IOException exception) {
> 43	            throw new DatasetValidationException("Failed to read evaluation resource: " + resourcePath, exception);
> 44	        }
> 45	    }

> 47	    public static List<RetrievalEvaluationCase> parse(Reader reader) {
> 48	        ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
> 49	        List<RetrievalEvaluationCase> cases = new ArrayList<>();
> 50	        Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
> 51	        try (BufferedReader buffered = new BufferedReader(reader)) {
> 52	            String line;
> 53	            int lineNumber = 0;
> 54	            while ((line = buffered.readLine()) != null) {
> 55	                lineNumber++;
> 56	                if (line.isBlank()) {
> 57	                    continue;
> 58	                }
> 59	                rejectUnstableIdentifiers(line, lineNumber);
> 60	                RetrievalEvaluationCase evaluationCase;
> 61	                try {
> 62	                    evaluationCase = objectMapper.readValue(line, RetrievalEvaluationCase.class);
> 63	                } catch (Exception exception) {
> 64	                    throw invalid(lineNumber, "invalid JSON or enum value", exception);
> 65	                }
> 66	                validate(evaluationCase, lineNumber);
> 67	                if (!ids.add(evaluationCase.id())) {
> 68	                    throw invalid(lineNumber, "duplicate id: " + evaluationCase.id());
> 69	                }
> 70	                cases.add(evaluationCase);
> 71	            }
> 72	        } catch (IOException exception) {
> 73	            throw new DatasetValidationException("Failed to read evaluation JSONL", exception);
> 74	        }
> 75	        if (cases.isEmpty()) {
> 76	            throw new DatasetValidationException("Evaluation JSONL contains no cases");
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(cases);
> 79	    }

> 81	    private static void rejectUnstableIdentifiers(String line, int lineNumber) {

> 84	        }
> 85	    }

> 87	    private static void validate(RetrievalEvaluationCase value, int lineNumber) {
> 88	        if (value == null) {
> 89	            throw invalid(lineNumber, "case must be an object");

> 91	        if (isBlank(value.id()) || !ID_PATTERN.matcher(value.id()).matches()) {

> 94	        if (isBlank(value.query())) {
> 95	            throw invalid(lineNumber, "query must not be blank");

> 97	        if (value.profile() == null) {
> 98	            throw invalid(lineNumber, "profile is required");

> 100	        if (value.expectedOutcome() == null) {
> 101	            throw invalid(lineNumber, "expectedOutcome is required");
> 102	        }
> 103	        if (isBlank(value.projectId())) {
> 104	            throw invalid(lineNumber, "projectId is required");
> 105	        }
> 106	
> 107	        boolean hasGold = !value.goldDocuments().isEmpty() || !value.goldCode().isEmpty();
> 108	        if (value.expectedOutcome() == RetrievalEvaluationCase.ExpectedOutcome.HIT && !hasGold) {

> 111	        if (value.expectedOutcome() == RetrievalEvaluationCase.ExpectedOutcome.NO_RESULTS && hasGold) {

> 114	
> 115	        for (int index = 0; index < value.goldDocuments().size(); index++) {

> 120	        }

> 122	            throw invalid(lineNumber, "document Gold requires documentId and version");
> 123	        }
> 124	    }

> 34	                }

> 87	class VisibleTextParser(HTMLParser):
> 88	    def __init__(self) -> None:
> 89	        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
> 90	        self.hidden = 0
> 91	        self.parts: list[str] = []
> 92	
> 93	    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs) -> None:
> 94	        if tag.lower() in {"script", "style", "noscript"}:
> 95	            self.hidden += 1
> 96	        elif tag.lower() in {"p", "div", "li", "br", "tr", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"}:
> 97	            self.parts.append("\n")
> 98	
> 99	    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
> 100	        if tag.lower() in {"script", "style", "noscript"} and self.hidden:
> 101	            self.hidden -= 1
> 102	        elif tag.lower() in {"p", "div", "li", "tr", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"}:
> 103	            self.parts.append("\n")
> 104	
> 105	    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
> 106	        if not self.hidden:
> 107	            self.parts.append(data)
> 108	
> 109	    def text(self) -> str:
> 110	        lines = [normalize(line) for line in "".join(self.parts).splitlines()]
> 111	        return "\n".join(line for line in lines if line)

> 114	def workbook_rows(path: Path) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]]:
> 115	    with ZipFile(path) as archive:
> 116	        shared: list[str] = []
> 117	        if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in archive.namelist():
> 118	            root = ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
> 119	            for item in root.findall(MAIN_NS + "si"):
> 120	                shared.append("".join(node.text or "" for node in item.iter(MAIN_NS + "t")))
> 121	        workbook = ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
> 122	        relationships = ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
> 123	        targets = {node.attrib["Id"]: node.attrib["Target"]
> 124	                   for node in relationships.findall(PKG_REL_NS + "Relationship")}
> 125	        result: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = {}
> 126	        sheets_element = workbook.find(MAIN_NS + "sheets")
> 127	        for sheet in [] if sheets_element is None else sheets_element:
> 128	            name = sheet.attrib["name"]
> 129	            target = targets[sheet.attrib[REL_NS + "id"]].lstrip("/")
> 130	            target = target if target.startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + target
> 131	            xml = ET.fromstring(archive.read(target))
> 132	            rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []
> 133	            for row in xml.iter(MAIN_NS + "row"):
> 134	                values: dict[str, str] = {}
> 135	                for cell in row.findall(MAIN_NS + "c"):
> 136	                    match = CELL_REF.match(cell.attrib.get("r", ""))
> 137	                    if not match:
> 138	                        continue
> 139	                    kind = cell.attrib.get("t")
> 140	                    raw = cell.find(MAIN_NS + "v")
> 141	                    inline = cell.find(MAIN_NS + "is")
> 142	                    value = ""
> 143	                    if kind == "s" and raw is not None:
> 144	                        value = shared[int(raw.text or "0")]
> 145	                    elif kind == "inlineStr" and inline is not None:
> 146	                        value = "".join(node.text or "" for node in inline.iter(MAIN_NS + "t"))
> 147	                    elif raw is not None:
> 148	                        value = raw.text or ""
> 149	                    value = normalize(value)
> 150	                    if value:
> 151	                        values[match.group(1)] = value
> 152	                if values:
> 153	                    rows.append(values)
> 154	            result[name] = rows
> 155	        return result

> 171	        current_module = "未分类"
> 172	        for row in rows[1:]:
> 173	            module = normalize(row.get("A", ""))
> 174	            question = normalize(row.get("B", ""))
> 175	            answer = normalize(row.get("C", ""))
> 176	            if module:
> 177	                current_module = module
> 178	            if not question and not answer:

> 180	            parts = [f"模块：{current_module}"]

> 183	            if answer:

> 185	            text = "\n".join(parts)
> 186	            stable = normalize(current_module).lower() + "|" + normalize(question or answer).lower()
> 187	            occurrences[stable] += 1
> 188	            entry_id = "xlsx-" + digest_text(stable + f"|{occurrences[stable]}")[:24]
> 189	            entry = {

> 191	                "filename": f"{XLSX_PATH.name}#{sheet_name}",

> 196	            operation = normalize(row.get(operation_column, "")) if operation_column else ""
> 197	            if operation.upper() in REMOVE_OPERATIONS or operation in REMOVE_OPERATIONS:
> 198	                entry["operation"] = "REMOVE"
> 199	            entries.append(entry)
> 200	            order += 1
> 201	    return entries, sources

> 204	def zip_entries(path: Path, version: str, start_order: int) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:
> 205	    if version != "5.1" or not path.is_file():
> 206	        return [], []
> 207	    entries: list[dict] = []
> 208	    locations: list[str] = []
> 209	    with ZipFile(path) as archive:
> 210	        for info in archive.infolist():
> 211	            name = repaired_zip_name(info.filename.replace("\\", "/"))
> 212	            lower = name.lower()
> 213	            basename = Path(name).name.lower()
> 214	            if (not name.startswith("5.1/") or not lower.endswith(".html") or "/resources/" in lower
> 215	                    or basename == "index.html" or basename.startswith("start") or info.file_size < 800):
> 216	                continue
> 217	            raw = archive.read(info)
> 218	            parser = VisibleTextParser()
> 219	            parser.feed(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
> 220	            text = parser.text()
> 221	            if not text:
> 222	                continue
> 223	            location = name
> 224	            locations.append(location)
> 225	            stable = Path(name).stem
> 226	            entries.append({
> 227	                "entryId": "html-" + digest_text(stable)[:24],
> 228	                "filename": stable + ".html",
> 229	                "parentOrder": start_order + len(entries),
> 230	                "text": text,
> 231	                "contentHash": digest_text(text),
> 232	            })
> 233	    source = [{"path": str(path), "location": "zip-folder=5.1"}] if entries else []
> 234	    return entries, source

> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }

> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();

> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);

> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),

> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;

> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }

> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));

> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。

> 30	    public ScanResult scan(RagProperties.Code config) throws IOException {
> 31	        Path root = Path.of(config.repositoryPath()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
> 32	        String commit = git(root, List.of("rev-parse", "HEAD"), false);
> 33	        List<Path> files;

> 50	    public ScanResult scanFiles(RagProperties.Code config, String commitSha, List<String> paths) throws IOException {
> 51	        Path root = Path.of(config.repositoryPath()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
> 52	        Aggregate aggregate = new Aggregate(registry.capabilityDiagnostics());
> 53	        int scanned = 0;
> 54	        for (String path : paths) {
> 55	            String relative = normalize(path);

> 57	            Path resolved = root.resolve(relative).normalize();
> 58	            if (!resolved.startsWith(root) || !include(root, resolved, config)) continue;
> 59	            String text = git(root, List.of("show", commitSha + ":" + relative), true);
> 60	            if (text == null) continue;
> 61	            scanned++;
> 62	            parse(config, commitSha, relative, text, aggregate);
> 63	        }

> 72	    private void parse(RagProperties.Code config, String commit, String path, String text, Aggregate aggregate) {
> 73	        if (text == null || text.indexOf('\0') >= 0
> 74	                || text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > config.resolvedMaxFileBytes()) {
> 75	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 76	                    "FILE_SKIPPED", "Binary or oversized source file"));
> 77	            return;
> 78	        }
> 79	        try {
> 80	            ParsedCodeFile parsed = registry.adapter(path).orElseThrow().parse(
> 81	                    config.projectId(), commit, path, text);
> 82	            aggregate.chunks.addAll(parsed.chunks());
> 83	            aggregate.symbols.addAll(parsed.symbols());
> 84	            aggregate.calls.addAll(parsed.calls());
> 85	            aggregate.diagnostics.addAll(parsed.diagnostics());
> 86	        }
> 87	        catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError exception) {
> 88	            log.warn("Code parsing failed for {}: {}", path, exception.getMessage(), exception);
> 89	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 90	                    "PARSE_FAILED", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 91	        }
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private String git(Path root, List<String> arguments, boolean missingAllowed) throws IOException {
> 95	        List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
> 96	        command.add("git");
> 97	        command.addAll(arguments);
> 98	        Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(root.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(false).start();
> 99	        byte[] output = process.getInputStream().readAllBytes();
> 100	        byte[] error = process.getErrorStream().readAllBytes();
> 101	        try {
> 102	            int exit = process.waitFor();
> 103	            if (exit == 0) return new String(output, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).stripTrailing();
> 104	            if (missingAllowed) return null;
> 105	            log.warn("Git command failed in repository {} with exit {}: {}", root.getFileName(), exit,
> 106	                    new String(error, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).strip());
> 107	            return "";
> 108	        }
> 109	        catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 110	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 111	            throw new IOException("Git command interrupted", exception);
> 112	        }
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    private boolean include(Path root, Path file, RagProperties.Code config) {
> 116	        String relative = "/" + normalize(root.relativize(file).toString());
> 117	        if (config.excludes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains)) return false;
> 118	        return config.includes().isEmpty() || config.includes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains);
> 119	    }
> 120	
> 121	    private String normalize(String path) {
> 122	        return path.replace('\\', '/');
> 123	    }

> 133	        }

> 42	    private static int nonNegative(String value, int fallback, String name) {

> 48	    private static int positive(String value, int fallback, String name) {

> 54	    private static int integer(String value, int fallback, String name) {

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);

> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }

> 35	    public static List<RetrievalEvaluationCase> loadResource(String resourcePath) {

> 48	        ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();

> 52	            String line;

> 165	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 166	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 167	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 168	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 169	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 170	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 171	        }
> 172	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 173	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 174	    }

> 176	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {
> 177	        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(
> 178	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));
> 179	    }

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }

> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }

> 81	        try:
> 82	            import torch
> 83	            from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
> 84	        except ImportError as error:
> 85	            raise RuntimeError(

> 87	            ) from error
> 88	
> 89	        self.device = self._resolve_device(torch)
> 90	        LOGGER.info("Loading reranker model=%s device=%s", self.model_id, self.device)
> 91	        self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_id, trust_remote_code=True)
> 92	        self._model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
> 93	            self.model_id,
> 94	            trust_remote_code=True,
> 95	        )
> 96	        self._model.to(self.device)
> 97	        self._model.eval()
> 98	        self._torch = torch
> 99	        LOGGER.info("Reranker ready model=%s device=%s", self.model_id, self.device)
> 100	
> 101	    def _resolve_device(self, torch: Any) -> str:
> 102	        requested = self.config.device.strip().lower()
> 103	        if requested != "auto":
> 104	            return requested
> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
> 106	            return "mps"
> 107	        if torch.cuda.is_available():
> 108	            return "cuda"
> 109	        return "cpu"
> 110	
> 111	    def score(self, query: str, texts: list[str], truncate: bool) -> list[float]:
> 112	        if self._model is None or self._tokenizer is None or self._torch is None:
> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():
> 117	            for start in range(0, len(texts), self.config.batch_size):
> 118	                batch = texts[start : start + self.config.batch_size]
> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {
> 120	                    "padding": True,
> 121	                    "truncation": truncate,
> 122	                    "return_tensors": "pt",
> 123	                }
> 124	                if truncate:
> 125	                    tokenization["max_length"] = self.config.max_length
> 126	                inputs = self._tokenizer([query] * len(batch), batch, **tokenization)
> 127	                inputs = {name: tensor.to(self.device) for name, tensor in inputs.items()}
> 128	                logits = self._model(**inputs, return_dict=True).logits.reshape(-1).float()
> 129	                if self.config.normalize:
> 130	                    logits = self._torch.sigmoid(logits)
> 131	                scores.extend(float(value) for value in logits.cpu().tolist())
> 132	        if len(scores) != len(texts):
> 133	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker returned an unexpected score count")
> 134	        return scores

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 24	    public String resolve(HttpServletRequest request) {
> 25	        String fromQuery = request.getParameter("projectId");
> 26	        if (hasText(fromQuery)) {
> 27	            return fromQuery.trim();
> 28	        }
> 29	        if (request instanceof CachedBodyHttpServletRequest cached) {

> 31	        }
> 32	        return null;

> 45	    private String extractFromJson(byte[] body) {
> 46	        if (body == null || body.length == 0) {
> 47	            return null;
> 48	        }
> 49	        try {
> 50	            JsonNode root = objectMapper.readTree(body);
> 51	            if (root != null && root.hasNonNull("projectId")) {
> 52	                String projectId = root.get("projectId").asText();
> 53	                return hasText(projectId) ? projectId.trim() : null;
> 54	            }
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            log.warn("Unable to parse projectId from the cached JSON request body; request content is omitted",
> 58	                    exception);
> 59	            return null;
> 60	        }
> 61	        return null;
> 62	    }

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }

> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);

> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }

> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;

> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);

> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }

> 101	    private EvaluationRetrieval retrieve(RetrievalEvaluationCase evaluationCase) {
> 102	        RetrievalProfile profile = productionProfile(evaluationCase.profile());
> 103	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 104	        try {
> 105	            RagOutcome<RetrievalBundle> outcome = retrievalPipeline.execute(new RetrievalRequest(
> 106	                    evaluationCase.query(), profile, evaluationCase.projectId(),
> 107	                    evaluationCase.documentId(), evaluationCase.version(),
> 108	                    RetrievalEvaluationMatcher.DEFAULT_CUTOFF));
> 109	            long totalLatency = elapsedMillis(started);
> 110	            RetrievalBundle bundle = outcome.data() == null
> 111	                    ? emptyBundle(evaluationCase, profile)
> 112	                    : outcome.data();
> 113	            return new EvaluationRetrieval(
> 114	                    bundle,
> 115	                    stageLatency(outcome.stageDiagnostics(), false),
> 116	                    profile.usesCodeEvidence() ? stageLatency(outcome.stageDiagnostics(), true) : 0,
> 117	                    totalLatency,
> 118	                    null,
> 119	                    null,
> 120	                    outcome.warnings(),
> 121	                    outcome.stageDiagnostics());
> 122	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 123	            long latency = elapsedMillis(started);
> 124	            String error = safeError(exception);
> 125	            return new EvaluationRetrieval(
> 126	                    emptyBundle(evaluationCase, profile),
> 127	                    latency,
> 128	                    profile.usesCodeEvidence() ? latency : 0,
> 129	                    latency,
> 130	                    error,
> 131	                    profile.usesCodeEvidence() ? error : null,
> 132	                    List.of(),
> 133	                    List.of());
> 134	        }
> 135	    }

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;

> 42	        for (Path file : files) {
> 43	            String relative = normalize(root.relativize(file).toString());
> 44	            parse(config, commit, relative, Files.readString(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8), aggregate);

> 49	    @Override
> 50	    public ScanResult scanFiles(RagProperties.Code config, String commitSha, List<String> paths) throws IOException {
> 51	        Path root = Path.of(config.repositoryPath()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
> 52	        Aggregate aggregate = new Aggregate(registry.capabilityDiagnostics());
> 53	        int scanned = 0;
> 54	        for (String path : paths) {
> 55	            String relative = normalize(path);
> 56	            if (!supports(relative)) continue;
> 57	            Path resolved = root.resolve(relative).normalize();
> 58	            if (!resolved.startsWith(root) || !include(root, resolved, config)) continue;
> 59	            String text = git(root, List.of("show", commitSha + ":" + relative), true);
> 60	            if (text == null) continue;
> 61	            scanned++;
> 62	            parse(config, commitSha, relative, text, aggregate);
> 63	        }
> 64	        return aggregate.result(config.projectId(), commitSha, scanned);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    @Override
> 68	    public boolean supports(String path) {
> 69	        return registry.supports(path);
> 70	    }
> 71	
> 72	    private void parse(RagProperties.Code config, String commit, String path, String text, Aggregate aggregate) {
> 73	        if (text == null || text.indexOf('\0') >= 0
> 74	                || text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > config.resolvedMaxFileBytes()) {
> 75	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 76	                    "FILE_SKIPPED", "Binary or oversized source file"));
> 77	            return;
> 78	        }
> 79	        try {
> 80	            ParsedCodeFile parsed = registry.adapter(path).orElseThrow().parse(
> 81	                    config.projectId(), commit, path, text);
> 82	            aggregate.chunks.addAll(parsed.chunks());
> 83	            aggregate.symbols.addAll(parsed.symbols());
> 84	            aggregate.calls.addAll(parsed.calls());
> 85	            aggregate.diagnostics.addAll(parsed.diagnostics());
> 86	        }
> 87	        catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError exception) {
> 88	            log.warn("Code parsing failed for {}: {}", path, exception.getMessage(), exception);
> 89	            aggregate.diagnostics.add(new CodeScanDiagnostic(CodeLanguage.fromPath(path).id(), path,
> 90	                    "PARSE_FAILED", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 91	        }
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private String git(Path root, List<String> arguments, boolean missingAllowed) throws IOException {
> 95	        List<String> command = new ArrayList<>();
> 96	        command.add("git");
> 97	        command.addAll(arguments);
> 98	        Process process = new ProcessBuilder(command).directory(root.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(false).start();
> 99	        byte[] output = process.getInputStream().readAllBytes();
> 100	        byte[] error = process.getErrorStream().readAllBytes();
> 101	        try {
> 102	            int exit = process.waitFor();
> 103	            if (exit == 0) return new String(output, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).stripTrailing();
> 104	            if (missingAllowed) return null;
> 105	            log.warn("Git command failed in repository {} with exit {}: {}", root.getFileName(), exit,
> 106	                    new String(error, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).strip());
> 107	            return "";
> 108	        }
> 109	        catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 110	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 111	            throw new IOException("Git command interrupted", exception);
> 112	        }
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    private boolean include(Path root, Path file, RagProperties.Code config) {
> 116	        String relative = "/" + normalize(root.relativize(file).toString());
> 117	        if (config.excludes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains)) return false;
> 118	        return config.includes().isEmpty() || config.includes().stream().anyMatch(relative::contains);
> 119	    }
> 120	
> 121	    private String normalize(String path) {
> 122	        return path.replace('\\', '/');
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private static final class Aggregate {
> 126	        private final List<CodeChunk> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 127	        private final List<CodeSymbol> symbols = new ArrayList<>();
> 128	        private final List<CodeCall> calls = new ArrayList<>();
> 129	        private final List<CodeScanDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 130	
> 131	        private Aggregate(List<CodeScanDiagnostic> capabilities) {
> 132	            diagnostics.addAll(capabilities);
> 133	        }
> 134	
> 135	        private ScanResult result(String project, String commit, int files) {
> 136	            return new ScanResult(project, commit, files, chunks, symbols, calls, diagnostics);
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	}

> 71	    def __init__(self, config: RerankerConfig) -> None:
> 72	        self.config = config
> 73	        self.model_id = config.model_id
> 74	        self.device = config.device
> 75	        self._torch: Any = None
> 76	        self._tokenizer: Any = None
> 77	        self._model: Any = None
> 78	        self._inference_lock = threading.Lock()

> 80	    def load(self) -> None:
> 81	        try:
> 82	            import torch
> 83	            from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
> 84	        except ImportError as error:
> 85	            raise RuntimeError(
> 86	                "Missing reranker dependencies. Run tools/start-bge-reranker.sh to create the Python 3.11 environment."
> 87	            ) from error
> 88	
> 89	        self.device = self._resolve_device(torch)
> 90	        LOGGER.info("Loading reranker model=%s device=%s", self.model_id, self.device)
> 91	        self._tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.model_id, trust_remote_code=True)
> 92	        self._model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
> 93	            self.model_id,
> 94	            trust_remote_code=True,
> 95	        )
> 96	        self._model.to(self.device)
> 97	        self._model.eval()
> 98	        self._torch = torch
> 99	        LOGGER.info("Reranker ready model=%s device=%s", self.model_id, self.device)
> 100	
> 101	    def _resolve_device(self, torch: Any) -> str:
> 102	        requested = self.config.device.strip().lower()
> 103	        if requested != "auto":
> 104	            return requested
> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
> 106	            return "mps"
> 107	        if torch.cuda.is_available():
> 108	            return "cuda"
> 109	        return "cpu"
> 110	
> 111	    def score(self, query: str, texts: list[str], truncate: bool) -> list[float]:
> 112	        if self._model is None or self._tokenizer is None or self._torch is None:
> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():
> 117	            for start in range(0, len(texts), self.config.batch_size):
> 118	                batch = texts[start : start + self.config.batch_size]
> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {
> 120	                    "padding": True,
> 121	                    "truncation": truncate,
> 122	                    "return_tensors": "pt",
> 123	                }
> 124	                if truncate:
> 125	                    tokenization["max_length"] = self.config.max_length
> 126	                inputs = self._tokenizer([query] * len(batch), batch, **tokenization)
> 127	                inputs = {name: tensor.to(self.device) for name, tensor in inputs.items()}
> 128	                logits = self._model(**inputs, return_dict=True).logits.reshape(-1).float()
> 129	                if self.config.normalize:
> 130	                    logits = self._torch.sigmoid(logits)
> 131	                scores.extend(float(value) for value in logits.cpu().tolist())
> 132	        if len(scores) != len(texts):
> 133	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker returned an unexpected score count")
> 134	        return scores
> 135

> 53	                documentId, version, source,

> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),

> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""

> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()

> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
