> ```python
> 1	"""
> 2	JSON file I/O utilities.
> 3	
> 4	Provides read_json and write_json as the single source of truth
> 5	for JSON file operations across all Trellis scripts.
> 6	"""
> 7	
> 8	from __future__ import annotations
> 9	
> 10	import json
> 11	import os
> 12	import tempfile
> 13	from pathlib import Path
> 14	
> 15	
> 16	def read_json(path: Path) -> dict | None:
> 17	    """Read and parse a JSON file.
> 18	
> 19	    Returns None if the file doesn't exist, is invalid JSON, or can't be read.
> 20	    """
> 21	    try:
> 22	        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
> 23	    except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
> 24	        return None
> 25	
> 26	
> 27	def write_json(path: Path, data: dict) -> bool:
> 28	    """Write dict to JSON file with pretty formatting.
> 29	
> 30	    The write is atomic: content goes to a temp file in the same directory
> 31	    and is then renamed over the target. A crash or Ctrl-C mid-write leaves
> 32	    the existing file intact rather than truncated, so a corrupted task.json
> 33	    can never make a task silently vanish from `task.py list`.
> 34	
> 35	    Returns True on success, False on error.
> 36	    """
> 37	    payload = json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
> 38	    try:
> 39	        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
> 40	            dir=str(path.parent), prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp"
> 41	        )
> 42	        try:
> 43	            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
> 44	                f.write(payload)
> 45	            os.replace(tmp, path)
> 46	        except BaseException:
> 47	            try:
> 48	                os.unlink(tmp)

> ```python
> 1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
> 2	"""Generate a versioned, vector-free manifest for code and requirement sources."""
> 3	from __future__ import annotations
> 4	
> 5	import argparse
> 6	import hashlib
> 7	import json
> 8	import subprocess
> 9	from pathlib import Path
> 10	from typing import Iterable
> 11	
> 12	
> 13	def run(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
> 14	    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=repo, text=True).strip()
> 15	
> 16	
> 17	def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
> 18	    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
> 19	
> 20	
> 21	def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
> 22	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
> 23	    with path.open("rb") as stream:
> 24	        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
> 25	            digest.update(block)
> 26	    return digest.hexdigest()
> 27	
> 28	
> 29	def changed_files(repo: Path, base: str, commit: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
> 30	    output = run(repo, "diff", "--name-status", "-M", base, commit)
> 31	    result: list[dict[str, object]] = []
> 32	    for line in output.splitlines():
> 33	        fields = line.split("\t")
> 34	        if len(fields) < 2:
> 35	            continue
> 36	        status = fields[0]
> 37	        path = fields[-1].replace("\\", "/")
> 38	        if not path.endswith(".java"):
> 39	            continue
> 40	        entry: dict[str, object] = {"status": status, "path": path}
> 41	        if status.startswith("R") and len(fields) == 3:
> 42	            entry["previousPath"] = fields[1].replace("\\", "/")
> 43	        if status[0] != "D":
> 44	            try:
> 45	                content = subprocess.check_output(
> 46	                    ["git", "show", f"{commit}:{path}"], cwd=repo
> 47	                )
> 48	                entry["contentHash"] = sha256_bytes(content)
> 49	                entry["bytes"] = len(content)
> 50	            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
> 51	                entry["contentHash"] = None
> 52	        result.append(entry)
> 53	    return sorted(result, key=lambda item: str(item["path"]))
> 54	
> 55	
> 56	def requirement_files(root: Path, paths: Iterable[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
> 57	    result = []
> 58	    for raw in paths:
> 59	        path = Path(raw).expanduser().resolve()
> 60	        if not path.is_file():
> 61	            raise SystemExit(f"requirement source does not exist: {path}")
> 62	        try:
> 63	            display_path = str(path.relative_to(root))
> 64	        except ValueError:
> 65	            display_path = str(path)
> 66	        result.append({
> 67	            "path": display_path,
> 68	            "contentHash": sha256_file(path),
> 69	            "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
> 70	        })
> 71	    return result
> 72

> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }

> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141	
> 142	    private record NodeDepth(CodeSymbol symbol, int depth) {
> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }
> 148	}

> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.code.CodeRelation.Resolution;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.model.CodeIntelligenceResponse;
> 6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 7	
> 8	import java.util.ArrayDeque;
> 9	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 10	import java.util.HashSet;
> 11	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	import java.util.Set;
> 15	
> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;
> 22	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 23	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 24	
> 25	    public CodeIntelligenceService(SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store, RagProperties properties,
> 26	                                   GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 27	        this.store = store;
> 28	        this.properties = properties;
> 29	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 30	    }
> 31	
> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141	
> 142	    private record NodeDepth(CodeSymbol symbol, int depth) {
> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }
> 148	}
> ```

> 156	def build_handler(

> 162	) -> type[BaseHTTPRequestHandler]:
> 163	    class RerankerHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
> 164	        server_version = "NexusBgeReranker/1.0"
> 165	
> 166	        def do_GET(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - BaseHTTPRequestHandler API
> 167	            if urlsplit(self.path).path != "/health":
> 168	                self._write_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
> 169	                return
> 170	            self._write_json(
> 171	                200,
> 172	                {
> 173	                    "status": "UP",
> 174	                    "model": reranker.model_id,
> 175	                    "device": reranker.device,
> 176	                },
> 177	            )
> 178	
> 179	        def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - BaseHTTPRequestHandler API
> 180	            if urlsplit(self.path).path != "/rerank":
> 181	                self._write_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
> 182	                return
> 183	            if api_key and not self._authorized(api_key):
> 184	                self._write_json(401, {"error": "unauthorized"})
> 185	                return
> 186	            try:
> 187	                payload = self._read_json(max_request_bytes)
> 188	                query, texts, truncate = validate_request(payload, max_texts)
> 189	                scores = reranker.score(query, texts, truncate)
> 190	                response = [{"index": index, "score": score} for index, score in enumerate(scores)]
> 191	                self._write_json(200, response)
> 192	            except RequestTooLargeError as error:
> 193	                self._write_json(413, {"error": str(error)})
> 194	            except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
> 195	                self._write_json(400, {"error": str(error)})
> 196	            except Exception as error:  # keep model/runtime details out of HTTP responses
> 197	                LOGGER.exception("Rerank request failed exceptionType=%s", type(error).__name__)
> 198	                self._write_json(500, {"error": "rerank failed"})
> 199	
> 200	        def _authorized(self, expected: str) -> bool:

> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */

> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";

> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {

> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }

> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }

> 15	def request(path: str, body: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:

> 17	    data = None
> 18	    if body is not None:
> 19	        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"

> 21	    if API_KEY:

> 13	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

> 15	import java.time.Duration;

> 23	
> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }
> 116	
> 117	    private record RankedIds(List<String> ids) {
> 118	    }
> 119	}

> 29	def changed_files(repo: Path, base: str, commit: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:

> 31	    result: list[dict[str, object]] = []
> 32	    for line in output.splitlines():
> 33	        fields = line.split("\t")
> 34	        if len(fields) < 2:
> 35	            continue
> 36	        status = fields[0]
> 37	        path = fields[-1].replace("\\", "/")
> 38	        if not path.endswith(".java"):
> 39	            continue
> 40	        entry: dict[str, object] = {"status": status, "path": path}
> 41	        if status.startswith("R") and len(fields) == 3:
> 42	            entry["previousPath"] = fields[1].replace("\\", "/")
> 43	        if status[0] != "D":
> 44	            try:
> 45	                content = subprocess.check_output(
> 46	                    ["git", "show", f"{commit}:{path}"], cwd=repo
> 47	                )
> 48	                entry["contentHash"] = sha256_bytes(content)
> 49	                entry["bytes"] = len(content)
> 50	            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
> 51	                entry["contentHash"] = None
> 52	        result.append(entry)
> 53	    return sorted(result, key=lambda item: str(item["path"]))
> 54	
> 55	
> 56	def requirement_files(root: Path, paths: Iterable[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
> 57	    result = []
> 58	    for raw in paths:

> 60	        if not path.is_file():
> 61	            raise SystemExit(f"requirement source does not exist: {path}")
> 62	        try:
> 63	            display_path = str(path.relative_to(root))
> 64	        except ValueError:
> 65	            display_path = str(path)
> 66	        result.append({
> 67	            "path": display_path,
> 68	            "contentHash": sha256_file(path),
> 69	            "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
> 70	        })
> 71	    return result

> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {
> 53	            String code = tool.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) + "_UNAVAILABLE";
> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 70	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 90	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) {
> 99	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 100	    }
> 101	}

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.rerank;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.ChunkRecord;
> 5	import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference;
> 6	import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
> 7	import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
> 8	import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient;
> 9	
> 10	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 11	import java.util.Comparator;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	
> 15	/**
> 16	 * 通过 HTTP 调用 BGE 重排 API 的实现。
> 17	 */
> 18	public class HttpBgeReranker implements BgeReranker {
> 19	
> 20	    private final RestClient client;
> 21	    private final RagProperties.Bge properties;
> 22	
> 23	    /** 注入 REST 客户端与 BGE 服务配置。 */
> 24	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties) {
> 25	        this.client = client;
> 26	        this.properties = properties;
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 30	    @Override
> 31	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 32	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 33	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 34	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 35	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 36	        }
> 37	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.body(Map.of(
> 38	                        "query", query,
> 39	                        "texts", candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(),
> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 42	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 43	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 44	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 45	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */
> 53	    private record Scored(ChunkRecord chunk, double score) {
> 54	    }
> 55	}

> 19	    public ResilientBgeReranker(BgeReranker delegate) {
> 20	        this.delegate = delegate;

> 22	
> 23	    /** 委托重排，失败时记录警告并按混合检索原始顺序截取 topK。 */

> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
> 27	            return List.of();
> 28	        }
> 29	        try {
> 30	            return delegate.rerank(query, candidates, topK);
> 31	        }
> 32	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 33	            log.atWarn().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "bge_rerank_fallback")
> 34	                    .log("BGE reranker unavailable, using hybrid order");
> 35	            return candidates.stream().limit(topK).toList();
> 36	        }

> 165	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 166	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 167	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 168	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 169	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 170	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 171	        }
> 172	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 173	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 174	    }
> 175	
> 176	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {
> 177	        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(
> 178	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));
> 179	    }
> 180	
> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }
> 205	
> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }
> 225	
> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }
> 235	
> 236	    private String requirementKey(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 237	        return hasText(chunk.parentId()) ? chunk.parentId() : chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder();
> 238	    }
> 239	
> 240	    private String codeKey(CodeChunk chunk) {
> 241	        return hasText(chunk.id()) ? chunk.id()
> 242	                : chunk.filePath() + ':' + chunk.symbolName() + ':' + chunk.startLine();
> 243	    }
> 244	
> 245	    private void collect(RagOutcome<?> outcome, List<RagWarning> warnings,
> 246	                         List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 247	        warnings.addAll(outcome.warnings());
> 248	        diagnostics.addAll(outcome.stageDiagnostics());
> 249	    }
> 250	
> 251	    private void recordOutcome(RagOutcome<?> outcome, String documentId, String version) {
> 252	        for (RagStageDiagnostic diagnostic : outcome.stageDiagnostics()) {
> 253	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 254	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 255	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 256	        }
> 257	    }
> 258	
> 259	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 260	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 261	    }
> 262	
> 263	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 264	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 265	    }
> 266	}

> 40	                        "truncate", true))
> 41	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});

> 46	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 47	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 48	        }
> 49	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();

> 126	def metric_change(before: float | int, after: float | int) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 127	    absolute = after - before
> 128	    relative = None if before == 0 else absolute / before
> 129	    return {"baseline": before, "rerank": after, "absolute": absolute, "relative": relative}

> 132	def non_regression_check(
> 133	    name: str,
> 134	    baseline: dict[str, Any],
> 135	    rerank: dict[str, Any],
> 136	    metric: str,
> 137	) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 138	    before = float(baseline.get(metric, 0))
> 139	    after = float(rerank.get(metric, 0))
> 140	    return {
> 141	        "name": name,
> 142	        "passed": after + 1e-12 >= before,
> 143	        "detail": f"{before:.6f} -> {after:.6f}",
> 144	    }

> 178	def source_state(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 179	    commit = command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=root)
> 180	    status = command("git", "status", "--porcelain", cwd=root)
> 181	    relevant = [
> 182	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationIT.java",
> 183	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationMatcher.java",
> 184	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationReport.java",

> 187	        root / "scripts/run-shiguang-eval.sh",
> 188	        root / "tools/retrieval-eval-comparison.py",
> 189	    ]
> 190	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
> 191	    file_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
> 192	    for path in relevant:
> 193	        data = path.read_bytes()
> 194	        relative = str(path.relative_to(root))

> 196	        digest.update(relative.encode("utf-8"))

> 198	        digest.update(data)
> 199	    return {
> 200	        "gitCommit": commit,
> 201	        "workingTreeDirty": bool(status),
> 202	        "evaluationSourceSha256": digest.hexdigest(),
> 203	        "files": file_hashes,
> 204	    }

> 101	def report_contract(report: dict[str, Any], mode: str, repetitions: int) -> list[str]:

> 126	def metric_change(before: float | int, after: float | int) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 127	    absolute = after - before
> 128	    relative = None if before == 0 else absolute / before
> 129	    return {"baseline": before, "rerank": after, "absolute": absolute, "relative": relative}

> 178	def source_state(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 179	    commit = command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=root)
> 180	    status = command("git", "status", "--porcelain", cwd=root)
> 181	    relevant = [
> 182	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationIT.java",
> 183	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationMatcher.java",
> 184	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationReport.java",
> 185	        root / "src/test/java/com/example/requirementrag/evaluation/RetrievalEvaluationSettings.java",
> 186	        root / "src/test/resources/evaluation/retrieval-eval-shiguang-v1.jsonl",
> 187	        root / "scripts/run-shiguang-eval.sh",
> 188	        root / "tools/retrieval-eval-comparison.py",
> 189	    ]
> 190	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
> 191	    file_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
> 192	    for path in relevant:
> 193	        data = path.read_bytes()
> 194	        relative = str(path.relative_to(root))
> 195	        file_hashes[relative] = sha256_bytes(data)
> 196	        digest.update(relative.encode("utf-8"))
> 197	        digest.update(b"\0")
> 198	        digest.update(data)
> 199	    return {
> 200	        "gitCommit": commit,
> 201	        "workingTreeDirty": bool(status),
> 202	        "evaluationSourceSha256": digest.hexdigest(),
> 203	        "files": file_hashes,
> 204	    }

> 23	    public boolean enabled() {

> 27	    public UserContext authenticate(String apiKey) {
> 28	        if (!properties.enabled()) {
> 29	            return UserContext.defaultAdmin();
> 30	        }
> 31	        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isBlank()) {
> 32	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 33	        }
> 34	        String candidate = apiKey.trim();
> 35	        for (AuthProperties.AuthUser configured : properties.users()) {
> 36	            if (constantTimeEquals(candidate, configured.apiKey())) {

> 38	            }
> 39	        }
> 40	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    private boolean constantTimeEquals(String left, String right) {
> 44	        if (left == null || right == null) {
> 45	            return false;
> 46	        }
> 47	        return MessageDigest.isEqual(
> 48	                left.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
> 49	                right.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
> 50	    }

> 181	                self._write_json(404, {"error": "not found"})
> 182	                return
> 183	            if api_key and not self._authorized(api_key):

> 201	            authorization = self.headers.get("Authorization", "")
> 202	            prefix = "Bearer "
> 203	            return authorization.startswith(prefix) and hmac.compare_digest(
> 204	                authorization[len(prefix) :], expected

> 207	        def _read_json(self, limit: int) -> Any:

> 209	            if raw_length is None:
> 210	                raise ValueError("Content-Length is required")
> 211	            try:
> 212	                length = int(raw_length)
> 213	            except ValueError as error:
> 214	                raise ValueError("invalid Content-Length") from error
> 215	            if length < 0 or length > limit:
> 216	                raise RequestTooLargeError(f"request body exceeds {limit} bytes")

> 219	        def _write_json(self, status: int, payload: Any) -> None:

> 222	            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
> 223	            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
> 224	            self.end_headers()
> 225	            self.wfile.write(body)

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.code;

> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.code.CodeRelation.Resolution;

> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.model.CodeIntelligenceResponse;
> 6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 7	
> 8	import java.util.ArrayDeque;
> 9	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 10	import java.util.HashSet;
> 11	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 12	import java.util.List;
> 13	import java.util.Map;
> 14	import java.util.Set;
> 15	
> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;
> 22	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 23	    private final GitDiffService gitDiffService;
> 24	
> 25	    public CodeIntelligenceService(SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store, RagProperties properties,
> 26	                                   GitDiffService gitDiffService) {
> 27	        this.store = store;
> 28	        this.properties = properties;
> 29	        this.gitDiffService = gitDiffService;
> 30	    }
> 31	
> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 46	        return graph(projectId, symbol, "inbound", depth, limit);
> 47	    }
> 48	
> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());
> 72	    }
> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }
> 124	
> 125	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse unavailable(String project, List<String> changed, String warning) {
> 126	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("NOT_AVAILABLE", project, null, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(),
> 127	                List.of(), List.of(), changed, List.of(), List.of(warning), false);
> 128	    }
> 129	
> 130	    private String resolveProject(String projectId) {
> 131	        return projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 132	    }
> 133	
> 134	    private int boundDepth(Integer depth) {
> 135	        return Math.min(Math.max(depth == null ? 2 : depth, 1), MAX_DEPTH);
> 136	    }
> 137	
> 138	    private int boundLimit(Integer limit) {
> 139	        return Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 50 : limit, 1), MAX_LIMIT);
> 140	    }
> 141

> 143	    }
> 144	
> 145	    private record Traversal(List<CodeSymbol> certain, List<CodeSymbol> inferred,
> 146	                             List<CodeRelation> relations, List<CodeRelation> unresolved, boolean truncated) {
> 147	    }
> 148	}

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 101	    def _resolve_device(self, torch: Any) -> str:
> 102	        requested = self.config.device.strip().lower()
> 103	        if requested != "auto":
> 104	            return requested
> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():

> 111	    def score(self, query: str, texts: list[str], truncate: bool) -> list[float]:
> 112	        if self._model is None or self._tokenizer is None or self._torch is None:
> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():
> 117	            for start in range(0, len(texts), self.config.batch_size):
> 118	                batch = texts[start : start + self.config.batch_size]
> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {
> 120	                    "padding": True,
> 121	                    "truncation": truncate,
> 122	                    "return_tensors": "pt",
> 123	                }
> 124	                if truncate:
> 125	                    tokenization["max_length"] = self.config.max_length
> 126	                inputs = self._tokenizer([query] * len(batch), batch, **tokenization)
> 127	                inputs = {name: tensor.to(self.device) for name, tensor in inputs.items()}
> 128	                logits = self._model(**inputs, return_dict=True).logits.reshape(-1).float()
> 129	                if self.config.normalize:
> 130	                    logits = self._torch.sigmoid(logits)
> 131	                scores.extend(float(value) for value in logits.cpu().tolist())
> 132	        if len(scores) != len(texts):
> 133	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker returned an unexpected score count")
> 134	        return scores

> 144	        raise ValueError("query must be a non-empty string")

> 149	    if not all(isinstance(text, str) and text.strip() for text in texts):
> 150	        raise ValueError("every texts entry must be a non-empty string")
> 151	    if not isinstance(truncate, bool):

> 153	    return query, texts, truncate

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {

> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }

> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);

> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {

> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
