> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }
> 87

> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {

> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }

> 100	    }

> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
> 27	            return List.of();

> 34	                    .log("BGE reranker unavailable, using hybrid order");
> 35	            return candidates.stream().limit(topK).toList();
> 36	        }

> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,

> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());

> 17	    private final RagProperties properties;

> 20	    public ProjectRegistry(RagProperties properties) {
> 21	        this.properties = properties;
> 22	        this.projectMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 23	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : properties.projects()) {
> 24	            if (project.id() == null || project.id().isBlank()) {
> 25	                continue;
> 26	            }
> 27	            projectMap.put(project.id(), project);
> 28	        }
> 29	        if (projectMap.isEmpty()) {
> 30	            RagProperties.ProjectConfig fallback = buildFallbackProject();
> 31	            projectMap.put(fallback.id(), fallback);
> 32	        }
> 33	    }

> 36	        if (projectId == null || projectId.isBlank()) {
> 37	            return Optional.of(defaultProject());
> 38	        }
> 39	        return Optional.ofNullable(projectMap.get(projectId));
> 40	    }

> 77	    public Optional<String> resolveProjectIdByGitPath(String pathWithNamespace) {
> 78	        if (pathWithNamespace == null || pathWithNamespace.isBlank()) {
> 79	            return Optional.empty();
> 80	        }
> 81	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : projectMap.values()) {
> 82	            if (pathWithNamespace.equals(project.gitPath())) {
> 83	                return Optional.of(project.id());
> 84	            }
> 85	        }
> 86	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : projectMap.values()) {
> 87	            if (pathWithNamespace.equals(project.id())) {
> 88	                return Optional.of(project.id());
> 89	            }
> 90	        }
> 91	        String repoName = pathWithNamespace.contains("/")
> 92	                ? pathWithNamespace.substring(pathWithNamespace.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)
> 93	                : pathWithNamespace;
> 94	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : projectMap.values()) {
> 95	            if (repoName.equals(project.id())) {
> 96	                return Optional.of(project.id());
> 97	            }
> 98	        }
> 99	        return Optional.empty();

> 157	                            "sparse", Map.of("indices", sparse.indices(), "values", sparse.values())),

> 192	    private static String retrievalMetadata(CodeChunk chunk) {

> 195	        String symbolName = safeText(chunk.symbolName());

> 203	    /**
> 204	     * 在有限 RRF 候选池内做确定性结构重排。原始名次仍是主信号，仅对明确的符号词和代码角色意图加分。
> 205	     */
> 206	    static List<CodeChunk> rerankCandidates(String query, List<CodeChunk> candidates, int limit) {
> 207	        if (candidates.isEmpty() || limit <= 0) {
> 208	            return List.of();
> 209	        }
> 210	        List<RankedCodeChunk> ranked = new ArrayList<>(candidates.size());
> 211	        for (int index = 0; index < candidates.size(); index++) {
> 212	            CodeChunk chunk = candidates.get(index);
> 213	            ranked.add(new RankedCodeChunk(chunk, index, candidateScore(query, chunk, index, candidates.size())));
> 214	        }
> 215	        return ranked.stream()
> 216	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(RankedCodeChunk::score).reversed()
> 217	                        .thenComparingInt(RankedCodeChunk::originalRank))
> 218	                .limit(Math.min(limit, ranked.size()))
> 219	                .map(RankedCodeChunk::chunk)
> 220	                .toList();
> 221	    }

> 223	    private static double candidateScore(String query, CodeChunk chunk, int index, int candidateCount) {
> 224	        String normalizedQuery = safeText(query).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 225	        String normalizedSymbol = safeText(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 226	        String symbolTerms = splitIdentifier(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 227	        String path = safeText(chunk.filePath()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 228	        double score = 1.0 - (0.30 * index / Math.max(candidateCount - 1.0, 1.0));
> 229	
> 230	        if (!normalizedSymbol.isBlank() && compact(normalizedQuery).contains(compact(normalizedSymbol))) {
> 231	            score += 0.50;
> 232	        }
> 233	        int matchedTerms = 0;
> 234	        for (String term : symbolTerms.split("\\s+")) {
> 235	            if (term.length() >= 3 && normalizedQuery.contains(term)) {
> 236	                matchedTerms++;
> 237	            }
> 238	        }
> 239	        score += Math.min(matchedTerms * 0.12, 0.36);
> 240	
> 241	        boolean serviceImplementation = path.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedSymbol.endsWith("impl");
> 242	        boolean controller = path.contains("/controller/");
> 243	        boolean test = path.contains("/src/test/") || path.contains("/test/");
> 244	        if (asksForServiceImplementation(normalizedQuery)) {
> 245	            if (serviceImplementation) {
> 246	                score += 0.42;
> 247	            }
> 248	            else if (controller) {
> 249	                score -= 0.08;
> 250	            }
> 251	        }
> 252	        else if (asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery) && serviceImplementation) {
> 253	            score += 0.24;
> 254	        }
> 255	        if (asksForController(normalizedQuery) && controller) {
> 256	            score += 0.35;
> 257	        }
> 258	        if (asksForTest(normalizedQuery)) {
> 259	            score += test ? 0.35 : 0.0;
> 260	        }
> 261	        else if (test) {
> 262	            score -= 0.12;
> 263	        }
> 264	        if ("method".equalsIgnoreCase(chunk.symbolType()) && asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery)) {
> 265	            score += 0.04;
> 266	        }
> 267	        return score;
> 268	    }

> 270	    private static boolean asksForServiceImplementation(String query) {

> 272	                "implementation entry", "business logic");

> 305	    private static String codeRole(String filePath, String symbolType, String symbolName) {

> 27	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:

> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {
> 53	            String code = tool.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) + "_UNAVAILABLE";
> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 70	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 90	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) {
> 99	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 100	    }
> 101	}

> 123	    private WikiDiff compareWiki(String project, VersionManifest from, VersionManifest to, List<RagWarning> warnings) {
> 124	        String beforeVersion = hasText(from.wikiVersion()) ? from.wikiVersion() : from.version();
> 125	        String afterVersion = hasText(to.wikiVersion()) ? to.wikiVersion() : to.version();
> 126	        try {
> 127	            Optional<VersionIndex> before = wikiRepository.findIndex(project, beforeVersion);
> 128	            Optional<VersionIndex> after = wikiRepository.findIndex(project, afterVersion);
> 129	            if (before.isEmpty() || after.isEmpty()) {
> 130	                warnings.add(warning("version.wiki", "WIKI_VERSION_MISSING", "Wiki 版本不完整，未执行 Wiki 差异分析"));
> 131	                return WikiDiff.unavailable();
> 132	            }
> 133	            return wikiChanges(before.get(), after.get());
> 134	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 135	            warnings.add(warning("version.wiki", "WIKI_DIFF_UNAVAILABLE", "Wiki 差异暂不可用"));
> 136	            return WikiDiff.unavailable();
> 137	        }
> 138	    }
> 139	
> 140	    private WikiDiff wikiChanges(VersionIndex before, VersionIndex after) {
> 141	        Map<String, PageSummary> oldPages = pages(before.pages());
> 142	        Map<String, PageSummary> newPages = pages(after.pages());
> 143	        List<WikiPageChange> changes = new ArrayList<>();
> 144	        for (PageSummary current : newPages.values()) {
> 145	            PageSummary baseline = oldPages.get(current.featureId());
> 146	            if (baseline == null) {
> 147	                changes.add(new WikiPageChange(ChangeType.ADDED, current.featureId(), current.title(), null,
> 148	                        current.status(), current.evidenceCount(), true));
> 149	            } else {
> 150	                boolean summaryChanged = !safe(baseline.summary()).equals(safe(current.summary()));
> 151	                int evidenceDelta = current.evidenceCount() - baseline.evidenceCount();
> 152	                if (baseline.status() != current.status() || summaryChanged || evidenceDelta != 0) {
> 153	                    changes.add(new WikiPageChange(ChangeType.MODIFIED, current.featureId(), current.title(),
> 154	                            baseline.status(), current.status(), evidenceDelta, summaryChanged));
> 155	                }
> 156	            }
> 157	        }
> 158	        for (PageSummary baseline : oldPages.values()) {
> 159	            if (!newPages.containsKey(baseline.featureId())) {
> 160	                changes.add(new WikiPageChange(ChangeType.REMOVED, baseline.featureId(), baseline.title(),
> 161	                        baseline.status(), null, -baseline.evidenceCount(), true));
> 162	            }
> 163	        }
> 164	        changes.sort(Comparator.comparing(WikiPageChange::featureId));
> 165	        return new WikiDiff(Availability.AVAILABLE, count(changes, ChangeType.ADDED),
> 166	                count(changes, ChangeType.MODIFIED), count(changes, ChangeType.REMOVED), changes);
> 167	    }
> 168	
> 169	    private Map<String, TestCaseSnapshot> cases(List<TestCaseSnapshot> values) {
> 170	        Map<String, TestCaseSnapshot> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 171	        for (TestCaseSnapshot value : values) result.putIfAbsent(value.caseId(), value);
> 172	        return result;
> 173	    }
> 174	
> 175	    private Map<String, PageSummary> pages(List<PageSummary> values) {
> 176	        Map<String, PageSummary> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 177	        for (PageSummary value : values == null ? List.<PageSummary>of() : values) result.putIfAbsent(value.featureId(), value);
> 178	        return result;
> 179	    }
> 180	
> 181	    private int count(List<WikiPageChange> changes, ChangeType type) {
> 182	        return (int) changes.stream().filter(change -> change.type() == type).count();
> 183	    }
> 184	
> 185	    private RagWarning warning(String stage, String code, String message) {
> 186	        return new RagWarning(stage, code, message, 0);
> 187	    }
> 188	
> 189	    private boolean hasText(String value) { return value != null && !value.isBlank(); }
> 190	    private String safe(String value) { return value == null ? "" : value; }
> 191	}

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);

> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }

> 34	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 35	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 36	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 37	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 38	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 39	        }
> 40	        byte[] requestBody;
> 41	        try {
> 42	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 43	                    query, candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(), true));
> 44	        }
> 45	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 46	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 47	        }
> 48	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 49	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 50	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 51	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 53	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 54	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 55	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 56	        }
> 57	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 58	    }

> 35	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();

> 43	                    query, candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(), true));
> 44	        }
> 45	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 46	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 47	        }
> 48	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 49	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 50	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 51	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 53	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 54	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 55	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 56	        }
> 57	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.security.UnauthenticatedException;
> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
> 9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 12	
> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {
> 53	            String code = tool.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) + "_UNAVAILABLE";
> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 70	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 90	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) {
> 99	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 100	    }
> 101	}

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */

> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {
> 53	            String code = tool.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) + "_UNAVAILABLE";
> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 70	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }

> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {

> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }

> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 90	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }

> 43	    @Override

> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {

> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);

> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();

> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);

> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}
> ```

> 35	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 36	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);

> 38	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 39	        }

> 41	        try {

> 43	                    query, candidates.stream().map(ChunkRecord::childText).toList(), true));
> 44	        }
> 45	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 46	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 47	        }
> 48	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 49	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 50	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 51	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 53	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 54	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 55	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 56	        }
> 57	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 58	    }

> 26	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) {

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";

> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;

> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {

> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);

> 292	    private long measureP95(int warmupRuns, int repetitions, ThrowingRunnable action) throws Exception {
> 293	        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < warmupRuns; iteration++) {
> 294	            action.run();
> 295	        }
> 296	        List<Long> samples = new ArrayList<>();
> 297	        for (int iteration = 0; iteration < repetitions; iteration++) {
> 298	            long begin = System.nanoTime();
> 299	            action.run();
> 300	            samples.add(Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - begin).toMillis());
> 301	        }
> 302	        samples.sort(Long::compareTo);
> 303	        return samples.get((int) Math.ceil(samples.size() * 0.95) - 1);
> 304	    }

> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(

> 92	    }

> 8	import io.modelcontextprotocol.server.transport.ServerTransportSecurityException;
> 9	import io.modelcontextprotocol.server.transport.ServerTransportSecurityValidator;
> 10	import org.springframework.ai.mcp.server.common.autoconfigure.properties.McpServerStreamableHttpProperties;
> 11	import org.springframework.ai.mcp.server.webmvc.transport.WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider;
> 12	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
> 13	import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
> 14	import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties;
> 15	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
> 16	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
> 17	import org.springframework.web.servlet.function.ServerRequest;
> 18	import tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper;
> 19	
> 20	import java.util.List;
> 21	import java.util.Map;
> 22	
> 23	/** Secures Streamable HTTP and makes the authenticated user available to tools. */
> 24	@Configuration
> 25	@EnableConfigurationProperties(McpProperties.class)
> 26	@ConditionalOnProperty(prefix = "app.mcp", name = "enabled", havingValue = "true", matchIfMissing = true)
> 27	public class McpTransportConfiguration {
> 28	
> 29	    public static final String USER_CONTEXT_KEY = "nexus.user";
> 30	    private static final String LOWERCASE_API_KEY_HEADER = "x-api-key";
> 31	
> 32	    @Bean
> 33	    WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider nexusMcpTransportProvider(
> 34	            @Qualifier("mcpServerJsonMapper") JsonMapper jsonMapper,
> 35	            McpServerStreamableHttpProperties serverProperties,
> 36	            ApiKeyAuthenticationService authenticationService) {
> 37	        return WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider.builder()
> 38	                .jsonMapper(new JacksonMcpJsonMapper(jsonMapper))
> 39	                .mcpEndpoint(serverProperties.getMcpEndpoint())
> 40	                .keepAliveInterval(serverProperties.getKeepAliveInterval())
> 41	                .disallowDelete(serverProperties.isDisallowDelete())
> 42	                .securityValidator(securityValidator(authenticationService))
> 43	                .contextExtractor(request -> transportContext(request, authenticationService))
> 44	                .build();
> 45	    }
> 46	
> 47	    private ServerTransportSecurityValidator securityValidator(ApiKeyAuthenticationService authenticationService) {
> 48	        return headers -> {
> 49	            try {
> 50	                authenticationService.authenticate(first(headers.get(LOWERCASE_API_KEY_HEADER)));
> 51	            }
> 52	            catch (UnauthenticatedException exception) {
> 53	                throw new ServerTransportSecurityException(401, "Missing or invalid API key");
> 54	            }
> 55	        };
> 56	    }
> 57	
> 58	    private McpTransportContext transportContext(ServerRequest request,
> 59	                                                 ApiKeyAuthenticationService authenticationService) {
> 60	        UserContext user = authenticationService.authenticate(
> 61	                first(request.headers().header(ApiKeyAuthenticationService.API_KEY_HEADER)));
> 62	        return McpTransportContext.create(Map.of(USER_CONTEXT_KEY, user));
> 63	    }
> 64	
> 65	    private String first(List<String> values) {
> 66	        return values == null || values.isEmpty() ? null : values.getFirst();
> 67	    }
> 68	}

> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,

> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);

> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);

> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());

> 50	            return response;

> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",

> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {

> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }

> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(

> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }

> 1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
> 2	"""Run a non-sensitive health and contract check against the local BGE reranker."""
> 3	from __future__ import annotations
> 4	
> 5	import json
> 6	import os
> 7	import urllib.error
> 8	import urllib.request
> 9	
> 10	BASE_URL = os.getenv("BGE_RERANK_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8081").rstrip("/")
> 11	PATH = os.getenv("BGE_RERANK_PATH", "/rerank")
> 12	API_KEY = os.getenv("BGE_RERANK_API_KEY", "")
> 13	
> 14	
> 15	def request(path: str, body: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> tuple[int, object]:
> 16	    headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
> 17	    data = None
> 18	    if body is not None:
> 19	        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
> 20	        data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
> 21	    if API_KEY:
> 22	        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {API_KEY}"
> 23	    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE_URL + path, data=data, headers=headers)
> 24	    try:
> 25	        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as response:
> 26	            return response.status, json.load(response)
> 27	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
> 28	        detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
> 29	        raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {error.code}: {detail[:300]}") from error
> 30	
> 31	
> 32	def main() -> None:
> 33	    health_status, health = request("/health")
> 34	    rerank_status, ranked = request(
> 35	        PATH,
> 36	        {
> 37	            "query": "local health check",
> 38	            "texts": ["local health check", "unrelated text"],
> 39	            "truncate": True,
> 40	        },
> 41	    )
> 42	    if health_status != 200 or rerank_status != 200:
> 43	        raise RuntimeError("reranker health check failed")
> 44	    if not isinstance(ranked, list) or len(ranked) != 2:
> 45	        raise RuntimeError("reranker response must contain two score entries")
> 46	    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) or "index" not in item or "score" not in item for item in ranked):
> 47	        raise RuntimeError("reranker response does not match the NEXUS contract")
> 48	    best = max(ranked, key=lambda item: float(item["score"]))
> 49	    if best["index"] != 0:
> 50	        raise RuntimeError("reranker did not rank the matching passage first")
> 51	    print(
> 52	        json.dumps(
> 53	            {
> 54	                "status": "UP",
> 55	                "model": health.get("model") if isinstance(health, dict) else None,
> 56	                "device": health.get("device") if isinstance(health, dict) else None,
> 57	                "contract": "PASS",
> 58	            },
> 59	            ensure_ascii=False,
> 60	        )
> 61	    )
> 62	
> 63	
> 64	if __name__ == "__main__":
> 65	    main()

> **`src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/retrieval/pipeline/RetrievalCircuitBreaker.java`** — RetrievalCircuitBreaker(class)
>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 22	        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {API_KEY}"

> 24	    try:
> 25	        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as response:
> 26	            return response.status, json.load(response)
> 27	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
> 28	        detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

> 46	    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) or "index" not in item or "score" not in item for item in ranked):

> 48	    best = max(ranked, key=lambda item: float(item["score"]))

> 205	     */
> 206	    static List<CodeChunk> rerankCandidates(String query, List<CodeChunk> candidates, int limit) {
> 207	        if (candidates.isEmpty() || limit <= 0) {
> 208	            return List.of();
> 209	        }
> 210	        List<RankedCodeChunk> ranked = new ArrayList<>(candidates.size());
> 211	        for (int index = 0; index < candidates.size(); index++) {
> 212	            CodeChunk chunk = candidates.get(index);
> 213	            ranked.add(new RankedCodeChunk(chunk, index, candidateScore(query, chunk, index, candidates.size())));
> 214	        }
> 215	        return ranked.stream()
> 216	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(RankedCodeChunk::score).reversed()
> 217	                        .thenComparingInt(RankedCodeChunk::originalRank))
> 218	                .limit(Math.min(limit, ranked.size()))
> 219	                .map(RankedCodeChunk::chunk)
> 220	                .toList();
> 221	    }

> 223	    private static double candidateScore(String query, CodeChunk chunk, int index, int candidateCount) {
> 224	        String normalizedQuery = safeText(query).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 225	        String normalizedSymbol = safeText(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 226	        String symbolTerms = splitIdentifier(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 227	        String path = safeText(chunk.filePath()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 228	        double score = 1.0 - (0.30 * index / Math.max(candidateCount - 1.0, 1.0));
> 229	
> 230	        if (!normalizedSymbol.isBlank() && compact(normalizedQuery).contains(compact(normalizedSymbol))) {
> 231	            score += 0.50;
> 232	        }
> 233	        int matchedTerms = 0;
> 234	        for (String term : symbolTerms.split("\\s+")) {
> 235	            if (term.length() >= 3 && normalizedQuery.contains(term)) {
> 236	                matchedTerms++;
> 237	            }
> 238	        }
> 239	        score += Math.min(matchedTerms * 0.12, 0.36);
> 240	
> 241	        boolean serviceImplementation = path.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedSymbol.endsWith("impl");
> 242	        boolean controller = path.contains("/controller/");
> 243	        boolean test = path.contains("/src/test/") || path.contains("/test/");
> 244	        if (asksForServiceImplementation(normalizedQuery)) {
> 245	            if (serviceImplementation) {
> 246	                score += 0.42;
> 247	            }
> 248	            else if (controller) {
> 249	                score -= 0.08;
> 250	            }
> 251	        }
> 252	        else if (asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery) && serviceImplementation) {
> 253	            score += 0.24;
> 254	        }
> 255	        if (asksForController(normalizedQuery) && controller) {
> 256	            score += 0.35;
> 257	        }
> 258	        if (asksForTest(normalizedQuery)) {
> 259	            score += test ? 0.35 : 0.0;
> 260	        }
> 261	        else if (test) {
> 262	            score -= 0.12;
> 263	        }
> 264	        if ("method".equalsIgnoreCase(chunk.symbolType()) && asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery)) {
> 265	            score += 0.04;
> 266	        }
> 267	        return score;
> 268	    }

> 340	    private void ensureCollection(String collection) {
> 341	        if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {

> 343	        }
> 344	        synchronized (this) {
> 345	            if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 346	                return;
> 347	            }
> 348	            RuntimeException lastFailure = null;
> 349	            for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 10; attempt++) {

> 351	                    client.get().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 352	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 353	                    return;
> 354	                }

> 359	                    client.put().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)

> 206	    static List<CodeChunk> rerankCandidates(String query, List<CodeChunk> candidates, int limit) {
> 207	        if (candidates.isEmpty() || limit <= 0) {
> 208	            return List.of();
> 209	        }
> 210	        List<RankedCodeChunk> ranked = new ArrayList<>(candidates.size());
> 211	        for (int index = 0; index < candidates.size(); index++) {
> 212	            CodeChunk chunk = candidates.get(index);
> 213	            ranked.add(new RankedCodeChunk(chunk, index, candidateScore(query, chunk, index, candidates.size())));
> 214	        }
> 215	        return ranked.stream()
> 216	                .sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(RankedCodeChunk::score).reversed()
> 217	                        .thenComparingInt(RankedCodeChunk::originalRank))
> 218	                .limit(Math.min(limit, ranked.size()))
> 219	                .map(RankedCodeChunk::chunk)
> 220	                .toList();
> 221	    }

> 223	    private static double candidateScore(String query, CodeChunk chunk, int index, int candidateCount) {
> 224	        String normalizedQuery = safeText(query).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 225	        String normalizedSymbol = safeText(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 226	        String symbolTerms = splitIdentifier(chunk.symbolName()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 227	        String path = safeText(chunk.filePath()).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
> 228	        double score = 1.0 - (0.30 * index / Math.max(candidateCount - 1.0, 1.0));
> 229	
> 230	        if (!normalizedSymbol.isBlank() && compact(normalizedQuery).contains(compact(normalizedSymbol))) {
> 231	            score += 0.50;
> 232	        }
> 233	        int matchedTerms = 0;
> 234	        for (String term : symbolTerms.split("\\s+")) {
> 235	            if (term.length() >= 3 && normalizedQuery.contains(term)) {
> 236	                matchedTerms++;
> 237	            }
> 238	        }
> 239	        score += Math.min(matchedTerms * 0.12, 0.36);
> 240	
> 241	        boolean serviceImplementation = path.contains("/service/impl/") || normalizedSymbol.endsWith("impl");
> 242	        boolean controller = path.contains("/controller/");
> 243	        boolean test = path.contains("/src/test/") || path.contains("/test/");
> 244	        if (asksForServiceImplementation(normalizedQuery)) {
> 245	            if (serviceImplementation) {
> 246	                score += 0.42;
> 247	            }
> 248	            else if (controller) {
> 249	                score -= 0.08;
> 250	            }
> 251	        }
> 252	        else if (asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery) && serviceImplementation) {
> 253	            score += 0.24;
> 254	        }
> 255	        if (asksForController(normalizedQuery) && controller) {
> 256	            score += 0.35;
> 257	        }
> 258	        if (asksForTest(normalizedQuery)) {
> 259	            score += test ? 0.35 : 0.0;
> 260	        }
> 261	        else if (test) {
> 262	            score -= 0.12;
> 263	        }
> 264	        if ("method".equalsIgnoreCase(chunk.symbolType()) && asksForBusinessBehavior(normalizedQuery)) {
> 265	            score += 0.04;
> 266	        }
> 267	        return score;
> 268	    }

> 179	    /** 分页滚动获取指定文档版本的全部 payload。 */
> 180	    public List<ChunkRecord> scrollVersion(String collection, String documentId, String version) {
> 181	        ensureCollection(collection);
> 182	        List<ChunkRecord> result = new ArrayList<>();
> 183	        Object offset = null;
> 184	        do {
> 185	            Map<String, Object> request = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 186	            request.put("filter", filter(documentId, version));
> 187	            request.put("limit", 256);
> 188	            request.put("with_payload", true);
> 189	            request.put("with_vector", false);
> 190	            if (offset != null) request.put("offset", offset);
> 191	            Map<String, Object> response = client.post().uri("/collections/{collection}/points/scroll", collection)
> 192	                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(request).retrieve()
> 193	                    .body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 194	            Map<String, Object> page = map(response == null ? null : response.get("result"));
> 195	            result.addAll(toRecords(list(page.get("points"))));
> 196	            offset = page.get("next_page_offset");
> 197	        } while (offset != null);
> 198	        return result;
> 199	    }

> 201	    /** 轮询等待 Qdrant 服务就绪，超时则抛出异常。 */
> 202	    public void waitUntilReady(Duration timeout) {
> 203	        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + timeout.toNanos();
> 204	        RuntimeException lastFailure = null;
> 205	        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
> 206	            try {
> 207	                client.get().uri("/collections").retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 208	                return;
> 209	            }
> 210	            catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 211	                lastFailure = exception;
> 212	                sleepMillis(1_000);
> 213	            }
> 214	        }
> 215	        throw new IllegalStateException("Qdrant 未就绪: " + properties.qdrant().baseUrl(), lastFailure);
> 216	    }
> 217	
> 218	    /** 确保指定 collection 存在，不存在则按嵌入维度自动创建。 */
> 219	    private void ensureCollection(String collection) {
> 220	        if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 221	            return;
> 222	        }
> 223	        synchronized (this) {
> 224	            if (initializedCollections.contains(collection)) {
> 225	                return;
> 226	            }
> 227	            RuntimeException lastFailure = null;
> 228	            for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 10; attempt++) {
> 229	                try {
> 230	                    client.get().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 231	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 232	                    return;
> 233	                }
> 234	                catch (HttpClientErrorException.NotFound exception) {
> 235	                    Map<String, Object> body = Map.of(
> 236	                            "vectors", Map.of("dense", Map.of("size", embeddingModel.dimensions(), "distance", "Cosine")),
> 237	                            "sparse_vectors", Map.of("sparse", Map.of("modifier", "idf")));
> 238	                    client.put().uri("/collections/{collection}", collection).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
> 239	                            .body(body).retrieve().toBodilessEntity();
> 240	                    initializedCollections.add(collection);
> 241	                    return;
> 242	                }
> 243	                catch (ResourceAccessException exception) {
> 244	                    lastFailure = exception;
> 245	                    sleepMillis(1_000L * attempt);
> 246	                }
> 247	            }
> 248	            throw new IllegalStateException("无法连接 Qdrant collection: " + collection, lastFailure);
> 249	        }
> 250	    }
> 251	
> 252	    /** 线程休眠指定毫秒，中断时恢复中断标志并抛异常。 */
> 253	    private void sleepMillis(long millis) {
> 254	        try {
> 255	            Thread.sleep(millis);
> 256	        }
> 257	        catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 258	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 259	            throw new IllegalStateException("等待 Qdrant 时被中断", exception);
> 260	        }
> 261	    }

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 4	
> 5	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 6	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 7	import java.util.List;
> 8	import java.util.Locale;
> 9	import java.util.Map;
> 10	
> 11	/**
> 12	 * 稀疏向量化器：基于字符级分词与哈希映射生成归一化稀疏向量。
> 13	 */
> 14	@Component
> 15	public class SparseVectorizer {
> 16	
> 17	    /**
> 18	     * 将文本转换为稀疏向量（indices + values），用于 Qdrant 稀疏检索。
> 19	     */
> 20	    public SparseVector vectorize(String text) {
> 21	        Map<Integer, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 22	        for (String token : tokenize(text)) {
> 23	            int index = token.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff;
> 24	            weights.merge(index, 1.0f, Float::sum);
> 25	        }
> 26	        float norm = (float) Math.sqrt(weights.values().stream().mapToDouble(v -> v * v).sum());
> 27	        List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 28	        List<Float> values = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 29	        weights.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()).forEach(entry -> {
> 30	            indices.add(entry.getKey());
> 31	            values.add(norm == 0 ? entry.getValue() : entry.getValue() / norm);
> 32	        });
> 33	        return new SparseVector(indices, values);
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    /** 中英文混合分词：汉字按单字/双字切分，英文按词切分。 */
> 37	    private List<String> tokenize(String text) {
> 38	        String normalized = text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^\\p{IsHan}a-z0-9]+", " ");
> 39	        List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
> 40	        for (String word : normalized.split("\\s+")) {
> 41	            if (word.isBlank()) continue;
> 42	            if (word.matches(".*\\p{IsHan}.*")) {
> 43	                for (int i = 0; i < word.length(); i++) {
> 44	                    tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 1));
> 45	                    if (i + 1 < word.length()) tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 2));
> 46	                }
> 47	            }
> 48	            else if (word.length() > 1) {
> 49	                tokens.add(word);
> 50	            }
> 51	        }
> 52	        return tokens;
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    /** 稀疏向量：索引列表与对应权重值。 */
> 56	    public record SparseVector(List<Integer> indices, List<Float> values) {
> 57	    }
> 58	}

> 16	/** Bounded static graph traversal and conservative impact analysis. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class CodeIntelligenceService {
> 19	    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 5;
> 20	    private static final int MAX_LIMIT = 200;
> 21	    private final SQLiteSymbolGraphStore store;

> 32	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse graph(String projectId, String symbol, String direction,
> 33	                                          Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 34	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 35	        String commit = store.latestCommit(project);
> 36	        if (commit == null) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "No code graph snapshot; run code index first");
> 37	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 38	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.findSymbols(project, commit, symbol, boundedLimit);
> 39	        if (roots.isEmpty()) return unavailable(project, List.of(), "Symbol not found in latest graph snapshot");
> 40	        boolean inbound = !"outbound".equalsIgnoreCase(direction);
> 41	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, commit, roots, inbound, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 42	        return response(project, commit, roots, traversal, List.of(), List.of());
> 43	    }
> 44	
> 45	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactSymbol(String projectId, String symbol, Integer depth, Integer limit) {

> 47	    }

> 49	    public CodeIntelligenceResponse impactCommits(String projectId, String fromCommit, String toCommit,
> 50	                                                  Integer depth, Integer limit) {
> 51	        String project = resolveProject(projectId);
> 52	        if (fromCommit == null || fromCommit.isBlank() || toCommit == null || toCommit.isBlank()) {
> 53	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("fromCommit and toCommit are required");
> 54	        }
> 55	        GitDiffService.GitDiffResult diff;
> 56	        try {
> 57	            diff = gitDiffService.diff(project, fromCommit, toCommit);
> 58	        }
> 59	        catch (java.io.IOException | InterruptedException exception) {
> 60	            if (exception instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 61	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to calculate commit impact", exception);
> 62	        }
> 63	        String snapshot = store.latestCommit(project);
> 64	        List<String> changed = diff.changedPaths();
> 65	        if (snapshot == null || !snapshot.equals(toCommit)) {
> 66	            return unavailable(project, changed, "Target commit graph is unavailable; returning file-level changes");
> 67	        }
> 68	        int boundedLimit = boundLimit(limit);
> 69	        List<CodeSymbol> roots = store.symbolsByFiles(project, toCommit, changed, boundedLimit);
> 70	        Traversal traversal = traverse(project, toCommit, roots, true, boundDepth(depth), boundedLimit);
> 71	        return response(project, toCommit, roots, traversal, changed, List.of());

> 73	
> 74	    private Traversal traverse(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots, boolean inbound,
> 75	                               int maxDepth, int limit) {
> 76	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> certain = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 77	        Map<String, CodeSymbol> inferred = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 78	        List<CodeRelation> relations = new ArrayList<>();
> 79	        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();
> 80	        ArrayDeque<NodeDepth> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
> 81	        roots.forEach(root -> {
> 82	            seen.add(root.id());
> 83	            queue.add(new NodeDepth(root, 0));
> 84	        });
> 85	        boolean truncated = false;
> 86	        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
> 87	            NodeDepth current = queue.removeFirst();
> 88	            if (current.depth() >= maxDepth) continue;
> 89	            for (CodeRelation relation : store.relations(project, commit, current.symbol().id(), inbound, limit)) {
> 90	                if (relations.size() >= limit) {
> 91	                    truncated = true;
> 92	                    break;
> 93	                }
> 94	                relations.add(relation);
> 95	                String nextId = inbound ? relation.callerSymbolId() : relation.calleeSymbolId();
> 96	                if (nextId == null) continue;
> 97	                CodeSymbol next = store.symbolById(project, commit, nextId);
> 98	                if (next == null) continue;
> 99	                if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.EXACT || relation.resolution() == Resolution.SAME_FILE) {
> 100	                    certain.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 101	                }
> 102	                else if (relation.resolution() == Resolution.HEURISTIC) {
> 103	                    inferred.putIfAbsent(next.id(), next);
> 104	                }
> 105	                if (seen.add(next.id())) queue.addLast(new NodeDepth(next, current.depth() + 1));
> 106	            }
> 107	            if (truncated) break;
> 108	        }
> 109	        return new Traversal(List.copyOf(certain.values()), List.copyOf(inferred.values()), relations,
> 110	                store.unresolved(project, commit, Math.min(limit, 50)), truncated);
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private CodeIntelligenceResponse response(String project, String commit, List<CodeSymbol> roots,
> 114	                                              Traversal traversal, List<String> changed, List<String> warnings) {
> 115	        List<String> suggestions = traversal.certain().stream()
> 116	                .filter(symbol -> symbol.entryPoint() || symbol.testSymbol())
> 117	                .map(symbol -> (symbol.testSymbol() ? "Retest " : "Regression-check ")
> 118	                        + symbol.qualifiedName() + " at " + symbol.filePath() + ":" + symbol.startLine())
> 119	                .limit(20).toList();
> 120	        return new CodeIntelligenceResponse("AVAILABLE", project, commit, roots, traversal.certain(),
> 121	                traversal.inferred(), traversal.relations(), traversal.unresolved(), changed, suggestions,
> 122	                warnings, traversal.truncated());
> 123	    }

> 128	    }

> 我再核对统一检索管线与现有符号图的边界，重点判断“整体替换”与“局部图增强”哪一种更合适。
