**结论：目前没有必要把整个项目“改成 GraphRAG”，更合适的是演进为「Hybrid RAG + 局部图增强检索」——也就是 Graph-enhanced RAG。**

你现在的系统其实已经具备 GraphRAG 的一部分基础，不需要推倒重来：

- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/retrieval/QdrantHybridStore.java` 已经提供稠密向量、稀疏向量和 RRF 融合检索。
- 统一检索管线已有并行召回、BGE rerank、缓存、超时、熔断和降级。
- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/code/SQLiteSymbolGraphStore.java` 已经存储代码符号和调用关系。
- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/code/CodeIntelligenceService.java` 已经支持入站/出站遍历、影响分析、确定关系与启发式关系分离。
- 需求、代码、测试、Wiki 已具备版本作用域、证据编号和版本比较能力。

因此它不是“纯向量 RAG”，而是一个**已有代码图能力、但图尚未全面参与知识检索主链路的混合 RAG**。

## 为什么不建议整体替换

### 1. 当前主要问题未必是“缺少图数据库”

0.8 正式评测结果是：

- Document Recall@10：`0.354167`
- Code Recall@10：`0.738095`
- MRR@10：`0.425617`
- 162 个黄金命中中有 99 个失败

GraphRAG 对“关系型问题”可能有效，但不会自动解决：

- 分块粒度不合理
- 黄金标签不完整或标注口径不一致
- 文档内容与查询词之间语义距离过大
- 版本、项目或 documentId 过滤导致候选缺失
- 初始召回池根本没有包含目标文档
- 代码索引文本表达不足

如果目标节点没有进入候选集，简单加一层图遍历不一定能救回来。应先按失败类型分析这 99 个 miss，再判断其中有多少确实需要关系扩展。

### 2. 全面 GraphRAG 会显著增加维护成本

真正的 GraphRAG 不只是换成 Neo4j。还需要长期维护：

- 节点本体：Requirement、Feature、Module、Symbol、File、Test、WikiPage、Version 等
- 边类型：implements、depends_on、calls、verifies、documents、conflicts_with、supersedes 等
- 实体消歧和跨版本身份
- 删除、重命名、增量更新和回滚
- 边的来源、置信度和证据
- 图查询范围和权限隔离
- 图召回与向量召回的融合排序
- 图服务不可用时的降级
- GraphRAG 专属黄金集和指标

你的项目强调 project、document、version、commit 隔离。如果图模型没有从一开始就严格包含这些维度，很容易产生比普通向量检索更隐蔽的**跨项目或跨版本污染**。

### 3. 图检索不应替代语义召回

以下查询仍然更适合当前的向量/稀疏混合召回：

- “有没有描述批量导入失败处理的需求？”
- “查找语义相似的实现代码”
- “这个自然语言问题可能对应哪些需求段落？”

图检索更擅长：

- “这个需求最终由哪些方法实现？”
- “修改该接口会影响哪些测试和 Wiki 页面？”
- “哪些需求依赖已经废弃的功能？”
- “这个版本的变化通过哪些调用链传播？”

所以正确组合是：**语义检索负责找入口，图遍历负责扩展上下文，reranker 负责最终排序。**

## 推荐的目标架构

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Q["用户查询"] --> R["Query Router"]
    R --> V["Qdrant 稠密 + 稀疏召回"]
    R --> K["关键词/结构化过滤"]
    V --> S["种子候选"]
    K --> S
    S --> G["受控图扩展 1-2 hops"]
    G --> F["候选融合与去重"]
    S --> F
    F --> B["BGE Reranker"]
    B --> E["证据绑定与回答"]
    G -.不可用.-> D["降级为现有 Hybrid RAG"]
```

关键点是：**图是召回增强分支，不是唯一事实入口，也不是主存储替代品。**

## 最值得做的图增强范围

### 第一优先级：需求—代码—测试—Wiki 可追踪图

建议新增或统一以下节点：

- `Requirement`
- `RequirementChunk`
- `CodeSymbol`
- `CodeFile`
- `TestCase`
- `WikiPage`
- `Project`
- `BusinessVersion`
- `GitCommit`

第一阶段只接受可验证的边：

- `RequirementChunk -> PART_OF -> Requirement`
- `CodeSymbol -> IMPLEMENTS -> Requirement`
- `TestCase -> VERIFIES -> Requirement`
- `WikiPage -> DOCUMENTS -> Requirement`
- `CodeSymbol -> CALLS -> CodeSymbol`
- `Version -> CONTAINS -> Requirement/CodeSymbol/WikiPage`

每条跨域边至少应携带：

- `projectId`
- `version` 或 `commit`
- `sourceEvidenceId`
- `resolution`：`EXACT`、`SAME_FILE`、`HEURISTIC`
- `confidence`
- `generatedAt`

没有来源证据的 LLM 推测边不能直接当成确定事实。

### 第二优先级：图扩展进入统一检索管线

不要先做复杂的社区摘要式 GraphRAG。可以先在现有 `RetrievalPipeline` 增加可选分支：

1. Qdrant 召回 top 40–50 个种子。
2. 将种子映射到 requirement/code symbol 节点。
3. 只扩展白名单边，最多 1–2 跳。
4. 每个种子最多增加固定数量邻居。
5. 图候选带上路径和关系置信度。
6. 与原候选去重后交给现有 BGE reranker。
7. 图服务失败时返回稳定 warning，继续使用原 Hybrid RAG。

不要无界 BFS，也不要把所有邻居直接塞给模型。

### 第三优先级：针对关系型问题路由

仅当查询包含明显关系意图时启用图扩展，例如：

- 影响、依赖、调用者、被谁实现
- 对应测试、关联需求、版本传播
- 冲突、追踪、上下游、回归范围

普通语义检索默认不启用图扩展，以免增加噪声和延迟。

## 是否需要引入 Neo4j

**现在不建议立即引入。**

现有 SQLite 符号图已经证明可以满足有界遍历和影响分析。可以先抽象统一接口，例如：

```java
interface KnowledgeGraphStore {
    List<KnowledgeNode> resolveSeeds(GraphScope scope, List<EvidenceRef> evidence);
    GraphExpansion expand(GraphScope scope, List<String> seedIds,
                          Set<RelationType> relations, int depth, int limit);
}
```

先用 SQLite 实现并完成评测。只有出现以下情况，再考虑 Neo4j、Memgraph 或其他图数据库：

- 节点/边规模使 SQLite 查询明显达不到 P95 目标
- 多实例并发写入成为现实需求
- 需要复杂的多跳路径、社区发现或图算法
- 运维团队能够承担额外基础设施
- 有基准证明专用图数据库确实带来收益

不要为了“GraphRAG”这个名称先增加基础设施。

## 必须先做的验证实验

建议从当前 54 条固定评测集派生一个 GraphRAG profile，并额外补充至少 20–30 条关系型问题：

1. 需求 → 实现代码
2. 代码 → 上游需求
3. 代码修改 → 受影响测试
4. 需求 → Wiki 页面
5. commit → 调用链影响
6. 跨版本关系污染反例
7. 跨项目污染反例

对照三组：

- A：当前 Hybrid RAG
- B：Hybrid RAG + 一跳图扩展
- C：Hybrid RAG + 两跳图扩展

至少比较：

- Recall@10
- MRR@10
- 路径正确率
- 错误扩展率
- 跨项目/跨版本污染率，必须为 0
- P95 延迟
- 平均候选数量
- BGE 调用量
- 图分支降级率

建议接受门槛：

- 关系型子集 Recall@10 有明确提升，例如至少 10%
- 全集 Recall/MRR 不回退
- 污染率为 0
- P95 增幅可控，例如不超过 20%–30%
- 图不可用时原有 Hybrid RAG 仍正常工作

## 最终建议

| 方案 | 建议 |
|---|---|
| 全面改造成纯 GraphRAG | **不建议** |
| 立刻引入 Neo4j | **不建议** |
| 保留 Qdrant + BGE 主链路 | **建议** |
| 复用现有 SQLite 代码图做受控扩展 | **强烈建议** |
| 建立需求—代码—测试—Wiki 跨域关系图 | **建议先做小范围试验** |
| 用固定黄金集证明收益后再扩大 | **必须** |

一句话总结：**这个项目需要的不是“改为 GraphRAG”，而是把现有代码图能力逐步接入统一检索管线，形成可降级、可评测、受版本和项目严格隔离的图增强 Hybrid RAG。**

对，**当前召回质量确实不能算优秀**。之前 0.8 的“PASS”只能说明：

- 评测过程已经固定、可复现；
- Python/Transformers BGE reranker 调用稳定；
- 性能没有回退，P95 还明显下降；
- **不代表检索质量达标。**

当前正式数据是：

| 指标 | 0.7 | 0.8 | 判断 |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Document Recall@10 | 0.3542 | 0.3542 | 明显偏低 |
| Code Recall@10 | 0.7381 | 0.7381 | 尚可，但仍有较大提升空间 |
| MRR@10 | 0.4256 | 0.4256 | 排名质量一般 |
| 黄金命中失败 | 99/162 | 99/162 | 问题严重 |
| BGE 调用 | — | 144 次成功 | reranker 运行了，但没产生指标收益 |

尤其需要警惕的是：**BGE 成功调用了 144 次，但三项质量指标完全不变。**这不能简单归因于“语料或黄金集基线”，必须验证：

1. reranker 是否真的改变了候选顺序；
2. BGE 分数是否有足够区分度；
3. reranker 输入的 query/document 格式是否正确；
4. 正确答案是否根本没有进入 reranker 候选池；
5. `top-k` 是否在 rerank 之前就截得太小；
6. 评测是否正确读取了 rerank 后的排序。

## 应先做召回失败归因，而不是立刻上 GraphRAG

把 99 个未命中逐条分成下面几类：

- **G1：语料缺失**——黄金答案不在索引语料中；
- **G2：切块失败**——源内容存在，但切块破坏了完整语义；
- **G3：过滤错误**——项目、版本、路径或类型过滤把正确结果排除了；
- **G4：候选召回失败**——正确块没有进入 dense/sparse/RRF 候选集；
- **G5：融合失败**——单路召回命中了，但 RRF 合并后掉出候选集；
- **G6：重排失败**——rerank 前命中，rerank 后掉出 Top-10；
- **G7：黄金集问题**——标签不完整、定位错误或版本不一致。

必须增加分阶段指标：

```text
Dense Recall@10/50/100
Sparse Recall@10/50/100
Dense ∪ Sparse Oracle Recall@10/50/100
RRF Recall@10/50/100
Pre-rerank Recall@10/50
Post-rerank Recall@10
Post-rerank MRR@10
Reranker order-change rate
Gold promotion/demotion count
```

关键判断是：

- 如果正确答案连候选 Top-50 都进不去，**换 reranker 没用**；
- 如果 Top-50 命中但 Top-10 不命中，才主要是融合和 reranker 问题；
- 如果源语料中没有答案，应先修索引和黄金集，而不是调模型；
- 如果 rerank 前后顺序几乎不变，需要检查实现或输入模板。

## 建议下一阶段目标

不要把 0.8 描述为“质量提升完成”，应该定义一个 **0.8.1 召回质量闭环**，目标至少包括：

- Document Recall@10：从 `0.354` 提升到 `≥0.55`；
- Code Recall@10：从 `0.738` 提升到 `≥0.82`；
- MRR@10：从 `0.426` 提升到 `≥0.55`；
- 对 99 个失败样本完成 100% 归因；
- 语料缺失和黄金集错误必须从检索指标中单独披露；
- reranker 顺序变化率、提升数和降级数必须出现在报告里；
- 分别报告需求、代码、测试、Wiki 等不同类型的指标，不能只看一个总平均值。

所以目前更准确的结论是：

> **0.8 完成了可复现评测和 reranker 基础设施闭环，但没有完成召回质量提升。当前最紧迫的问题是分阶段诊断 99 个未命中样本，定位语料、切块、过滤、候选生成、融合和重排各自造成的损失。**

在这个分析完成前，**不建议先改 GraphRAG**。GraphRAG 只能补强依赖关系和跨实体查询，不能自动修复 35.4% 的文档召回率。

> MRR应该是越小越好吧

不是。**标准 MRR（Mean Reciprocal Rank，平均倒数排名）是越大越好**。

计算公式为：

`MRR = (1/N) × Σ(1 / rankᵢ)`

例如正确答案的位置：

| 首个正确结果排名 | Reciprocal Rank |
|---:|---:|
| 第 1 名 | 1.0 |
| 第 2 名 | 0.5 |
| 第 5 名 | 0.2 |
| 第 10 名 | 0.1 |
| Top-K 未命中 | 0 |

因此：

- **MRR = 1.0**：每个查询的正确结果都是第一名，最好；
- **MRR 趋近 0**：正确结果排名很靠后或没有命中，较差；
- 当前 **MRR@10 = 0.4256**：越往上提升越好，例如目标可设为 `≥ 0.55`。

容易混淆的是 **Mean Rank / Average Rank（平均排名）**，它直接计算正确答案所在名次，所以才是**越小越好**。

简而言之：

- **MRR：越大越好**；
- **Mean Rank：越小越好**；
- **Latency/P95：越小越好**。

除非本项目把名为 `MRR` 的字段错误实现成了平均排名，否则之前对指标方向的判断没有问题。不过，`0.4256 → 0.4256` 仍说明 0.8 的 reranker **没有带来可测量的排名提升**。

> 16	/** 智能项目路由：在用户未指定 projectId 时，通过 LLM 分类将查询路由到正确项目。 */

> 87	        if (project.isEmpty()) {
> 88	            return null;
> 89	        }
> 90	        String side = hasText(result.side()) ? result.side() : project.get().side();
> 91	        double confidence = clampConfidence(result.confidence());

> 119	        if (Double.isNaN(confidence) || Double.isInfinite(confidence)) {
> 120	            return 0.0;
> 121	        }
> 122	        return Math.max(0.0, Math.min(1.0, confidence));
> 123	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 4	
> 5	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 6	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 7	import java.util.List;
> 8	import java.util.Locale;
> 9	import java.util.Map;
> 10	
> 11	/**
> 12	 * 稀疏向量化器：基于字符级分词与哈希映射生成归一化稀疏向量。
> 13	 */
> 14	@Component
> 15	public class SparseVectorizer {
> 16	
> 17	    /**
> 18	     * 将文本转换为稀疏向量（indices + values），用于 Qdrant 稀疏检索。
> 19	     */
> 20	    public SparseVector vectorize(String text) {
> 21	        Map<Integer, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 22	        for (String token : tokenize(text)) {
> 23	            int index = token.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff;
> 24	            weights.merge(index, 1.0f, Float::sum);
> 25	        }
> 26	        float norm = (float) Math.sqrt(weights.values().stream().mapToDouble(v -> v * v).sum());
> 27	        List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 28	        List<Float> values = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 29	        weights.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()).forEach(entry -> {
> 30	            indices.add(entry.getKey());
> 31	            values.add(norm == 0 ? entry.getValue() : entry.getValue() / norm);
> 32	        });
> 33	        return new SparseVector(indices, values);
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    /** 中英文混合分词：汉字按单字/双字切分，英文按词切分。 */
> 37	    private List<String> tokenize(String text) {
> 38	        String normalized = text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^\\p{IsHan}a-z0-9]+", " ");
> 39	        List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
> 40	        for (String word : normalized.split("\\s+")) {
> 41	            if (word.isBlank()) continue;
> 42	            if (word.matches(".*\\p{IsHan}.*")) {
> 43	                for (int i = 0; i < word.length(); i++) {
> 44	                    tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 1));
> 45	                    if (i + 1 < word.length()) tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 2));
> 46	                }
> 47	            }
> 48	            else if (word.length() > 1) {
> 49	                tokens.add(word);
> 50	            }
> 51	        }
> 52	        return tokens;
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    /** 稀疏向量：索引列表与对应权重值。 */
> 56	    public record SparseVector(List<Integer> indices, List<Float> values) {
> 57	    }
> 58	}

> 140	        if (request.includeVersionCorpus()) {

> 142	        }
> 143	        collect(codeOutcome, warnings, diagnostics);

> 145	        boolean failedCoreStage = requirementOutcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED

> 147	                || codeOutcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED;
> 148	        if (requirements.isEmpty() && corpus.isEmpty() && code.isEmpty() && failedCoreStage) {
> 149	            throw new RagUnavailableException(warnings);
> 150	        }
> 151	
> 152	        RagOutcomeStatus status = !warnings.isEmpty()
> 153	                ? RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED
> 154	                : requirements.isEmpty() && corpus.isEmpty() && code.isEmpty()
> 155	                        ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;

> 166	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 167	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 168	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 169	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 170	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 171	        }
> 172	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 173	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 174	    }

> 176	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {

> 178	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));

> 181	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 182	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 183	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 184	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 185	        try {
> 186	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 187	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 188	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 189	            return outcome;
> 190	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 191	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 192	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 193	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 194	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 195	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 196	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 197	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 198	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 199	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 201	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 202	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 203	        }
> 204	    }
> 205	
> 206	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 207	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 208	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 209	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 210	        try {
> 211	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 212	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 213	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 214	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 215	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 216	            return outcome;
> 217	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 218	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 219	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 220	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 221	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 222	            return outcome;
> 223	        }
> 224	    }

> 226	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 227	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 228	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 229	            if (value != null) {
> 230	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 231	            }
> 232	        }
> 233	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 234	    }

> 253	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 254	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 255	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 256	        }

> 19	/** Compares requirement parent chunks from reviewable snapshots, with Qdrant payloads as a fallback. */
> 20	@Service

> 22	    private static final int EXCERPT_LIMIT = 360;

> 32	        this.snapshots = snapshots;

> 35	    public RequirementDiff compare(String projectId, VersionManifest from, VersionManifest to) {
> 36	        if (!hasReference(from) || !hasReference(to)) return RequirementDiff.unavailable();
> 37	        List<ChunkRecord> before;
> 38	        List<ChunkRecord> after;
> 39	        Optional<Snapshot> beforeSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 40	                from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 41	        Optional<Snapshot> afterSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 42	                to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 43	        List<RequirementChunkDiff.ParentChange> parentChanges;
> 44	        if (beforeSnapshot.isPresent() && afterSnapshot.isPresent()) {
> 45	            before = chunks(beforeSnapshot.get());
> 46	            after = chunks(afterSnapshot.get());
> 47	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after);
> 48	        } else {
> 49	            String collection = projectRegistry.resolveRequirementCollection(projectId);
> 50	            before = store.scrollVersion(collection, from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 51	            after = store.scrollVersion(collection, to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 52	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after).stream()
> 53	                    .filter(change -> change.type() != RequirementChunkDiff.Type.REMOVED)
> 54	                    .toList();
> 55	        }
> 56	        List<RequirementChange> changes = parentChanges.stream()
> 57	                .map(item -> change(ChangeType.valueOf(item.type().name()), item.before(), item.after()))
> 58	                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
> 59	        changes.sort(Comparator.comparing(RequirementChange::filename,
> 60	                        Comparator.nullsFirst(String::compareTo))
> 61	                .thenComparingInt(RequirementChange::parentOrder)
> 62	                .thenComparing(change -> change.type().name()));
> 63	        return new RequirementDiff(VersionModels.Availability.AVAILABLE,
> 64	                count(changes, ChangeType.ADDED), count(changes, ChangeType.MODIFIED),
> 65	                count(changes, ChangeType.REMOVED), changes);
> 66	    }

> 68	    private List<ChunkRecord> chunks(Snapshot snapshot) {
> 69	        return snapshot.entries().stream().map(entry -> chunk(snapshot, entry)).toList();
> 70	    }

> 72	    private ChunkRecord chunk(Snapshot snapshot, Entry entry) {
> 73	        return new ChunkRecord(entry.entryId() + "-child", snapshot.documentId(), snapshot.requirementVersion(),
> 74	                entry.filename(), entry.entryId(), entry.text(), entry.text(), entry.contentHash(),
> 75	                entry.parentOrder(), 0);
> 76	    }
> 77	
> 78	    private RequirementChange change(ChangeType type, ChunkRecord before, ChunkRecord after) {
> 79	        ChunkRecord source = after != null ? after : before;
> 80	        return new RequirementChange(type, source.filename(), source.parentId(), source.parentOrder(),
> 81	                before == null ? null : RequirementChunkDiff.hash(before), after == null ? null : RequirementChunkDiff.hash(after),
> 82	                before == null ? null : excerpt(before.parentText()), after == null ? null : excerpt(after.parentText()));
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private int count(List<RequirementChange> changes, ChangeType type) {
> 86	        return (int) changes.stream().filter(change -> change.type() == type).count();
> 87	    }

> 94	        String normalized = safe(text).replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 95	        return normalized.length() <= EXCERPT_LIMIT ? normalized : normalized.substring(0, EXCERPT_LIMIT) + "…";
> 96	    }

> 我先把“候选生成、父块去重、BGE 重排”三个阶段的实际候选数量和截断点查清，再给你按收益排序的改进方案。
>
> 我再确认两个最关键的事实：文档混合检索到底返回多少候选，以及评测中候选池是否经常只剩 1～3 条。
</details>

你现在**不应该先换模型，也不应该先上 GraphRAG**。从当前实现和正式报告看，已经发现了一个足以解释“BGE 调用了但指标完全不变”的关键问题：

## 1. 文档重排实际上几乎没有可排的候选

当前链路是：

```text
Qdrant dense/sparse/RRF
  → 按 parentId 去重
  → BGE reranker
  → Top-K
```

`RetrievalPipeline` 在调用 BGE 之前执行：

```java
List<ChunkRecord> requirementCandidates =
    deduplicate(requirementOutcome.data(), this::requirementKey);
```

而 `requirementKey()` 优先使用 `parentId`。正式评测里：

- Qdrant 阶段经常返回约 3 个 child chunk；
- 但 144 次需要文档召回的评测中，传到最终结果的候选数**全部是 1**；
- BGE 接收到一个候选时，无论模型多强，都不可能改变顺序；
- 所以 `0.7 → 0.8` 的 Document Recall 和 MRR 完全不变是必然结果。

这说明当前首要问题不是 `bge-reranker-v2-m3` 的能力，而是**候选在重排之前被过早折叠了**。

## 2. 第一优先级：改成“先重排 child，再聚合 parent”

推荐链路：

```text
Dense Top-50/100 ─┐
                  ├→ RRF Top-50 → child 级 BGE rerank → parent 聚合 → Top-10
Sparse Top-50/100 ┘
```

具体做法：

1. 保留 Qdrant 返回的所有 child chunk，不在 BGE 前按 `parentId` 去重；
2. BGE 对 30～100 个 child 候选进行排序；
3. BGE 后再按 parent 聚合；
4. 同一 parent 的多个 child 可采用：
   - 最高 child 分数作为 parent 分数；或
   - `maxScore + 0.1 × secondScore`，奖励多个片段共同命中；
5. 最后返回不同 parent 的 Top-10。

需要修改的核心文件是：

- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/retrieval/pipeline/RetrievalPipeline.java`
- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/retrieval/pipeline/DefaultRequirementReranker.java`
- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/rerank/HttpBgeReranker.java`

同时应让 reranker 返回分数，而不只是重新排序后的 `ChunkRecord`，否则无法正确做 parent 聚合和诊断。

## 3. 第二优先级：修正文档切块和 parentId 粒度

如果一份需求文档的大量片段共享同一个 `parentId`，那么 parent 粒度过粗。应采用两层切块：

```text
文件
  → 章节/需求条目 parent
      → 语义窗口 child
```

建议：

- 每个需求条目、三级标题或业务规则生成独立 parent；
- parent 大约 500～1500 中文字；
- child 大约 150～400 中文字；
- child overlap 约 40～80 字；
- 表格行、接口字段、验收条件不要随意跨块拆开；
- `parentId` 必须稳定，可由文件路径、标题路径和内容标识生成；
- 重新索引后检查 parent 数量分布，禁止整个评测文档只有一个 parent。

BGE 输入也不要只有 `childText`。建议构造为：

```text
文件：xxx
章节：关注关系 / 取消关注
类型：需求规则
正文：取消关注时，应同步减少关注数和粉丝数……
```

标题、章节和类型通常能明显改善短查询的重排效果。

## 4. 第三优先级：替换当前简易 sparse 检索

当前 `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/retrieval/SparseVectorizer.java` 只是：

- 中文单字、双字切分；
- Java `hashCode()` 映射；
- 词频归一化；
- 没有 IDF；
- 存在哈希碰撞。

它并不等价于真正的 BM25 或 learned sparse retrieval。对于类名、方法名、错误码、接口路径和业务专有词，这会限制召回质量。

建议按优先级选择：

1. **BM25/倒排索引**：最适合精确符号、接口名、错误码；
2. **BGE-M3 sparse 权重**：如果当前 embedding 服务可以稳定输出 lexical weights；
3. 保留现有 sparse 仅作为最低级降级方案。

融合时不要只固定使用等权 RRF，应分别评测：

- dense only；
- sparse only；
- 等权 RRF；
- dense/sparse 加权融合；
- 按查询类型动态加权。

例如查询中包含 `RelationServiceImpl`、`unfollow`、`POST /relation/follow` 时，应提高 lexical 分支权重。

## 5. 第四优先级：给代码召回增加真正的候选池和 reranker

当前代码链路最终固定返回 10 条：正式评测中，126 次代码查询的候选数全部为 10。更重要的是，`RetrievalPipeline` 目前只对需求文档调用 `RequirementReranker`，**代码结果没有经过 BGE 重排**。

正确做法是：

```text
Code dense/sparse Top-50～100
  → 融合
  → 精确符号与路径加权
  → Code BGE rerank Top-20
  → 去重
  → 最终 Top-10
```

代码 passage 不应只放源码正文，应组合：

```text
项目 + 模块 + 文件路径
类名 + 方法名 + 完整签名
注释/Javadoc
调用或实现关系摘要
源码正文
```

此外加入确定性加分规则：

- 查询精确包含方法名：强加分；
- 查询精确包含类名：强加分；
- 查询包含路径或模块名：路径加分；
- 中文业务词：主要依赖 embedding/BM25；
- 测试查询：测试文件和被测符号同时进入候选。

这部分主要涉及：

- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/code/CodeQdrantStore.java`
- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/code/CodeKnowledgeService.java`
- `/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/retrieval/pipeline/RetrievalPipeline.java`

## 6. 必须补充分阶段指标，否则每次调参都不知道损失发生在哪里

下一版报告至少记录：

```text
Gold-in-corpus rate
Dense Recall@10/50/100
Sparse Recall@10/50/100
Dense ∪ Sparse Oracle Recall@50/100
RRF Recall@10/50
Pre-dedup candidate count
Post-dedup candidate count
Pre-rerank gold rank
Post-rerank gold rank
Reranker order-change rate
Gold promoted / unchanged / demoted
Final Recall@10
Final MRR@10
```

失败样本应自动分类：

- `CORPUS_MISSING`
- `CHUNKING_MISMATCH`
- `FILTERED_OUT`
- `DENSE_MISS`
- `SPARSE_MISS`
- `FUSION_LOSS`
- `DEDUP_LOSS`
- `RERANK_DEMOTION`
- `GOLD_LABEL_ERROR`

尤其需要单列 `DEDUP_LOSS`。从现状判断，它很可能是文档召回质量的主要问题之一。

另外，54 条黄金查询重复运行 3 次主要用于延迟稳定性。质量指标应以 **54 条唯一查询**为主，重复运行只用于计算 P50/P95，避免把 162 次运行误认为 162 个独立质量样本。

## 7. 推荐按下面顺序做对照实验

不要一次性把所有变量都改掉，应逐步做 A/B：

| 实验 | 改动 | 目的 |
|---|---|---|
| A | 当前 0.8 | 基线 |
| B | BGE 前不按 parent 去重 | 验证过早去重问题 |
| C | B + hybrid 候选扩大到 50 | 验证候选池上限 |
| D | C + 标题/章节上下文输入 BGE | 验证重排输入质量 |
| E | D + BM25 或 BGE-M3 sparse | 验证 lexical 召回 |
| F | E + 代码 Top-50 后 BGE rerank | 提升 Code Recall/MRR |

每个实验都要固定：语料、commit、黄金集、模型、top-k、随机性和运行环境。

## 8. 合理的近期目标

第一轮不必承诺直接达到极高数值，建议设成：

- `Gold-in-corpus rate = 100%`，或明确剔除并披露缺失样本；
- Document Recall@10 至少提高 **0.15 个绝对值**；
- Code Recall@10 至少提高 **0.05 个绝对值**；
- MRR@10 至少提高 **0.10 个绝对值**；
- reranker 顺序变化率不能接近 0；
- 跨项目、跨版本污染率必须为 0；
- P95 增幅设置明确预算。

## 结论

最值得先做的是：

> **取消 BGE 前的 parent 去重，让 BGE 重排完整 child 候选池；扩大候选池；重排后再做 parent 聚合。**

这是当前最直接、最可验证、也最可能显著提升 Document Recall 和 MRR 的改动。之后再升级 sparse 检索并给代码增加独立 reranker。现阶段换更大的 reranker 或引入 GraphRAG，都会因为候选池与切块问题而收益有限。

> {"name":"ParentChildChunker","qualified_name":"Users-user-Documents-request-RAG.src.main.java.com.example.requirementrag.service.ParentChildChunker.ParentChildChunker","label":"Class","file_path":"/Users/user/Documents/request-RAG/src/main/java/com/example/requirementrag/service/ParentChildChunker.java","start_line":11,"end_line":60,"source":"@Component\npublic class ParentChildChunker {\n\n    static final int PARENT_SIZE = 2_000;\n    static final int CHILD_SIZE = 500;\n    static final int CHILD_OVERLAP = 80;\n\n    /**\n     * 将文本拆分为父块及其子块列表。\n     */\n    public List<ParentChunk> split(String text) {\n        List<String> parents = splitByBoundary(text, PARENT_SIZE, 0);\n        List<ParentChunk> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int parentIndex = 0; parentIndex < parents.size(); parentIndex++) {\n            String parent = parents.get(parentIndex);\n            result.add(new ParentChunk(parentIndex, parent, splitByBoundary(parent, CHILD_SIZE, CHILD_OVERLAP)));\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 按字符边界（换行、句号、分号）切分，支持块间重叠以保留上下文。\n     */\n    private List<String> splitByBoundary(String text, int size, int overlap) {\n        List<String> chunks = new ArrayList<>();\n        int start = 0;\n        while (start < text.length()) {\n            int end = Math.min(start + size, text.length());\n            if (end < text.length()) {\n                int boundary = Math.max(text.lastIndexOf('\\n', end), Math.max(text.lastIndexOf('。', end), text.lastIndexOf('；', end)));\n                if (boundary > start + size / 2) {\n                    end = boundary + 1;\n                }\n            }\n            String chunk = text.substring(start, end).strip();\n            if (!chunk.isBlank()) {\n                chunks.add(chunk);\n            }\n            if (end >= text.length()) {\n                break;\n            }\n            start = Math.max(start + 1, end - overlap);\n        }\n        return chunks;\n    }\n\n    /** 父块及其有序子块列表。 */\n    public record ParentChunk(int order, String text, List<String> children) {\n    }\n}\n","complexity":0,"lines":0,"is_exported":true,"is_test":false,"is_entry_point":false,"docstring":"/**\n * 父子分块器：先按较大窗口切父块，再按较小窗口切子块并保留重叠。\n */","callers":0,"callees":0}

> 26	public class RequirementIngestionService {
> 27	
> 28	    private final QdrantHybridStore store;

> 31	    private final RagObservability observability;

> 37	                                       ParentChildChunker chunker, RagObservability observability) {
> 38	        this.store = store;
> 39	        this.preprocessor = preprocessor;
> 40	        this.chunker = chunker;
> 41	        this.observability = observability;
> 42	    }
> 43	
> 44	    /**

> 47	    public IngestResponse ingest(MultipartFile file, String version, String documentId) throws IOException {
> 48	        return ingest(null, file, version, documentId);
> 49	    }
> 50	
> 51	    /**
> 52	     * 上传 multipart 文件并导入为指定版本的向量分块。
> 53	     */
> 54	    public IngestResponse ingest(String collection, MultipartFile file, String version, String documentId) throws IOException {
> 55	        String id = StringUtils.hasText(documentId) ? documentId : UUID.randomUUID().toString();
> 56	        String filename = StringUtils.hasText(file.getOriginalFilename()) ? file.getOriginalFilename() : "document";
> 57	        return ingestEntries(collection, id, version, List.of(new KnowledgeEntry(filename, readMultipart(file, id, version, filename))));
> 58	    }
> 59	
> 60	    /**
> 61	     * 批量导入知识条目：清洗、分块、去重后替换指定版本的全部分块。使用默认 collection。
> 62	     */
> 63	    public IngestResponse ingestEntries(String documentId, String version, List<KnowledgeEntry> entries) {
> 64	        return ingestEntries(null, documentId, version, entries);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    /**
> 68	     * 批量导入知识条目：清洗、分块、去重后替换指定版本的全部分块。
> 69	     */
> 70	    public IngestResponse ingestEntries(String collection, String documentId, String version, List<KnowledgeEntry> entries) {
> 71	        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
> 72	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("没有可导入的知识条目");
> 73	        }
> 74	
> 75	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 76	        Set<String> seenParents = new HashSet<>();
> 77	        Set<String> seenChildren = new HashSet<>();
> 78	        for (KnowledgeEntry entry : entries) {
> 79	            String cleaned = observability.observe("text.clean", documentId, version, () -> preprocessor.clean(entry.text()));
> 80	            if (cleaned.isBlank()) {
> 81	                continue;
> 82	            }
> 83	            List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents = observability.observe("parent_child.chunk", documentId, version,
> 84	                    () -> chunker.split(cleaned));
> 85	            observability.items("parent_child.chunk", "parents", parents.size());
> 86	            List<ChunkRecord> entryChunks = observability.observe("content.deduplicate", documentId, version,
> 87	                    () -> deduplicate(documentId, version, entry.source(), parents, seenParents, seenChildren));
> 88	            int rawChildren = parents.stream().mapToInt(parent -> parent.children().size()).sum();
> 89	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "input", rawChildren);
> 90	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "output", entryChunks.size());
> 91	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "removed", rawChildren - entryChunks.size());
> 92	            chunks.addAll(entryChunks);
> 93	        }
> 94	
> 95	        if (chunks.isEmpty()) {
> 96	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("文档解析后没有有效文本");
> 97	        }
> 98	
> 99	        if (collection != null && !collection.isBlank()) {
> 100	            observability.observe("qdrant.upsert", documentId, version,
> 101	                    () -> store.replaceVersion(collection, documentId, version, chunks));
> 102	        } else {
> 103	            observability.observe("qdrant.upsert", documentId, version,
> 104	                    () -> store.replaceVersion(documentId, version, chunks));
> 105	        }
> 106	        observability.event("document_ingested");
> 107	        return new IngestResponse(documentId, version, chunks.size());
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 使用 Tika 解析上传文件为纯文本。 */
> 111	    private String readMultipart(MultipartFile file, String id, String version, String filename) throws IOException {
> 112	        byte[] fileBytes = file.getBytes();
> 113	        return observability.observe("document.parse", id, version, () -> {
> 114	            var resource = new NamedByteArrayResource(fileBytes, filename);
> 115	            return new TikaDocumentReader(resource).read().stream().map(Document::getText)
> 116	                    .reduce("", (left, right) -> left + "\n" + right);
> 117	        });
> 118	    }
> 119	
> 120	    /** 按内容哈希去重父块与子块，生成 ChunkRecord 列表。 */
> 121	    private List<ChunkRecord> deduplicate(String id, String version, String filename,
> 122	                                          List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents,
> 123	                                          Set<String> seenParents, Set<String> seenChildren) {
> 124	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 125	        for (ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk parent : parents) {
> 126	            String parentHash = Hashing.sha256(parent.text());
> 127	            if (!seenParents.add(parentHash)) continue;
> 128	            String parentId = Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":parent:" + parentHash);
> 129	            for (int childIndex = 0; childIndex < parent.children().size(); childIndex++) {
> 130	                String child = parent.children().get(childIndex);
> 131	                String childHash = Hashing.sha256(child);
> 132	                if (!seenChildren.add(childHash)) continue;
> 133	                chunks.add(new ChunkRecord(Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":child:" + childHash), id, version,
> 134	                        filename, parentId, parent.text(), child, childHash, parent.order(), childIndex));
> 135	            }
> 136	        }
> 137	        return chunks;
> 138	    }
> 139	
> 140	    /** 带文件名的 ByteArrayResource，供 Tika 识别文件类型。 */
> 141	    private static final class NamedByteArrayResource extends ByteArrayResource {
> 142	        private final String filename;
> 143	
> 144	        /** 构造带原始文件名的字节资源。 */
> 145	        private NamedByteArrayResource(byte[] bytes, String filename) {
> 146	            super(bytes);
> 147	            this.filename = filename;
> 148	        }
> 149	
> 150	        /** 返回原始文件名。 */
> 151	        @Override
> 152	        public String getFilename() {
> 153	            return filename;
> 154	        }
> 155	    }
> 156	}

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.versioning;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.ProjectRegistry;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.ChunkRecord;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.QdrantHybridStore;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.RequirementSnapshotModels.Entry;
> 7	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.RequirementSnapshotModels.Snapshot;
> 8	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.ChangeType;
> 9	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.RequirementChange;

> 11	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.VersionManifest;
> 12	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 13	
> 14	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 15	import java.util.Comparator;
> 16	import java.util.List;
> 17	import java.util.Optional;
> 18	
> 19	/** Compares requirement parent chunks from reviewable snapshots, with Qdrant payloads as a fallback. */
> 20	@Service
> 21	public class RequirementVersionDiffService {
> 22	    private static final int EXCERPT_LIMIT = 360;
> 23	
> 24	    private final QdrantHybridStore store;
> 25	    private final ProjectRegistry projectRegistry;
> 26	    private final RequirementSnapshotRepository snapshots;
> 27	
> 28	    public RequirementVersionDiffService(QdrantHybridStore store, ProjectRegistry projectRegistry,
> 29	                                         RequirementSnapshotRepository snapshots) {
> 30	        this.store = store;
> 31	        this.projectRegistry = projectRegistry;
> 32	        this.snapshots = snapshots;
> 33	    }
> 34	
> 35	    public RequirementDiff compare(String projectId, VersionManifest from, VersionManifest to) {
> 36	        if (!hasReference(from) || !hasReference(to)) return RequirementDiff.unavailable();
> 37	        List<ChunkRecord> before;
> 38	        List<ChunkRecord> after;
> 39	        Optional<Snapshot> beforeSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 40	                from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 41	        Optional<Snapshot> afterSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 42	                to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 43	        List<RequirementChunkDiff.ParentChange> parentChanges;
> 44	        if (beforeSnapshot.isPresent() && afterSnapshot.isPresent()) {
> 45	            before = chunks(beforeSnapshot.get());
> 46	            after = chunks(afterSnapshot.get());
> 47	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after);
> 48	        } else {
> 49	            String collection = projectRegistry.resolveRequirementCollection(projectId);
> 50	            before = store.scrollVersion(collection, from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 51	            after = store.scrollVersion(collection, to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 52	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after).stream()
> 53	                    .filter(change -> change.type() != RequirementChunkDiff.Type.REMOVED)
> 54	                    .toList();
> 55	        }
> 56	        List<RequirementChange> changes = parentChanges.stream()
> 57	                .map(item -> change(ChangeType.valueOf(item.type().name()), item.before(), item.after()))
> 58	                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
> 59	        changes.sort(Comparator.comparing(RequirementChange::filename,
> 60	                        Comparator.nullsFirst(String::compareTo))
> 61	                .thenComparingInt(RequirementChange::parentOrder)
> 62	                .thenComparing(change -> change.type().name()));
> 63	        return new RequirementDiff(VersionModels.Availability.AVAILABLE,
> 64	                count(changes, ChangeType.ADDED), count(changes, ChangeType.MODIFIED),
> 65	                count(changes, ChangeType.REMOVED), changes);
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    private List<ChunkRecord> chunks(Snapshot snapshot) {
> 69	        return snapshot.entries().stream().map(entry -> chunk(snapshot, entry)).toList();
> 70	    }
> 71	
> 72	    private ChunkRecord chunk(Snapshot snapshot, Entry entry) {
> 73	        return new ChunkRecord(entry.entryId() + "-child", snapshot.documentId(), snapshot.requirementVersion(),
> 74	                entry.filename(), entry.entryId(), entry.text(), entry.text(), entry.contentHash(),
> 75	                entry.parentOrder(), 0);
> 76	    }
> 77	
> 78	    private RequirementChange change(ChangeType type, ChunkRecord before, ChunkRecord after) {
> 79	        ChunkRecord source = after != null ? after : before;
> 80	        return new RequirementChange(type, source.filename(), source.parentId(), source.parentOrder(),
> 81	                before == null ? null : RequirementChunkDiff.hash(before), after == null ? null : RequirementChunkDiff.hash(after),
> 82	                before == null ? null : excerpt(before.parentText()), after == null ? null : excerpt(after.parentText()));
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private int count(List<RequirementChange> changes, ChangeType type) {
> 86	        return (int) changes.stream().filter(change -> change.type() == type).count();
> 87	    }
> 88	
> 89	    private boolean hasReference(VersionManifest manifest) {
> 90	        return hasText(manifest.requirementDocumentId()) && hasText(manifest.requirementVersion());
> 91	    }
> 92	
> 93	    private String excerpt(String text) {
> 94	        String normalized = safe(text).replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 95	        return normalized.length() <= EXCERPT_LIMIT ? normalized : normalized.substring(0, EXCERPT_LIMIT) + "…";
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) { return value == null ? "" : value; }
> 99	    private boolean hasText(String value) { return value != null && !value.isBlank(); }
> 100	}

> 121	    private List<ChunkRecord> deduplicate(String id, String version, String filename,
> 122	                                          List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents,
> 123	                                          Set<String> seenParents, Set<String> seenChildren) {
> 124	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 125	        for (ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk parent : parents) {
> 126	            String parentHash = Hashing.sha256(parent.text());
> 127	            if (!seenParents.add(parentHash)) continue;
> 128	            String parentId = Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":parent:" + parentHash);
> 129	            for (int childIndex = 0; childIndex < parent.children().size(); childIndex++) {
> 130	                String child = parent.children().get(childIndex);
> 131	                String childHash = Hashing.sha256(child);
> 132	                if (!seenChildren.add(childHash)) continue;
> 133	                chunks.add(new ChunkRecord(Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":child:" + childHash), id, version,
> 134	                        filename, parentId, parent.text(), child, childHash, parent.order(), childIndex));
> 135	            }
> 136	        }
> 137	        return chunks;
> 138	    }

> 10	/**
> 11	 * 文本预处理器，去除 HTML 噪声、重复行与分页标记，控制上下文长度。
> 12	 */
> 13	@Component
> 14	public class TextPreprocessor {
> 15	
> 16	    private static final int MAX_LINE_LENGTH = 4_000;
> 17	    private static final int MAX_TOTAL_LENGTH = 120_000;
> 18	    private static final Set<String> NOISE = Set.of("目录", "返回顶部", "上一页", "下一页", "点击查看", "暂无数据");
> 19	
> 20	    /**
> 21	     * 清洗原始文本：去噪、去重、截断至最大长度。
> 22	     */
> 23	    public String clean(String raw) {
> 24	        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
> 25	            return "";
> 26	        }
> 27	
> 28	        List<String> kept = new ArrayList<>();
> 29	        String previous = null;
> 30	        int totalLength = 0;
> 31	        for (String line : raw.replace('\u00a0', ' ').split("\\R")) {
> 32	            String value = normalizeLine(line);
> 33	            if (value.isBlank() || NOISE.contains(value) || isPageMarker(value)) {

> 35	            }
> 36	            if (value.equals(previous)) {
> 37	                continue;
> 38	            }
> 39	            if (totalLength + value.length() > MAX_TOTAL_LENGTH) {
> 40	                break;
> 41	            }
> 42	            kept.add(value);
> 43	            previous = value;
> 44	            totalLength += value.length() + 1;
> 45	        }
> 46	        return String.join("\n", new LinkedHashSet<>(kept));
> 47	    }

> 52	    private String normalizeLine(String line) {
> 53	        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(Math.min(line.length(), MAX_LINE_LENGTH));
> 54	        boolean previousSpace = false;
> 55	        for (int index = 0; index < line.length() && builder.length() < MAX_LINE_LENGTH; index++) {
> 56	            char ch = line.charAt(index);
> 57	            if (ch == ' ' || ch == '\t') {
> 58	                if (!previousSpace && !builder.isEmpty()) {
> 59	                    builder.append(' ');
> 60	                    previousSpace = true;
> 61	                }
> 62	                continue;
> 63	            }
> 64	            builder.append(ch);
> 65	            previousSpace = false;
> 66	        }
> 67	        return builder.toString().strip();
> 68	    }
> 69	
> 70	    /**
> 71	     * 判断是否为「第 N 页」类分页标记。
> 72	     */
> 73	    private boolean isPageMarker(String value) {
> 74	        if (value.length() > 32) {
> 75	            return false;
> 76	        }
> 77	        return value.startsWith("第") && value.contains("页");
> 78	    }
> 79	}

> 35	    public RequirementDiff compare(String projectId, VersionManifest from, VersionManifest to) {
> 36	        if (!hasReference(from) || !hasReference(to)) return RequirementDiff.unavailable();
> 37	        List<ChunkRecord> before;
> 38	        List<ChunkRecord> after;
> 39	        Optional<Snapshot> beforeSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 40	                from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 41	        Optional<Snapshot> afterSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 42	                to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 43	        List<RequirementChunkDiff.ParentChange> parentChanges;
> 44	        if (beforeSnapshot.isPresent() && afterSnapshot.isPresent()) {
> 45	            before = chunks(beforeSnapshot.get());
> 46	            after = chunks(afterSnapshot.get());
> 47	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after);
> 48	        } else {
> 49	            String collection = projectRegistry.resolveRequirementCollection(projectId);
> 50	            before = store.scrollVersion(collection, from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 51	            after = store.scrollVersion(collection, to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 52	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after).stream()
> 53	                    .filter(change -> change.type() != RequirementChunkDiff.Type.REMOVED)
> 54	                    .toList();
> 55	        }
> 56	        List<RequirementChange> changes = parentChanges.stream()
> 57	                .map(item -> change(ChangeType.valueOf(item.type().name()), item.before(), item.after()))
> 58	                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
> 59	        changes.sort(Comparator.comparing(RequirementChange::filename,
> 60	                        Comparator.nullsFirst(String::compareTo))
> 61	                .thenComparingInt(RequirementChange::parentOrder)
> 62	                .thenComparing(change -> change.type().name()));
> 63	        return new RequirementDiff(VersionModels.Availability.AVAILABLE,
> 64	                count(changes, ChangeType.ADDED), count(changes, ChangeType.MODIFIED),
> 65	                count(changes, ChangeType.REMOVED), changes);
> 66	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.cache;
> 2	
> 3	import java.time.Clock;
> 4	import java.time.Duration;
> 5	import java.util.Comparator;
> 6	import java.util.Map;
> 7	import java.util.Optional;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Small process-local cache with explicit TTL and capacity bounds. */
> 11	public final class BoundedTtlCache<K, V> {
> 12	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<K, Entry<V>> entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 13	    private final long ttlMillis;
> 14	    private final int maxEntries;
> 15	    private final Clock clock;
> 16	
> 17	    public BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries) {
> 18	        this(ttl, maxEntries, Clock.systemUTC());
> 19	    }
> 20	
> 21	    BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {
> 22	        this.ttlMillis = Math.max(0, ttl == null ? 0 : ttl.toMillis());
> 23	        this.maxEntries = Math.max(0, maxEntries);
> 24	        this.clock = clock;
> 25	    }
> 26	
> 27	    public Optional<V> get(K key) {
> 28	        if (!enabled() || key == null) return Optional.empty();
> 29	        Entry<V> entry = entries.get(key);
> 30	        if (entry == null) return Optional.empty();
> 31	        if (entry.expiresAtMillis() <= clock.millis()) {
> 32	            entries.remove(key, entry);
> 33	            return Optional.empty();
> 34	        }
> 35	        return Optional.of(entry.value());
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    public void put(K key, V value) {
> 39	        if (!enabled() || key == null || value == null) return;
> 40	        long now = clock.millis();
> 41	        removeExpired(now);
> 42	        entries.put(key, new Entry<>(value, now, now + ttlMillis));
> 43	        trimToCapacity();
> 44	    }
> 45	
> 46	    public void invalidate(K key) {
> 47	        if (key != null) entries.remove(key);
> 48	    }
> 49	
> 50	    public void invalidateWhere(java.util.function.Predicate<K> predicate) {
> 51	        if (predicate != null) entries.keySet().removeIf(predicate);
> 52	    }
> 53	
> 54	    public void clear() {
> 55	        entries.clear();
> 56	    }
> 57	
> 58	    int size() {
> 59	        return entries.size();
> 60	    }
> 61	
> 62	    private boolean enabled() {
> 63	        return ttlMillis > 0 && maxEntries > 0;
> 64	    }
> 65	
> 66	    private void removeExpired(long now) {
> 67	        entries.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getValue().expiresAtMillis() <= now);
> 68	    }
> 69	
> 70	    private void trimToCapacity() {
> 71	        while (entries.size() > maxEntries) {
> 72	            entries.entrySet().stream()
> 73	                    .min(Comparator.comparingLong(entry -> entry.getValue().createdAtMillis()))
> 74	                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
> 75	                    .ifPresent(entries::remove);
> 76	        }
> 77	    }
> 78	
> 79	    private record Entry<V>(V value, long createdAtMillis, long expiresAtMillis) {
> 80	    }
> 81	}

> 25	@Service

> 27	
> 28	    private final QdrantHybridStore store;

> 31	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 32	
> 33	    /**

> 36	    public RequirementIngestionService(QdrantHybridStore store, TextPreprocessor preprocessor,
> 37	                                       ParentChildChunker chunker, RagObservability observability) {
> 38	        this.store = store;
> 39	        this.preprocessor = preprocessor;
> 40	        this.chunker = chunker;
> 41	        this.observability = observability;
> 42	    }
> 43	
> 44	    /**
> 45	     * 上传 multipart 文件并导入为指定版本的向量分块。使用默认 collection。

> 50	
> 51	    /**
> 52	     * 上传 multipart 文件并导入为指定版本的向量分块。
> 53	     */
> 54	    public IngestResponse ingest(String collection, MultipartFile file, String version, String documentId) throws IOException {
> 55	        String id = StringUtils.hasText(documentId) ? documentId : UUID.randomUUID().toString();
> 56	        String filename = StringUtils.hasText(file.getOriginalFilename()) ? file.getOriginalFilename() : "document";
> 57	        return ingestEntries(collection, id, version, List.of(new KnowledgeEntry(filename, readMultipart(file, id, version, filename))));
> 58	    }
> 59	
> 60	    /**
> 61	     * 批量导入知识条目：清洗、分块、去重后替换指定版本的全部分块。使用默认 collection。
> 62	     */
> 63	    public IngestResponse ingestEntries(String documentId, String version, List<KnowledgeEntry> entries) {
> 64	        return ingestEntries(null, documentId, version, entries);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    /**
> 68	     * 批量导入知识条目：清洗、分块、去重后替换指定版本的全部分块。
> 69	     */
> 70	    public IngestResponse ingestEntries(String collection, String documentId, String version, List<KnowledgeEntry> entries) {
> 71	        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
> 72	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("没有可导入的知识条目");
> 73	        }
> 74	
> 75	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 76	        Set<String> seenParents = new HashSet<>();
> 77	        Set<String> seenChildren = new HashSet<>();
> 78	        for (KnowledgeEntry entry : entries) {
> 79	            String cleaned = observability.observe("text.clean", documentId, version, () -> preprocessor.clean(entry.text()));
> 80	            if (cleaned.isBlank()) {
> 81	                continue;
> 82	            }
> 83	            List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents = observability.observe("parent_child.chunk", documentId, version,
> 84	                    () -> chunker.split(cleaned));
> 85	            observability.items("parent_child.chunk", "parents", parents.size());
> 86	            List<ChunkRecord> entryChunks = observability.observe("content.deduplicate", documentId, version,
> 87	                    () -> deduplicate(documentId, version, entry.source(), parents, seenParents, seenChildren));
> 88	            int rawChildren = parents.stream().mapToInt(parent -> parent.children().size()).sum();
> 89	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "input", rawChildren);
> 90	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "output", entryChunks.size());
> 91	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "removed", rawChildren - entryChunks.size());
> 92	            chunks.addAll(entryChunks);
> 93	        }
> 94	
> 95	        if (chunks.isEmpty()) {
> 96	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("文档解析后没有有效文本");
> 97	        }
> 98	
> 99	        if (collection != null && !collection.isBlank()) {
> 100	            observability.observe("qdrant.upsert", documentId, version,
> 101	                    () -> store.replaceVersion(collection, documentId, version, chunks));
> 102	        } else {
> 103	            observability.observe("qdrant.upsert", documentId, version,
> 104	                    () -> store.replaceVersion(documentId, version, chunks));
> 105	        }
> 106	        observability.event("document_ingested");
> 107	        return new IngestResponse(documentId, version, chunks.size());
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 使用 Tika 解析上传文件为纯文本。 */
> 111	    private String readMultipart(MultipartFile file, String id, String version, String filename) throws IOException {
> 112	        byte[] fileBytes = file.getBytes();
> 113	        return observability.observe("document.parse", id, version, () -> {
> 114	            var resource = new NamedByteArrayResource(fileBytes, filename);
> 115	            return new TikaDocumentReader(resource).read().stream().map(Document::getText)
> 116	                    .reduce("", (left, right) -> left + "\n" + right);
> 117	        });
> 118	    }
> 119	
> 120	    /** 按内容哈希去重父块与子块，生成 ChunkRecord 列表。 */
> 121	    private List<ChunkRecord> deduplicate(String id, String version, String filename,
> 122	                                          List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents,
> 123	                                          Set<String> seenParents, Set<String> seenChildren) {
> 124	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 125	        for (ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk parent : parents) {
> 126	            String parentHash = Hashing.sha256(parent.text());
> 127	            if (!seenParents.add(parentHash)) continue;
> 128	            String parentId = Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":parent:" + parentHash);
> 129	            for (int childIndex = 0; childIndex < parent.children().size(); childIndex++) {
> 130	                String child = parent.children().get(childIndex);
> 131	                String childHash = Hashing.sha256(child);
> 132	                if (!seenChildren.add(childHash)) continue;
> 133	                chunks.add(new ChunkRecord(Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":child:" + childHash), id, version,
> 134	                        filename, parentId, parent.text(), child, childHash, parent.order(), childIndex));
> 135	            }
> 136	        }
> 137	        return chunks;
> 138	    }
> 139	
> 140	    /** 带文件名的 ByteArrayResource，供 Tika 识别文件类型。 */
> 141	    private static final class NamedByteArrayResource extends ByteArrayResource {
> 142	        private final String filename;
> 143	
> 144	        /** 构造带原始文件名的字节资源。 */
> 145	        private NamedByteArrayResource(byte[] bytes, String filename) {
> 146	            super(bytes);
> 147	            this.filename = filename;
> 148	        }
> 149	
> 150	        /** 返回原始文件名。 */
> 151	        @Override
> 152	        public String getFilename() {
> 153	            return filename;
> 154	        }
> 155	    }
> 156	}

> 20	    public ProjectRegistry(RagProperties properties) {

> 77	    public Optional<String> resolveProjectIdByGitPath(String pathWithNamespace) {
> 78	        if (pathWithNamespace == null || pathWithNamespace.isBlank()) {
> 79	            return Optional.empty();
> 80	        }
> 81	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : projectMap.values()) {
> 82	            if (pathWithNamespace.equals(project.gitPath())) {
> 83	                return Optional.of(project.id());
> 84	            }
> 85	        }
> 86	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : projectMap.values()) {
> 87	            if (pathWithNamespace.equals(project.id())) {
> 88	                return Optional.of(project.id());
> 89	            }
> 90	        }
> 91	        String repoName = pathWithNamespace.contains("/")
> 92	                ? pathWithNamespace.substring(pathWithNamespace.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)
> 93	                : pathWithNamespace;
> 94	        for (RagProperties.ProjectConfig project : projectMap.values()) {
> 95	            if (repoName.equals(project.id())) {
> 96	                return Optional.of(project.id());
> 97	            }
> 98	        }
> 99	        return Optional.empty();
> 100	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.mcp;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.model.Permission;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.UserContext;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.security.ProjectAuthorizationService;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.security.UnauthenticatedException;
> 7	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
> 8	import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
> 9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
> 10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
> 11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 12	
> 13	import java.util.Objects;
> 14	import java.util.function.Function;
> 15	
> 16	/** Applies shared authorization, audit logging, and metrics around MCP tool calls. */
> 17	@Service
> 18	public class McpToolInvocationService {
> 19	
> 20	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(McpToolInvocationService.class);
> 21	
> 22	    private final ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService;
> 23	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 24	    private final McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy;
> 25	
> 26	    public McpToolInvocationService(ProjectAuthorizationService authorizationService, MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
> 27	                                    McpResponsePolicy responsePolicy) {
> 28	        this.authorizationService = authorizationService;
> 29	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 30	        this.responsePolicy = responsePolicy;
> 31	    }
> 32	
> 33	    public <T> McpToolResponse<T> invoke(String tool, org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request,
> 34	                                         String requestedProjectId, String version, Permission permission,
> 35	                                         Function<String, McpToolResponse<T>> action) {
> 36	        UserContext user = authenticatedUser(request);
> 37	        authorizationService.requirePermission(user, permission);
> 38	        String projectId = authorizationService.requireProjectAccess(user, requestedProjectId);
> 39	        Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start(meterRegistry);
> 40	        long startedAt = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        try {
> 42	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(action.apply(projectId));
> 43	            String status = response.warnings().isEmpty() ? "SUCCESS" : "DEGRADED";
> 44	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, status, elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 45	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", status,
> 46	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 47	            response.warnings().forEach(warning -> meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.warnings",
> 48	                    "tool", tool, "code", warning.code()).increment());
> 49	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", status));
> 50	            return response;
> 51	        }
> 52	        catch (McpDependencyUnavailableException exception) {
> 53	            String code = tool.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) + "_UNAVAILABLE";
> 54	            McpToolResponse<T> response = responsePolicy.enforceTotalLimit(new McpToolResponse<>(
> 55	                    new McpToolResponse.ResolvedScope(projectId, version, null), null, java.util.List.of(),
> 56	                    java.util.Map.of("status", "DEGRADED"),
> 57	                    java.util.List.of(new com.example.requirementrag.model.RagWarning(
> 58	                            "mcp", code, "Tool dependency is temporarily unavailable", 0)), false));
> 59	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "DEGRADED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), response.warnings().size());
> 60	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED",
> 61	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 62	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "DEGRADED"));
> 63	            return response;
> 64	        }
> 65	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 66	            record(tool, user, projectId, version, "FAILED", elapsedMillis(startedAt), 0);
> 67	            meterRegistry.counter("nexus.mcp.tool.calls", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED",
> 68	                    "role", user.role().name()).increment();
> 69	            sample.stop(meterRegistry.timer("nexus.mcp.tool.duration", "tool", tool, "status", "FAILED"));
> 70	            log.warn("MCP tool failed tool={} actor={} project={} version={} exceptionType={}",
> 71	                    tool, user.username(), projectId, safe(version), exception.getClass().getSimpleName());
> 72	            throw exception;
> 73	        }
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    private UserContext authenticatedUser(
> 77	            org.springframework.ai.mcp.annotation.context.McpSyncRequestContext request) {
> 78	        if (request == null || request.transportContext() == null) {
> 79	            throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 80	        }
> 81	        Object value = request.transportContext().get(McpTransportConfiguration.USER_CONTEXT_KEY);
> 82	        if (value instanceof UserContext user) {
> 83	            return user;
> 84	        }
> 85	        throw new UnauthenticatedException();
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    private void record(String tool, UserContext user, String projectId, String version,
> 89	                        String status, long durationMs, int warningCount) {
> 90	        log.info("MCP tool={} actor={} role={} project={} version={} durationMs={} status={} warningCount={}",
> 91	                tool, user.username(), user.role(), projectId, safe(version), durationMs, status, warningCount);
> 92	    }
> 93	
> 94	    private long elapsedMillis(long startedAt) {
> 95	        return (System.nanoTime() - startedAt) / 1_000_000;
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) {
> 99	        return Objects.toString(value, "");
> 100	    }
> 101	}
> ```

> 167	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 168	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 169	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 170	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 171	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 172	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 173	        }
> 174	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 175	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 176	    }

> 183	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 184	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 185	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 186	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 187	        try {
> 188	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 189	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 190	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 191	            return outcome;
> 192	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 193	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 194	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 195	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 196	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 197	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 198	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 199	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 200	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 201	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 202	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 203	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 204	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 205	        }
> 206	    }
> 207	
> 208	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 209	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 210	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 211	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 212	        try {
> 213	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 214	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 215	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 216	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 217	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 218	            return outcome;
> 219	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 220	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 221	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 222	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 223	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 224	            return outcome;
> 225	        }
> 226	    }

> 228	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 229	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 230	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 231	            if (value != null) {
> 232	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 233	            }
> 234	        }
> 235	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 236	    }

> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }

> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }
> 83	
> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }
> 95

> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }

> 43	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }
> 70

> 72	    private String requestPassage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 73	        return enrichedPassageEnabled ? passage(chunk) : normalize(chunk.childText());
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    static String passage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }
> 83	
> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }
> 95	
> 96	    private static String normalize(String value) {
> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }
> 99	
> 100	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */

> 102	    }
> 103	
> 104	    private record RerankRequest(String query, List<String> texts, boolean truncate) {

> 101	    def _resolve_device(self, torch: Any) -> str:
> 102	        requested = self.config.device.strip().lower()
> 103	        if requested != "auto":
> 104	            return requested
> 105	        if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
> 106	            return "mps"
> 107	        if torch.cuda.is_available():
> 108	            return "cuda"

> 111	    def score(self, query: str, texts: list[str], truncate: bool) -> list[float]:
> 112	        if self._model is None or self._tokenizer is None or self._torch is None:
> 113	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker model has not been loaded")
> 114	
> 115	        scores: list[float] = []
> 116	        with self._inference_lock, self._torch.inference_mode():
> 117	            for start in range(0, len(texts), self.config.batch_size):
> 118	                batch = texts[start : start + self.config.batch_size]
> 119	                tokenization: dict[str, Any] = {
> 120	                    "padding": True,
> 121	                    "truncation": truncate,
> 122	                    "return_tensors": "pt",
> 123	                }
> 124	                if truncate:
> 125	                    tokenization["max_length"] = self.config.max_length
> 126	                inputs = self._tokenizer([query] * len(batch), batch, **tokenization)
> 127	                inputs = {name: tensor.to(self.device) for name, tensor in inputs.items()}
> 128	                logits = self._model(**inputs, return_dict=True).logits.reshape(-1).float()
> 129	                if self.config.normalize:
> 130	                    logits = self._torch.sigmoid(logits)
> 131	                scores.extend(float(value) for value in logits.cpu().tolist())
> 132	        if len(scores) != len(texts):
> 133	            raise RuntimeError("Reranker returned an unexpected score count")
> 134	        return scores

> 157	        boolean failedCoreStage = requirementOutcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED
> 158	                || request.includeVersionCorpus() && corpusOutcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED
> 159	                || codeOutcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED;
> 160	        if (requirements.isEmpty() && corpus.isEmpty() && code.isEmpty() && failedCoreStage) {
> 161	            throw new RagUnavailableException(warnings);
> 162	        }
> 163	
> 164	        RagOutcomeStatus status = !warnings.isEmpty()
> 165	                ? RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED
> 166	                : requirements.isEmpty() && corpus.isEmpty() && code.isEmpty()
> 167	                        ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 168	        RetrievalBundle bundle = new RetrievalBundle(request.query(), request.profile(), projectId, documentId,
> 169	                version, requirements, corpus, code);
> 170	        RagOutcome<RetrievalBundle> outcome = new RagOutcome<>(status, bundle, warnings, diagnostics);
> 171	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS || status == RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS) {
> 172	            resultCache.put(request, projectId, documentId, version, limit, outcome);
> 173	        }
> 174	        return outcome;

> 177	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 178	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 179	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 180	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 181	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 182	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 183	        }
> 184	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 185	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 186	    }

> 188	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {
> 189	        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(
> 190	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));
> 191	    }

> 193	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 194	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 195	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 196	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 197	        try {
> 198	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 199	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 200	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 201	            return outcome;
> 202	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 203	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 204	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 205	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 206	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 207	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 208	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 209	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 210	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 211	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 212	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 213	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 214	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 215	        }
> 216	    }
> 217	
> 218	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 219	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 220	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 221	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 222	        try {
> 223	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 224	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 225	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 226	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 227	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 228	            return outcome;
> 229	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 230	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 231	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 232	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 233	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 234	            return outcome;
> 235	        }
> 236	    }

> 238	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 239	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 240	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 241	            if (value != null) {
> 242	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 243	            }
> 244	        }
> 245	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 246	    }

> 270	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 271	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 272	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 273	        }
> 274	    }

> 276	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 277	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 278	    }

> 280	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 281	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 282	    }

> 34	    /** 构造可显式回退到 0.8 child-only passage 的重排器。 */
> 35	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties, JsonMapper jsonMapper,
> 36	                           boolean enrichedPassageEnabled) {
> 37	        this.client = client;
> 38	        this.properties = properties;
> 39	        this.jsonMapper = jsonMapper;
> 40	        this.enrichedPassageEnabled = enrichedPassageEnabled;
> 41	    }
