> 43	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }

> 73	        return enrichedPassageEnabled ? passage(chunk) : normalize(chunk.childText());
> 74	    }

> 76	    static String passage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }
> 83	
> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }
> 95	
> 96	    private static String normalize(String value) {
> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;
> 31	    private final ChatClient chatClient;
> 32	    private final RagProperties properties;
> 33	    private final RagObservability observability;
> 34	
> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;
> 39	        this.properties = properties;
> 40	        this.observability = observability;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }

> 118	    }

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
> 2	"""Generate a versioned, vector-free manifest for code and requirement sources."""
> 3	from __future__ import annotations
> 4	
> 5	import argparse
> 6	import hashlib
> 7	import json
> 8	import subprocess
> 9	from pathlib import Path
> 10	from typing import Iterable
> 11	
> 12	
> 13	def run(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
> 14	    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=repo, text=True).strip()
> 15	
> 16	
> 17	def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
> 18	    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
> 19	
> 20	
> 21	def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
> 22	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
> 23	    with path.open("rb") as stream:
> 24	        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
> 25	            digest.update(block)
> 26	    return digest.hexdigest()
> 27	
> 28	
> 29	def changed_files(repo: Path, base: str, commit: str) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
> 30	    output = run(repo, "diff", "--name-status", "-M", base, commit)
> 31	    result: list[dict[str, object]] = []
> 32	    for line in output.splitlines():
> 33	        fields = line.split("\t")
> 34	        if len(fields) < 2:
> 35	            continue
> 36	        status = fields[0]
> 37	        path = fields[-1].replace("\\", "/")
> 38	        if not path.endswith(".java"):
> 39	            continue
> 40	        entry: dict[str, object] = {"status": status, "path": path}
> 41	        if status.startswith("R") and len(fields) == 3:
> 42	            entry["previousPath"] = fields[1].replace("\\", "/")
> 43	        if status[0] != "D":
> 44	            try:
> 45	                content = subprocess.check_output(
> 46	                    ["git", "show", f"{commit}:{path}"], cwd=repo
> 47	                )
> 48	                entry["contentHash"] = sha256_bytes(content)
> 49	                entry["bytes"] = len(content)
> 50	            except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
> 51	                entry["contentHash"] = None
> 52	        result.append(entry)
> 53	    return sorted(result, key=lambda item: str(item["path"]))
> 54	
> 55	
> 56	def requirement_files(root: Path, paths: Iterable[str]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
> 57	    result = []
> 58	    for raw in paths:
> 59	        path = Path(raw).expanduser().resolve()
> 60	        if not path.is_file():
> 61	            raise SystemExit(f"requirement source does not exist: {path}")
> 62	        try:
> 63	            display_path = str(path.relative_to(root))
> 64	        except ValueError:
> 65	            display_path = str(path)
> 66	        result.append({
> 67	            "path": display_path,
> 68	            "contentHash": sha256_file(path),
> 69	            "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
> 70	        })
> 71	    return result
> 72

> 319	def source_state(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 320	    commit = command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=root)
> 321	    status = command("git", "status", "--porcelain", cwd=root)
> 322	    relevant = evaluation_source_paths(root)
> 323	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
> 324	    file_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
> 325	    for path in relevant:
> 326	        data = path.read_bytes()
> 327	        relative = str(path.relative_to(root))
> 328	        file_hashes[relative] = sha256_bytes(data)
> 329	        digest.update(relative.encode("utf-8"))
> 330	        digest.update(b"\0")
> 331	        digest.update(data)
> 332	    return {
> 333	        "gitCommit": commit,
> 334	        "workingTreeDirty": bool(status),
> 335	        "evaluationSourceSha256": digest.hexdigest(),
> 336	        "files": file_hashes,
> 337	    }

> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }
> 85	
> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }

> 118	    }

> 165	    /** 读取源码片段，用于前端点击检索结果后展示。 */
> 166	    public SourceSnippet source(String projectId, String filePath, Integer startLine, Integer endLine) throws IOException {
> 167	        if (filePath == null || filePath.isBlank()) {
> 168	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("filePath required");
> 169	        }
> 170	        String repoPath = resolveRepositoryPath(projectId);
> 171	        Path root = Path.of(repoPath).toRealPath();
> 172	        Path file = root.resolve(filePath).normalize().toRealPath();
> 173	        if (!file.startsWith(root)) {
> 174	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("filePath escapes repository root");
> 175	        }
> 176	        List<String> lines = Files.readAllLines(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
> 177	        int start = Math.max(1, startLine == null ? 1 : startLine);
> 178	        int end = Math.min(lines.size(), endLine == null ? Math.min(lines.size(), start + 120) : endLine);
> 179	        if (start > end) {
> 180	            start = end;
> 181	        }
> 182	        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
> 183	        for (int line = start; line <= end; line++) {
> 184	            text.append(String.format("%5d  %s%n", line, lines.get(line - 1)));
> 185	        }
> 186	        return new SourceSnippet(filePath, start, end, text.toString());
> 187	    }

> 238	    private String resolveView(String query, String view) {
> 239	        if (view != null && !view.isBlank() && !"auto".equalsIgnoreCase(view)) {
> 240	            return view;
> 241	        }
> 242	        if (query != null && query.matches(".*(链路|流程|调用|路径|flow|call).*")) {
> 243	            return "flow";
> 244	        }
> 245	        if (query != null && query.matches(".*(类|class|对象|模型).*")) {
> 246	            return "class";
> 247	        }
> 248	        if (query != null && query.matches(".*(函数|方法|method|function|接口).*")) {
> 249	            return "method";
> 250	        }
> 251	        return "structure";
> 252	    }

> 79	        int resolvedLimit = Math.min(Math.max(limit == null ? 10 : limit, 1), 50);

> 84	    /** 同时检索当前项目与同组对端（不同 side）项目的代码 chunk。 */
> 85	    private List<CodeChunk> searchCrossSide(String query, String projectId, int limit) {
> 86	        String resolvedProject = projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 87	        List<String> projectIds = new ArrayList<>();
> 88	        projectIds.add(resolvedProject);
> 89	        try {
> 90	            RagProperties.ProjectConfig current = projectRegistry.require(resolvedProject);
> 91	            String group = current.group();
> 92	            String side = current.side();
> 93	            if (group != null && !group.isBlank()) {
> 94	                projectRegistry.findByGroup(group).stream()
> 95	                        .filter(project -> !resolvedProject.equals(project.id()))
> 96	                        .filter(project -> side == null || side.isBlank() || !side.equals(project.side()))
> 97	                        .map(RagProperties.ProjectConfig::id)
> 98	                        .forEach(projectIds::add);
> 99	            }
> 100	        }
> 101	        catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
> 102	            log.warn("Cross-side search is using only the resolved project because project metadata is unavailable: {}",
> 103	                    resolvedProject, exception);
> 104	        }
> 105	        return projectIds.stream()
> 106	                .flatMap(pid -> safeSearch(query, pid, limit))
> 107	                .limit(limit)
> 108	                .toList();
> 109	    }

> 116	            log.warn("Code search failed for project {}; omitting that project from cross-side results",
> 117	                    projectId, exception);
> 118	            return Stream.empty();
> 119	        }
> 120	    }

> 24	/** Executes the configured BGE then optional LLM requirement rerank policy. */
> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;

> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }

> 184	            text.append(String.format("%5d  %s%n", line, lines.get(line - 1)));
> 185	        }
> 186	        return new SourceSnippet(filePath, start, end, text.toString());

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}
> ```

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 4	
> 5	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 6	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 7	import java.util.List;
> 8	import java.util.Locale;
> 9	import java.util.Map;
> 10	
> 11	/**
> 12	 * 稀疏向量化器：基于字符级分词与哈希映射生成归一化稀疏向量。
> 13	 */
> 14	@Component
> 15	public class SparseVectorizer {
> 16	
> 17	    /**
> 18	     * 将文本转换为稀疏向量（indices + values），用于 Qdrant 稀疏检索。
> 19	     */
> 20	    public SparseVector vectorize(String text) {
> 21	        Map<Integer, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 22	        for (String token : tokenize(text)) {
> 23	            int index = token.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff;
> 24	            weights.merge(index, 1.0f, Float::sum);
> 25	        }
> 26	        float norm = (float) Math.sqrt(weights.values().stream().mapToDouble(v -> v * v).sum());
> 27	        List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 28	        List<Float> values = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 29	        weights.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()).forEach(entry -> {
> 30	            indices.add(entry.getKey());
> 31	            values.add(norm == 0 ? entry.getValue() : entry.getValue() / norm);
> 32	        });
> 33	        return new SparseVector(indices, values);
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    /** 中英文混合分词：汉字按单字/双字切分，英文按词切分。 */
> 37	    private List<String> tokenize(String text) {
> 38	        String normalized = text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^\\p{IsHan}a-z0-9]+", " ");
> 39	        List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
> 40	        for (String word : normalized.split("\\s+")) {
> 41	            if (word.isBlank()) continue;
> 42	            if (word.matches(".*\\p{IsHan}.*")) {
> 43	                for (int i = 0; i < word.length(); i++) {
> 44	                    tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 1));
> 45	                    if (i + 1 < word.length()) tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 2));
> 46	                }
> 47	            }
> 48	            else if (word.length() > 1) {
> 49	                tokens.add(word);
> 50	            }
> 51	        }
> 52	        return tokens;
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    /** 稀疏向量：索引列表与对应权重值。 */
> 56	    public record SparseVector(List<Integer> indices, List<Float> values) {
> 57	    }
> 58	}

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.cache.BoundedTtlCache;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 5	import org.springframework.ai.embedding.EmbeddingModel;
> 6	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 7	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 8	
> 9	import java.time.Duration;
> 10	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 11	import java.util.List;
> 12	
> 13	/**
> 14	 * 以受控批次生成向量。批次失败时自动二分降级，避免并发请求压垮本地嵌入服务。
> 15	 */
> 16	@Component
> 17	public class EmbeddingBatcher {
> 18	
> 19	    static final int DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32;
> 20	
> 21	    private final EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;
> 22	    private final BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache;
> 23	    private final String modelFingerprint;
> 24	
> 25	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel) {
> 26	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(Duration.ZERO, 0));
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    @Autowired
> 30	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, RagProperties properties) {
> 31	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(
> 32	                Duration.ofSeconds(properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheTtlSeconds()),
> 33	                properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheMaxEntries()));
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache) {
> 37	        this.embeddingModel = embeddingModel;
> 38	        this.cache = cache;
> 39	        this.modelFingerprint = embeddingModel.getClass().getName();
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 43	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 44	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 45	            return List.of();
> 46	        }
> 47	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 48	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 49	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 50	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 51	        }
> 52	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 56	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 57	        List<String> misses = new ArrayList<>();
> 58	        List<Integer> missIndexes = new ArrayList<>();
> 59	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 60	            String key = key(texts.get(index));
> 61	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 62	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 63	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 64	            } else {
> 65	                misses.add(texts.get(index));
> 66	                missIndexes.add(index);
> 67	            }
> 68	        }
> 69	        if (!misses.isEmpty()) {
> 70	            List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(misses, absoluteStart);
> 71	            for (int index = 0; index < embedded.size(); index++) {
> 72	                float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 73	                int resultIndex = missIndexes.get(index);
> 74	                cache.put(key(texts.get(resultIndex)), vector.clone());
> 75	                result.set(resultIndex, vector);
> 76	            }
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private String key(String text) {
> 82	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 86	        try {
> 87	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 88	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 89	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 90	            }
> 91	            return vectors;
> 92	        }
> 93	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 94	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 95	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 96	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 97	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 98	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 99	                        exception);
> 100	            }
> 101	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 102	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 103	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 104	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 105	            return vectors;
> 106	        }
> 107	    }
> 108	}

> 93	    private List<CodeChunk> searchCrossSide(String query, String projectId, int limit) {
> 94	        String resolvedProject = projectId == null || projectId.isBlank() ? properties.code().projectId() : projectId;
> 95	        List<String> projectIds = new ArrayList<>();
> 96	        projectIds.add(resolvedProject);

> 99	            String group = current.group();
> 100	            String side = current.side();
> 101	            if (group != null && !group.isBlank()) {
> 102	                projectRegistry.findByGroup(group).stream()
> 103	                        .filter(project -> !resolvedProject.equals(project.id()))
> 104	                        .filter(project -> side == null || side.isBlank() || !side.equals(project.side()))
> 105	                        .map(RagProperties.ProjectConfig::id)
> 106	                        .forEach(projectIds::add);

> 109	        catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {

> 111	                    resolvedProject, exception);

> 114	                .flatMap(pid -> safeSearch(query, pid, limit))

> 179	        Path root = Path.of(repoPath).toRealPath();

> 181	        if (!file.startsWith(root)) {

> 184	        List<String> lines = Files.readAllLines(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
> 185	        int start = Math.max(1, startLine == null ? 1 : startLine);
> 186	        int end = Math.min(lines.size(), endLine == null ? Math.min(lines.size(), start + 120) : endLine);
> 187	        if (start > end) {
> 188	            start = end;
> 189	        }
> 190	        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
> 191	        for (int line = start; line <= end; line++) {
> 192	            text.append(String.format("%5d  %s%n", line, lines.get(line - 1)));
> 193	        }
> 194	        return new SourceSnippet(filePath, start, end, text.toString());

>
> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 4	
> 5	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 6	import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
> 7	import java.util.List;
> 8	import java.util.Locale;
> 9	import java.util.Map;
> 10	
> 11	/**
> 12	 * 稀疏向量化器：基于字符级分词与哈希映射生成归一化稀疏向量。
> 13	 */
> 14	@Component
> 15	public class SparseVectorizer {
> 16	
> 17	    /**
> 18	     * 将文本转换为稀疏向量（indices + values），用于 Qdrant 稀疏检索。
> 19	     */
> 20	    public SparseVector vectorize(String text) {
> 21	        Map<Integer, Float> weights = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 22	        for (String token : tokenize(text)) {
> 23	            int index = token.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff;
> 24	            weights.merge(index, 1.0f, Float::sum);
> 25	        }
> 26	        float norm = (float) Math.sqrt(weights.values().stream().mapToDouble(v -> v * v).sum());
> 27	        List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 28	        List<Float> values = new ArrayList<>(weights.size());
> 29	        weights.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()).forEach(entry -> {
> 30	            indices.add(entry.getKey());
> 31	            values.add(norm == 0 ? entry.getValue() : entry.getValue() / norm);
> 32	        });
> 33	        return new SparseVector(indices, values);
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    /** 中英文混合分词：汉字按单字/双字切分，英文按词切分。 */
> 37	    private List<String> tokenize(String text) {
> 38	        String normalized = text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^\\p{IsHan}a-z0-9]+", " ");
> 39	        List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
> 40	        for (String word : normalized.split("\\s+")) {
> 41	            if (word.isBlank()) continue;
> 42	            if (word.matches(".*\\p{IsHan}.*")) {
> 43	                for (int i = 0; i < word.length(); i++) {
> 44	                    tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 1));
> 45	                    if (i + 1 < word.length()) tokens.add(word.substring(i, i + 2));
> 46	                }
> 47	            }
> 48	            else if (word.length() > 1) {
> 49	                tokens.add(word);
> 50	            }
> 51	        }
> 52	        return tokens;
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    /** 稀疏向量：索引列表与对应权重值。 */
> 56	    public record SparseVector(List<Integer> indices, List<Float> values) {
> 57	    }
> 58	}

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
> 5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
> 6	
> 7	import java.time.Duration;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);

> 43	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }

> 73	        return enrichedPassageEnabled ? passage(chunk) : normalize(chunk.childText());
> 74	    }

> 76	    static String passage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }
> 83	
> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }

> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }

> 14	 * 以受控批次生成向量。批次失败时自动二分降级，避免并发请求压垮本地嵌入服务。

> 16	@Component
> 17	public class EmbeddingBatcher {
> 18	
> 19	    static final int DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32;
> 20	
> 21	    private final EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;
> 22	    private final BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache;
> 23	    private final String modelFingerprint;

> 29	    @Autowired
> 30	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, RagProperties properties) {
> 31	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(
> 32	                Duration.ofSeconds(properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheTtlSeconds()),

> 36	    EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache) {
> 37	        this.embeddingModel = embeddingModel;
> 38	        this.cache = cache;
> 39	        this.modelFingerprint = embeddingModel.getClass().getName();
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 43	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 44	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 45	            return List.of();
> 46	        }
> 47	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 48	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 49	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 50	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 51	        }
> 52	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 56	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 57	        List<String> misses = new ArrayList<>();
> 58	        List<Integer> missIndexes = new ArrayList<>();
> 59	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 60	            String key = key(texts.get(index));
> 61	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 62	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 63	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 64	            } else {
> 65	                misses.add(texts.get(index));
> 66	                missIndexes.add(index);
> 67	            }
> 68	        }
> 69	        if (!misses.isEmpty()) {
> 70	            List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(misses, absoluteStart);
> 71	            for (int index = 0; index < embedded.size(); index++) {
> 72	                float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 73	                int resultIndex = missIndexes.get(index);
> 74	                cache.put(key(texts.get(resultIndex)), vector.clone());
> 75	                result.set(resultIndex, vector);
> 76	            }
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private String key(String text) {
> 82	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 86	        try {
> 87	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 88	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 89	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 90	            }
> 91	            return vectors;
> 92	        }
> 93	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 94	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 95	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 96	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 97	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 98	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 99	                        exception);
> 100	            }
> 101	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 102	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 103	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 104	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 105	            return vectors;
> 106	        }
> 107	    }
> 108	}

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.versioning;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.ProjectRegistry;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.model.ChunkRecord;
> 5	import com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.QdrantHybridStore;
> 6	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.RequirementSnapshotModels.Entry;
> 7	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.RequirementSnapshotModels.Snapshot;
> 8	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.ChangeType;
> 9	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.RequirementChange;
> 10	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.RequirementDiff;
> 11	import com.example.requirementrag.versioning.VersionModels.VersionManifest;
> 12	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
> 13	
> 14	import java.util.ArrayList;
> 15	import java.util.Comparator;
> 16	import java.util.List;
> 17	import java.util.Optional;
> 18	
> 19	/** Compares requirement parent chunks from reviewable snapshots, with Qdrant payloads as a fallback. */
> 20	@Service
> 21	public class RequirementVersionDiffService {
> 22	    private static final int EXCERPT_LIMIT = 360;
> 23	
> 24	    private final QdrantHybridStore store;
> 25	    private final ProjectRegistry projectRegistry;
> 26	    private final RequirementSnapshotRepository snapshots;
> 27	
> 28	    public RequirementVersionDiffService(QdrantHybridStore store, ProjectRegistry projectRegistry,
> 29	                                         RequirementSnapshotRepository snapshots) {
> 30	        this.store = store;
> 31	        this.projectRegistry = projectRegistry;
> 32	        this.snapshots = snapshots;
> 33	    }
> 34	
> 35	    public RequirementDiff compare(String projectId, VersionManifest from, VersionManifest to) {
> 36	        if (!hasReference(from) || !hasReference(to)) return RequirementDiff.unavailable();
> 37	        List<ChunkRecord> before;
> 38	        List<ChunkRecord> after;
> 39	        Optional<Snapshot> beforeSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 40	                from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 41	        Optional<Snapshot> afterSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 42	                to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 43	        List<RequirementChunkDiff.ParentChange> parentChanges;
> 44	        if (beforeSnapshot.isPresent() && afterSnapshot.isPresent()) {
> 45	            before = chunks(beforeSnapshot.get());
> 46	            after = chunks(afterSnapshot.get());
> 47	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after);
> 48	        } else {
> 49	            String collection = projectRegistry.resolveRequirementCollection(projectId);
> 50	            before = store.scrollVersion(collection, from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 51	            after = store.scrollVersion(collection, to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 52	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after).stream()
> 53	                    .filter(change -> change.type() != RequirementChunkDiff.Type.REMOVED)
> 54	                    .toList();
> 55	        }
> 56	        List<RequirementChange> changes = parentChanges.stream()
> 57	                .map(item -> change(ChangeType.valueOf(item.type().name()), item.before(), item.after()))
> 58	                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
> 59	        changes.sort(Comparator.comparing(RequirementChange::filename,
> 60	                        Comparator.nullsFirst(String::compareTo))
> 61	                .thenComparingInt(RequirementChange::parentOrder)
> 62	                .thenComparing(change -> change.type().name()));
> 63	        return new RequirementDiff(VersionModels.Availability.AVAILABLE,
> 64	                count(changes, ChangeType.ADDED), count(changes, ChangeType.MODIFIED),
> 65	                count(changes, ChangeType.REMOVED), changes);
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    private List<ChunkRecord> chunks(Snapshot snapshot) {
> 69	        return snapshot.entries().stream().map(entry -> chunk(snapshot, entry)).toList();
> 70	    }
> 71	
> 72	    private ChunkRecord chunk(Snapshot snapshot, Entry entry) {
> 73	        return new ChunkRecord(entry.entryId() + "-child", snapshot.documentId(), snapshot.requirementVersion(),
> 74	                entry.filename(), entry.entryId(), entry.text(), entry.text(), entry.contentHash(),
> 75	                entry.parentOrder(), 0);
> 76	    }
> 77	
> 78	    private RequirementChange change(ChangeType type, ChunkRecord before, ChunkRecord after) {
> 79	        ChunkRecord source = after != null ? after : before;
> 80	        return new RequirementChange(type, source.filename(), source.parentId(), source.parentOrder(),
> 81	                before == null ? null : RequirementChunkDiff.hash(before), after == null ? null : RequirementChunkDiff.hash(after),
> 82	                before == null ? null : excerpt(before.parentText()), after == null ? null : excerpt(after.parentText()));
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private int count(List<RequirementChange> changes, ChangeType type) {
> 86	        return (int) changes.stream().filter(change -> change.type() == type).count();
> 87	    }
> 88	
> 89	    private boolean hasReference(VersionManifest manifest) {
> 90	        return hasText(manifest.requirementDocumentId()) && hasText(manifest.requirementVersion());
> 91	    }
> 92	
> 93	    private String excerpt(String text) {
> 94	        String normalized = safe(text).replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 95	        return normalized.length() <= EXCERPT_LIMIT ? normalized : normalized.substring(0, EXCERPT_LIMIT) + "…";
> 96	    }
> 97	
> 98	    private String safe(String value) { return value == null ? "" : value; }
> 99	    private boolean hasText(String value) { return value != null && !value.isBlank(); }
> 100	}

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.cache;
> 2	
> 3	import java.time.Clock;
> 4	import java.time.Duration;
> 5	import java.util.Comparator;
> 6	import java.util.Map;
> 7	import java.util.Optional;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Small process-local cache with explicit TTL and capacity bounds. */
> 11	public final class BoundedTtlCache<K, V> {
> 12	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<K, Entry<V>> entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 13	    private final long ttlMillis;
> 14	    private final int maxEntries;
> 15	    private final Clock clock;
> 16	
> 17	    public BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries) {
> 18	        this(ttl, maxEntries, Clock.systemUTC());
> 19	    }
> 20	
> 21	    BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {
> 22	        this.ttlMillis = Math.max(0, ttl == null ? 0 : ttl.toMillis());
> 23	        this.maxEntries = Math.max(0, maxEntries);
> 24	        this.clock = clock;
> 25	    }
> 26	
> 27	    public Optional<V> get(K key) {
> 28	        if (!enabled() || key == null) return Optional.empty();
> 29	        Entry<V> entry = entries.get(key);
> 30	        if (entry == null) return Optional.empty();
> 31	        if (entry.expiresAtMillis() <= clock.millis()) {
> 32	            entries.remove(key, entry);
> 33	            return Optional.empty();
> 34	        }
> 35	        return Optional.of(entry.value());
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    public void put(K key, V value) {
> 39	        if (!enabled() || key == null || value == null) return;
> 40	        long now = clock.millis();
> 41	        removeExpired(now);
> 42	        entries.put(key, new Entry<>(value, now, now + ttlMillis));
> 43	        trimToCapacity();
> 44	    }
> 45	
> 46	    public void invalidate(K key) {
> 47	        if (key != null) entries.remove(key);
> 48	    }
> 49	
> 50	    public void invalidateWhere(java.util.function.Predicate<K> predicate) {
> 51	        if (predicate != null) entries.keySet().removeIf(predicate);
> 52	    }
> 53	
> 54	    public void clear() {
> 55	        entries.clear();
> 56	    }
> 57	
> 58	    int size() {
> 59	        return entries.size();
> 60	    }
> 61	
> 62	    private boolean enabled() {
> 63	        return ttlMillis > 0 && maxEntries > 0;
> 64	    }
> 65	
> 66	    private void removeExpired(long now) {
> 67	        entries.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getValue().expiresAtMillis() <= now);
> 68	    }
> 69	
> 70	    private void trimToCapacity() {
> 71	        while (entries.size() > maxEntries) {
> 72	            entries.entrySet().stream()
> 73	                    .min(Comparator.comparingLong(entry -> entry.getValue().createdAtMillis()))
> 74	                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
> 75	                    .ifPresent(entries::remove);
> 76	        }
> 77	    }
> 78	
> 79	    private record Entry<V>(V value, long createdAtMillis, long expiresAtMillis) {
> 80	    }
> 81	}

> 13	/**

> 16	@Component
> 17	public class EmbeddingBatcher {
> 18	
> 19	    static final int DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32;
> 20	
> 21	    private final EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;
> 22	    private final BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache;
> 23	    private final String modelFingerprint;
> 24	
> 25	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel) {
> 26	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(Duration.ZERO, 0));
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    @Autowired
> 30	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, RagProperties properties) {
> 31	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(
> 32	                Duration.ofSeconds(properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheTtlSeconds()),
> 33	                properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheMaxEntries()));
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache) {
> 37	        this.embeddingModel = embeddingModel;
> 38	        this.cache = cache;
> 39	        this.modelFingerprint = embeddingModel.getClass().getName();
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 43	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 44	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 45	            return List.of();
> 46	        }
> 47	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 48	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 49	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 50	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 51	        }
> 52	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 56	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 57	        List<String> misses = new ArrayList<>();
> 58	        List<Integer> missIndexes = new ArrayList<>();
> 59	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 60	            String key = key(texts.get(index));
> 61	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 62	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 63	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 64	            } else {
> 65	                misses.add(texts.get(index));
> 66	                missIndexes.add(index);
> 67	            }
> 68	        }
> 69	        if (!misses.isEmpty()) {
> 70	            List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(misses, absoluteStart);
> 71	            for (int index = 0; index < embedded.size(); index++) {
> 72	                float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 73	                int resultIndex = missIndexes.get(index);
> 74	                cache.put(key(texts.get(resultIndex)), vector.clone());
> 75	                result.set(resultIndex, vector);
> 76	            }
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private String key(String text) {
> 82	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 86	        try {
> 87	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 88	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 89	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 90	            }
> 91	            return vectors;
> 92	        }
> 93	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 94	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 95	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 96	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 97	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 98	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 99	                        exception);
> 100	            }
> 101	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 102	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 103	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 104	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 105	            return vectors;
> 106	        }
> 107	    }
> 108	}

> 42	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 43	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 44	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 45	            return List.of();
> 46	        }
> 47	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 48	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 49	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 50	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 51	        }
> 52	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 53	    }

> 55	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 56	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 57	        List<String> misses = new ArrayList<>();
> 58	        List<Integer> missIndexes = new ArrayList<>();
> 59	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 60	            String key = key(texts.get(index));
> 61	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 62	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 63	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 64	            } else {
> 65	                misses.add(texts.get(index));
> 66	                missIndexes.add(index);
> 67	            }
> 68	        }
> 69	        if (!misses.isEmpty()) {
> 70	            List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(misses, absoluteStart);
> 71	            for (int index = 0; index < embedded.size(); index++) {
> 72	                float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 73	                int resultIndex = missIndexes.get(index);
> 74	                cache.put(key(texts.get(resultIndex)), vector.clone());
> 75	                result.set(resultIndex, vector);
> 76	            }
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private String key(String text) {
> 82	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 86	        try {
> 87	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 88	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 89	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 90	            }
> 91	            return vectors;
> 92	        }
> 93	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 94	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 95	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 96	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 97	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 98	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 99	                        exception);
> 100	            }
> 101	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 102	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 103	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 104	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 105	            return vectors;
> 106	        }
> 107	    }
> 108	}

> 2	
> 3	import java.time.Clock;
> 4	import java.time.Duration;
> 5	import java.util.Comparator;

> 7	import java.util.Optional;
> 8	import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
> 9	
> 10	/** Small process-local cache with explicit TTL and capacity bounds. */
> 11	public final class BoundedTtlCache<K, V> {
> 12	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<K, Entry<V>> entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 13	    private final long ttlMillis;
> 14	    private final int maxEntries;
> 15	    private final Clock clock;
> 16	
> 17	    public BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries) {
> 18	        this(ttl, maxEntries, Clock.systemUTC());
> 19	    }
> 20	
> 21	    BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {
> 22	        this.ttlMillis = Math.max(0, ttl == null ? 0 : ttl.toMillis());
> 23	        this.maxEntries = Math.max(0, maxEntries);
> 24	        this.clock = clock;
> 25	    }
> 26	
> 27	    public Optional<V> get(K key) {
> 28	        if (!enabled() || key == null) return Optional.empty();
> 29	        Entry<V> entry = entries.get(key);
> 30	        if (entry == null) return Optional.empty();
> 31	        if (entry.expiresAtMillis() <= clock.millis()) {
> 32	            entries.remove(key, entry);
> 33	            return Optional.empty();
> 34	        }
> 35	        return Optional.of(entry.value());
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    public void put(K key, V value) {
> 39	        if (!enabled() || key == null || value == null) return;
> 40	        long now = clock.millis();
> 41	        removeExpired(now);
> 42	        entries.put(key, new Entry<>(value, now, now + ttlMillis));
> 43	        trimToCapacity();
> 44	    }
> 45	
> 46	    public void invalidate(K key) {
> 47	        if (key != null) entries.remove(key);
> 48	    }
> 49	
> 50	    public void invalidateWhere(java.util.function.Predicate<K> predicate) {
> 51	        if (predicate != null) entries.keySet().removeIf(predicate);
> 52	    }
> 53	
> 54	    public void clear() {
> 55	        entries.clear();
> 56	    }
> 57	
> 58	    int size() {
> 59	        return entries.size();
> 60	    }
> 61	
> 62	    private boolean enabled() {
> 63	        return ttlMillis > 0 && maxEntries > 0;
> 64	    }
> 65	
> 66	    private void removeExpired(long now) {
> 67	        entries.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getValue().expiresAtMillis() <= now);
> 68	    }
> 69	
> 70	    private void trimToCapacity() {
> 71	        while (entries.size() > maxEntries) {
> 72	            entries.entrySet().stream()
> 73	                    .min(Comparator.comparingLong(entry -> entry.getValue().createdAtMillis()))
> 74	                    .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
> 75	                    .ifPresent(entries::remove);
> 76	        }
> 77	    }
> 78	
> 79	    private record Entry<V>(V value, long createdAtMillis, long expiresAtMillis) {
> 80	    }
> 81	}

> 16	@Component
> 17	public class EmbeddingBatcher {
> 18	
> 19	    static final int DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32;
> 20	
> 21	    private final EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;
> 22	    private final BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache;
> 23	    private final String modelFingerprint;
> 24	
> 25	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel) {
> 26	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(Duration.ZERO, 0));
> 27	    }
> 28	
> 29	    @Autowired
> 30	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, RagProperties properties) {
> 31	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(
> 32	                Duration.ofSeconds(properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheTtlSeconds()),
> 33	                properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheMaxEntries()));
> 34	    }
> 35	
> 36	    EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache) {
> 37	        this.embeddingModel = embeddingModel;
> 38	        this.cache = cache;
> 39	        this.modelFingerprint = embeddingModel.getClass().getName();
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 43	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 44	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 45	            return List.of();
> 46	        }
> 47	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 48	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 49	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 50	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 51	        }
> 52	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 56	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 57	        List<String> misses = new ArrayList<>();
> 58	        List<Integer> missIndexes = new ArrayList<>();
> 59	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 60	            String key = key(texts.get(index));
> 61	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 62	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 63	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 64	            } else {
> 65	                misses.add(texts.get(index));
> 66	                missIndexes.add(index);
> 67	            }
> 68	        }
> 69	        if (!misses.isEmpty()) {
> 70	            List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(misses, absoluteStart);
> 71	            for (int index = 0; index < embedded.size(); index++) {
> 72	                float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 73	                int resultIndex = missIndexes.get(index);
> 74	                cache.put(key(texts.get(resultIndex)), vector.clone());
> 75	                result.set(resultIndex, vector);
> 76	            }
> 77	        }
> 78	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 79	    }
> 80	
> 81	    private String key(String text) {
> 82	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 83	    }
> 84	
> 85	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 86	        try {
> 87	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 88	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 89	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 90	            }
> 91	            return vectors;
> 92	        }
> 93	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 94	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 95	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 96	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 97	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 98	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 99	                        exception);
> 100	            }
> 101	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 102	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 103	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 104	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 105	            return vectors;
> 106	        }
> 107	    }
> 108	}

> 19	public class HttpBgeReranker implements BgeReranker {
> 20	
> 21	    static final int MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS = 700;
> 22	    static final int MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS = 900;
> 23	
> 24	    private final RestClient client;

> 31	        this(client, properties, jsonMapper, true);

> 33	
> 34	    /** 构造可显式回退到 0.8 child-only passage 的重排器。 */
> 35	    public HttpBgeReranker(RestClient client, RagProperties.Bge properties, JsonMapper jsonMapper,
> 36	                           boolean enrichedPassageEnabled) {
> 37	        this.client = client;
> 38	        this.properties = properties;
> 39	        this.jsonMapper = jsonMapper;
> 40	        this.enrichedPassageEnabled = enrichedPassageEnabled;
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }
> 70	
> 71	
> 72	    private String requestPassage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 73	        return enrichedPassageEnabled ? passage(chunk) : normalize(chunk.childText());
> 74	    }
> 75	
> 76	    static String passage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }
> 83	
> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }
> 95	
> 96	    private static String normalize(String value) {
> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }
> 99	
> 100	    /** 带相关性分数的分块记录。 */

> 102	    }
> 103

> 105	    }

> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }

> 76	    static String passage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }

> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }

> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }

> 182	     * Scoring several children cannot change the final parent order when every candidate belongs to the same parent.

> 186	    private List<ChunkRecord> optimizeSingleParentRerank(List<ChunkRecord> candidates, boolean childFirstRerank) {
> 187	        if (!childFirstRerank || candidates.size() <= 1) {
> 188	            return candidates;
> 189	        }
> 190	        String firstParent = requirementKey(candidates.getFirst());
> 191	        boolean singleParent = candidates.stream().allMatch(candidate -> requirementKey(candidate).equals(firstParent));
> 192	        return singleParent ? List.of(candidates.getFirst()) : candidates;
> 193	    }
