> 195	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 196	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 197	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 198	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 199	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 200	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 201	        }
> 202	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 203	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {

> 211	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 212	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 213	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 214	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 215	        try {
> 216	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 217	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 218	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 219	            return outcome;
> 220	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 221	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 222	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 223	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 224	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 225	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 226	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 227	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 228	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 229	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 230	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 231	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 232	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 233	        }
> 234	    }

> 236	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 237	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 238	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 239	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 240	        try {
> 241	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 242	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 243	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 244	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 245	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 246	            return outcome;
> 247	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 248	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 249	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 250	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 251	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 252	            return outcome;
> 253	        }
> 254	    }

> 256	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 257	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 258	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 259	            if (value != null) {
> 260	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 261	            }
> 262	        }
> 263	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 264	    }

> 286	    private void recordOutcome(RagOutcome<?> outcome, String documentId, String version) {
> 287	        for (RagStageDiagnostic diagnostic : outcome.stageDiagnostics()) {
> 288	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 289	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 290	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 291	        }
> 292	    }

> 294	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 295	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 296	    }

> 298	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 299	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 300	    }

> 182	     * Scoring several children cannot change the final parent order when every candidate belongs to the same parent.

> 186	    private List<ChunkRecord> optimizeSingleParentRerank(List<ChunkRecord> candidates, boolean childFirstRerank) {

> 190	        String firstParent = requirementKey(candidates.getFirst());
> 191	        boolean singleParent = candidates.stream().allMatch(candidate -> requirementKey(candidate).equals(firstParent));

> 195	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 196	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 197	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 198	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 199	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 200	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 201	        }
> 202	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 203	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 204	    }

> 206	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {

> 208	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));

> 211	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 212	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 213	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 214	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 215	        try {
> 216	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 217	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 218	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 219	            return outcome;
> 220	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 221	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 222	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 223	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 224	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 225	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 226	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 227	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 228	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 229	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 230	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 231	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 232	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 233	        }
> 234	    }
> 235	
> 236	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 237	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 238	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 239	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 240	        try {
> 241	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 242	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 243	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 244	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 245	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 246	            return outcome;
> 247	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 248	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 249	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 250	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 251	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 252	            return outcome;
> 253	        }
> 254	    }
> 255	
> 256	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 257	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 258	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 259	            if (value != null) {
> 260	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 261	            }
> 262	        }
> 263	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 264	    }

> 269	    }

> 273	    }

> 278	    }

> 280	    private void collect(RagOutcome<?> outcome, List<RagWarning> warnings,
> 281	                         List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 282	        warnings.addAll(outcome.warnings());
> 283	        diagnostics.addAll(outcome.stageDiagnostics());

> 286	    private void recordOutcome(RagOutcome<?> outcome, String documentId, String version) {
> 287	        for (RagStageDiagnostic diagnostic : outcome.stageDiagnostics()) {
> 288	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 289	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 290	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 291	        }
> 292	    }
> 293	
> 294	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 295	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 296	    }
> 297	
> 298	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 299	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 300	    }

> 191	        boolean singleParent = candidates.stream().allMatch(candidate -> requirementKey(candidate).equals(firstParent));

> 195	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> submit(String stage,
> 196	                                                               Supplier<RagOutcome<List<T>>> action,
> 197	                                                               long timeoutMs) {
> 198	        if (!circuitBreaker.allow(stage)) {
> 199	            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage,
> 200	                    "RETRIEVAL_CIRCUIT_OPEN", "检索依赖暂时熔断", 0));
> 201	        }
> 202	        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(action, retrievalExecutor)
> 203	                .orTimeout(timeoutMs, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
> 204	    }
> 205	
> 206	    private <T> CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> completed(String stage) {
> 207	        return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(
> 208	                RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), stage, 0, 0));
> 209	    }

> 211	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> await(CompletableFuture<RagOutcome<List<T>>> future, String stage,
> 212	                                          String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 213	                                          String documentId, String version) {
> 214	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 215	        try {
> 216	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = future.get();
> 217	            if (outcome.status() == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 218	            else circuitBreaker.success(stage);
> 219	            return outcome;
> 220	        } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
> 221	            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
> 222	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 223	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 224	        } catch (ExecutionException exception) {
> 225	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 226	            RuntimeException failure = exception.getCause() instanceof TimeoutException
> 227	                    ? new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch timed out", exception.getCause())
> 228	                    : new IllegalStateException("retrieval branch failed", exception.getCause());
> 229	            circuitBreaker.failure(stage);
> 230	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 231	                    duration, warningCode, failure);
> 232	            return RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration);
> 233	        }
> 234	    }
> 235	
> 236	    private <T> RagOutcome<List<T>> retrieve(String stage, String documentId, String version,
> 237	                                              String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 238	                                              Supplier<List<T>> action) {
> 239	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 240	        try {
> 241	            List<T> result = action.get();
> 242	            List<T> data = result == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(result);
> 243	            RagOutcomeStatus status = data.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS : RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS;
> 244	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.of(status, data, stage, elapsedMillis(started), data.size());
> 245	            recordOutcome(outcome, documentId, version);
> 246	            return outcome;
> 247	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 248	            long durationMs = elapsedMillis(started);
> 249	            RagOutcome<List<T>> outcome = RagOutcome.failed(List.of(), stage, warningCode, warningMessage, durationMs);
> 250	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED,
> 251	                    durationMs, warningCode, exception);
> 252	            return outcome;
> 253	        }
> 254	    }
> 255	
> 256	    private <T> List<T> deduplicate(List<T> values, Function<T, String> keyFunction) {
> 257	        Map<String, T> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
> 258	        for (T value : values == null ? List.<T>of() : values) {
> 259	            if (value != null) {
> 260	                unique.putIfAbsent(keyFunction.apply(value), value);
> 261	            }
> 262	        }
> 263	        return List.copyOf(unique.values());
> 264	    }
> 265	
> 266	    private String requirementCandidateKey(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 267	        return hasText(chunk.id()) ? chunk.id()
> 268	                : requirementKey(chunk) + ':' + chunk.childOrder() + ':' + chunk.contentHash();
> 269	    }
> 270	
> 271	    private String requirementKey(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 272	        return hasText(chunk.parentId()) ? chunk.parentId() : chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder();
> 273	    }
> 274	
> 275	    private String codeKey(CodeChunk chunk) {
> 276	        return hasText(chunk.id()) ? chunk.id()
> 277	                : chunk.filePath() + ':' + chunk.symbolName() + ':' + chunk.startLine();
> 278	    }
> 279	
> 280	    private void collect(RagOutcome<?> outcome, List<RagWarning> warnings,
> 281	                         List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 282	        warnings.addAll(outcome.warnings());
> 283	        diagnostics.addAll(outcome.stageDiagnostics());
> 284	    }
> 285	
> 286	    private void recordOutcome(RagOutcome<?> outcome, String documentId, String version) {
> 287	        for (RagStageDiagnostic diagnostic : outcome.stageDiagnostics()) {
> 288	            String warningCode = outcome.warnings().isEmpty() ? null : outcome.warnings().getFirst().code();
> 289	            observability.outcome(diagnostic.stage(), documentId, version, diagnostic.status(),
> 290	                    diagnostic.durationMs(), warningCode, null);
> 291	        }
> 292	    }
> 293	
> 294	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 295	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 296	    }
> 297	
> 298	    private boolean hasText(String value) {
> 299	        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
> 300	    }
> 301	}

> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)

> 21	/**
> 22	 * RAG 流水线可观测性：阶段计时、指标上报与结构化日志。
> 23	 */
> 24	@Component
> 25	public class RagObservability {
> 26	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RagObservability.class);
> 27	    private static final int MAX_RECENT_EVENTS = 200;
> 28	    private final ObservationRegistry observationRegistry;
> 29	    private final MeterRegistry meterRegistry;
> 30	    private final List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents = new ArrayList<>();
> 31	
> 32	    /** 注入 Micrometer 观测与指标注册表。 */
> 33	    public RagObservability(ObservationRegistry observationRegistry, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
> 34	        this.observationRegistry = observationRegistry;
> 35	        this.meterRegistry = meterRegistry;
> 36	    }
> 37	
> 38	    /** 观测带返回值的操作，记录耗时、成功/失败日志与失败计数。 */
> 39	    public <T> T observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Supplier<T> action) {
> 40	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 41	        Observation observation = Observation.createNotStarted("rag.stage", observationRegistry)
> 42	                .contextualName("rag " + stage)
> 43	                .lowCardinalityKeyValue("rag.stage", stage)
> 44	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.id", safe(documentId))
> 45	                .highCardinalityKeyValue("rag.document.version", safe(version));
> 46	        try {
> 47	            T result = observation.observe(action);
> 48	            log.atInfo().addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 49	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 50	                    .addKeyValue("status", "success").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 51	                    .log("RAG stage completed");
> 52	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "success", elapsedMillis(started), ""));
> 53	            return result;
> 54	        }
> 55	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 56	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 57	                    .tag("exception", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 58	            log.atError().setCause(exception).addKeyValue("event", "rag_stage").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 59	                    .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 60	                    .addKeyValue("status", "failure").addKeyValue("durationMs", elapsedMillis(started))
> 61	                    .log("RAG stage failed");
> 62	            remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), "failed",
> 63	                    elapsedMillis(started), exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
> 64	            throw exception;
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    /** 观测无返回值的操作。 */
> 69	    public void observe(String stage, String documentId, String version, Runnable action) {
> 70	        observe(stage, documentId, version, () -> { action.run(); return null; });
> 71	    }
> 72	
> 73	    /** 记录已被调用方归类的阶段结果；公开诊断只保存稳定 warning code。 */
> 74	    public void outcome(String stage, String documentId, String version, RagOutcomeStatus status,
> 75	                        long durationMs, String warningCode, RuntimeException failure) {
> 76	        String normalizedStatus = status.name().toLowerCase();
> 77	        Counter.builder("rag.stage.outcomes").tag("stage", stage).tag("status", normalizedStatus)
> 78	                .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 79	        if (warningCode != null && !warningCode.isBlank()) {
> 80	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.warnings").tag("stage", stage).tag("code", warningCode)
> 81	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 82	        }
> 83	        var event = log.atInfo();
> 84	        if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED) {
> 85	            event = log.atWarn();
> 86	        } else if (status == RagOutcomeStatus.FAILED) {
> 87	            Counter.builder("rag.stage.failures").tag("stage", stage)
> 88	                    .tag("exception", failure == null ? "Unknown" : failure.getClass().getSimpleName())
> 89	                    .register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 90	            event = log.atError();
> 91	            if (failure != null) {
> 92	                event.setCause(failure);
> 93	            }
> 94	        }
> 95	        event.addKeyValue("event", "rag_outcome").addKeyValue("stage", stage)
> 96	                .addKeyValue("documentId", safe(documentId)).addKeyValue("version", safe(version))
> 97	                .addKeyValue("status", normalizedStatus).addKeyValue("durationMs", durationMs)
> 98	                .addKeyValue("warningCode", safe(warningCode)).log("RAG stage outcome");
> 99	        remember(new RagStageEvent(Instant.now(), stage, safe(documentId), safe(version), normalizedStatus,
> 100	                durationMs, warningCode == null ? "" : warningCode));
> 101	    }
> 102	
> 103	    /** 记录某阶段处理的条目数量分布。 */

> 105	        DistributionSummary.builder("rag.stage.items")
> 106	                .description("Number of items entering or leaving a RAG stage")
> 107	                .tag("stage", stage).tag("kind", kind).register(meterRegistry).record(count);
> 108	    }
> 109	
> 110	    /** 递增业务事件计数器。 */
> 111	    public void event(String type) {
> 112	        Counter.builder("rag.events").tag("type", type).register(meterRegistry).increment();
> 113	    }
> 114	
> 115	    /** 返回最近的 RAG 阶段事件，最新在前。 */
> 116	    public synchronized List<RagStageEvent> recentEvents() {
> 117	        List<RagStageEvent> copy = new ArrayList<>(recentEvents);
> 118	        Collections.reverse(copy);
> 119	        return copy;
> 120	    }

> 123	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {

> 125	    }
> 126	
> 127	    /** 空值或空白字符串替换为 unknown，避免指标标签缺失。 */
> 128	    private String safe(String value) {

> 130	    }

> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {

> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }

> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 86	    private List<ChunkRecord> stage(String stage, String warningCode, String warningMessage,
> 87	                                    String documentId, String version, List<ChunkRecord> fallback,
> 88	                                    java.util.function.Supplier<List<ChunkRecord>> action,
> 89	                                    List<RagWarning> warnings, List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
> 90	        long started = System.nanoTime();
> 91	        try {
> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();
> 93	            List<ChunkRecord> result = value == null || value.isEmpty() ? fallback : List.copyOf(value);
> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);
> 97	            return result;
> 98	        } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 99	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }
> 107	
> 108	    private String stableId(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 109	        return chunk.parentId() == null || chunk.parentId().isBlank()
> 110	                ? chunk.filename() + ':' + chunk.parentOrder() : chunk.parentId();
> 111	    }
> 112	
> 113	    private long elapsedMillis(long started) {
> 114	        return Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - started).toMillis();
> 115	    }

> 43	    /** 调用 BGE API 对候选子块文本重排，按分数降序返回 topK。 */
> 44	    @Override
> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;
> 52	        try {
> 53	            requestBody = jsonMapper.writeValueAsBytes(new RerankRequest(
> 54	                    query, candidates.stream().map(this::requestPassage).toList(), true));
> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 57	            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to serialize BGE rerank request", exception);
> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {
> 64	            int index = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("index", 0)).intValue();
> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();
> 69	    }

> 73	        return enrichedPassageEnabled ? passage(chunk) : normalize(chunk.childText());
> 74	    }

> 76	    static String passage(ChunkRecord chunk) {
> 77	        String child = bounded(normalize(chunk.childText()), MAX_CHILD_CHARACTERS);
> 78	        String parent = parentContext(normalize(chunk.parentText()), child, MAX_PARENT_CONTEXT_CHARACTERS);
> 79	        return "file: " + normalize(chunk.filename())
> 80	                + "\nmatching child:\n" + child
> 81	                + "\nparent context:\n" + parent;
> 82	    }
> 83	
> 84	    private static String parentContext(String parent, String child, int limit) {
> 85	        if (parent.length() <= limit) return parent;
> 86	        int match = child.isBlank() ? -1 : parent.indexOf(child);
> 87	        int center = match < 0 ? 0 : match + child.length() / 2;
> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }
> 91	
> 92	    private static String bounded(String value, int limit) {
> 93	        return value.length() <= limit ? value : value.substring(0, limit);
> 94	    }
> 95	
> 96	    private static String normalize(String value) {
> 97	        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
> 98	    }

> 102	    }

> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.cache.BoundedTtlCache;
> 4	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;

> 9	import java.time.Duration;

> 15	
> 16	/**
> 17	 * 以受控批次生成向量。批次失败时自动二分降级，避免并发请求压垮本地嵌入服务。
> 18	 */
> 19	@Component
> 20	public class EmbeddingBatcher {
> 21	
> 22	    static final int DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE = 32;
> 23	
> 24	    private final EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;
> 25	    private final BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache;
> 26	    private final String modelFingerprint;
> 27	    /** 同一文本并发 miss 只允许一次模型调用，避免需求与代码分支重复击穿本地 Ollama。 */
> 28	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, CompletableFuture<float[]>> inFlight = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 29	
> 30	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel) {
> 31	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(Duration.ZERO, 0));
> 32	    }
> 33	
> 34	    @Autowired
> 35	    public EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, RagProperties properties) {
> 36	        this(embeddingModel, new BoundedTtlCache<>(
> 37	                Duration.ofSeconds(properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheTtlSeconds()),
> 38	                properties.retrieval().resolvedEmbeddingCacheMaxEntries()));
> 39	    }
> 40	
> 41	    EmbeddingBatcher(EmbeddingModel embeddingModel, BoundedTtlCache<String, float[]> cache) {
> 42	        this.embeddingModel = embeddingModel;
> 43	        this.cache = cache;
> 44	        this.modelFingerprint = embeddingModel.getClass().getName();
> 45	    }
> 46	
> 47	    /** 为全部文本生成与输入顺序一致的向量。 */
> 48	    public List<float[]> embedAll(List<String> texts) {
> 49	        if (texts == null || texts.isEmpty()) {
> 50	            return List.of();
> 51	        }
> 52	        List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 53	        for (int start = 0; start < texts.size(); start += DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE) {
> 54	            int end = Math.min(start + DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE, texts.size());
> 55	            vectors.addAll(embedCachedBatch(texts.subList(start, end), start));
> 56	        }
> 57	        return List.copyOf(vectors);
> 58	    }
> 59	
> 60	    private List<float[]> embedCachedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 61	        List<float[]> result = new ArrayList<>(java.util.Collections.nCopies(texts.size(), null));
> 62	        List<PendingEmbedding> pending = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        List<PendingEmbedding> owners = new ArrayList<>();
> 64	        for (int index = 0; index < texts.size(); index++) {
> 65	            String text = texts.get(index);
> 66	            String key = key(text);
> 67	            var cached = cache.get(key);
> 68	            if (cached.isPresent()) {
> 69	                result.set(index, cached.get().clone());
> 70	                continue;
> 71	            }
> 72	
> 73	            CompletableFuture<float[]> candidate = new CompletableFuture<>();
> 74	            CompletableFuture<float[]> future = inFlight.putIfAbsent(key, candidate);
> 75	            if (future == null) {
> 76	                future = candidate;
> 77	                owners.add(new PendingEmbedding(key, text, index, future));
> 78	            }
> 79	            pending.add(new PendingEmbedding(key, text, index, future));
> 80	        }
> 81	
> 82	        if (!owners.isEmpty()) {
> 83	            try {
> 84	                List<float[]> embedded = embedBatch(owners.stream().map(PendingEmbedding::text).toList(),
> 85	                        absoluteStart + owners.getFirst().resultIndex());
> 86	                for (int index = 0; index < owners.size(); index++) {
> 87	                    PendingEmbedding owner = owners.get(index);
> 88	                    float[] vector = embedded.get(index);
> 89	                    cache.put(owner.key(), vector.clone());
> 90	                    owner.future().complete(vector.clone());
> 91	                }
> 92	            } catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 93	                owners.forEach(owner -> owner.future().completeExceptionally(exception));
> 94	                throw exception;
> 95	            } finally {
> 96	                owners.forEach(owner -> inFlight.remove(owner.key(), owner.future()));
> 97	            }
> 98	        }
> 99	
> 100	        try {
> 101	            for (PendingEmbedding item : pending) {
> 102	                result.set(item.resultIndex(), item.future().join().clone());
> 103	            }
> 104	        } catch (CompletionException exception) {
> 105	            Throwable cause = exception.getCause();
> 106	            if (cause instanceof RuntimeException runtimeException) {
> 107	                throw runtimeException;
> 108	            }
> 109	            throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务并发请求失败", cause);
> 110	        }
> 111	        return List.copyOf(result);
> 112	    }
> 113	
> 114	    private record PendingEmbedding(String key, String text, int resultIndex, CompletableFuture<float[]> future) {
> 115	    }
> 116	
> 117	    private String key(String text) {
> 118	        return modelFingerprint + '\u0000' + (text == null ? "" : text);
> 119	    }
> 120	
> 121	    private List<float[]> embedBatch(List<String> texts, int absoluteStart) {
> 122	        try {
> 123	            List<float[]> vectors = embeddingModel.embed(texts);
> 124	            if (vectors == null || vectors.size() != texts.size()) {
> 125	                throw new IllegalStateException("嵌入服务返回的向量数量与文本数量不一致");
> 126	            }
> 127	            return vectors;
> 128	        }
> 129	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {
> 130	            if (texts.size() == 1) {
> 131	                String text = texts.getFirst();
> 132	                throw new EmbeddingUnavailableException(
> 133	                        "第 " + (absoluteStart + 1) + " 个文本无法生成向量（字符数 "
> 134	                                + (text == null ? 0 : text.length()) + "），请确认 Ollama 与嵌入模型可用",
> 135	                        exception);
> 136	            }
> 137	            int middle = texts.size() / 2;
> 138	            List<float[]> vectors = new ArrayList<>(texts.size());
> 139	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(0, middle), absoluteStart));
> 140	            vectors.addAll(embedBatch(texts.subList(middle, texts.size()), absoluteStart + middle));
> 141	            return vectors;
> 142	        }
> 143	    }
> 144	}

> ```java
> 1	package com.example.requirementrag.retrieval.pipeline;
> 2	
> 3	import com.example.requirementrag.config.RagProperties;
> 4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

> 9	
> 10	/** Lightweight per-stage circuit breaker that prevents repeated calls during dependency outages. */
> 11	@Component
> 12	public class RetrievalCircuitBreaker {
> 13	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, State> states = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 14	    private final int failureThreshold;
> 15	    private final long openMillis;
> 16	
> 17	    @Autowired
> 18	    public RetrievalCircuitBreaker(RagProperties properties) {
> 19	        this(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerFailureThreshold(),
> 20	                Duration.ofMillis(properties.retrieval().resolvedCircuitBreakerOpenMs()));
> 21	    }
> 22	
> 23	    RetrievalCircuitBreaker(int failureThreshold, Duration openDuration) {
> 24	        this.failureThreshold = Math.max(0, failureThreshold);
> 25	        this.openMillis = Math.max(0, openDuration == null ? 0 : openDuration.toMillis());
> 26	    }
> 27	
> 28	    public boolean allow(String stage) {
> 29	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return true;
> 30	        State state = states.get(stage);
> 31	        if (state == null) return true;
> 32	        if (state.openUntilMillis > 0 && state.openUntilMillis <= System.currentTimeMillis()) {
> 33	            states.remove(stage, state);
> 34	            return true;
> 35	        }
> 36	        return state.openUntilMillis == 0;
> 37	    }
> 38	
> 39	    public void success(String stage) {
> 40	        states.remove(stage);
> 41	    }
> 42	
> 43	    public void failure(String stage) {
> 44	        if (failureThreshold == 0 || openMillis == 0) return;
> 45	        states.compute(stage, (ignored, previous) -> {
> 46	            int failures = previous == null ? 1 : previous.failures + 1;
> 47	            long openUntil = failures >= failureThreshold ? System.currentTimeMillis() + openMillis : 0;
> 48	            return new State(failures, openUntil);
> 49	        });
> 50	    }
> 51	
> 52	    private record State(int failures, long openUntilMillis) {
> 53	    }
> 54	}

> 10	/** Small process-local cache with explicit TTL and capacity bounds. */
> 11	public final class BoundedTtlCache<K, V> {
> 12	    private final ConcurrentHashMap<K, Entry<V>> entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
> 13	    private final long ttlMillis;
> 14	    private final int maxEntries;
> 15	    private final Clock clock;
> 16	
> 17	    public BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries) {
> 18	        this(ttl, maxEntries, Clock.systemUTC());
> 19	    }

> 21	    BoundedTtlCache(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {

> 45	    public List<ChunkRecord> rerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int topK) {
> 46	        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return List.of();
> 47	        RestClient.RequestBodySpec request = client.post().uri(properties.path()).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
> 48	        if (properties.apiKey() != null && !properties.apiKey().isBlank()) {
> 49	            request.header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer " + properties.apiKey());
> 50	        }
> 51	        byte[] requestBody;

> 55	        }
> 56	        catch (RuntimeException exception) {

> 58	        }
> 59	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = request.contentLength(requestBody.length).body(requestBody)
> 60	                .retrieve().body(new ParameterizedTypeReference<>() {});
> 61	        if (response == null) return List.of();
> 62	        List<Scored> scored = new ArrayList<>();
> 63	        for (Map<String, Object> item : response) {

> 65	            double score = ((Number) item.getOrDefault("score", item.getOrDefault("relevance_score", 0))).doubleValue();
> 66	            if (index >= 0 && index < candidates.size()) scored.add(new Scored(candidates.get(index), score));
> 67	        }
> 68	        return scored.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingDouble(Scored::score).reversed()).limit(topK).map(Scored::chunk).toList();

> 88	        int start = Math.max(0, Math.min(center - limit / 2, parent.length() - limit));
> 89	        return parent.substring(start, start + limit);
> 90	    }

> 25	@Service
> 26	public class DefaultRequirementReranker implements RequirementReranker {
> 27	    private static final String BGE_STAGE = "bge.rerank";
> 28	    private static final String LLM_STAGE = "llm.rerank";
> 29	
> 30	    private final BgeReranker bgeReranker;

> 35	    public DefaultRequirementReranker(BgeReranker bgeReranker, ChatClient chatClient,
> 36	                                      RagProperties properties, RagObservability observability) {
> 37	        this.bgeReranker = bgeReranker;
> 38	        this.chatClient = chatClient;

> 43	    @Override
> 44	    public RagOutcome<List<ChunkRecord>> rerank(String query, String documentId, String version,
> 45	                                                List<ChunkRecord> candidates, int limit) {
> 46	        List<ChunkRecord> source = candidates == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(candidates);
> 47	        if (source.isEmpty()) {
> 48	            return RagOutcome.of(RagOutcomeStatus.NO_RESULTS, List.of(), BGE_STAGE, 0, 0);
> 49	        }
> 50	        List<RagWarning> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
> 51	        List<RagStageDiagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
> 52	        List<ChunkRecord> bge = stage(BGE_STAGE, "BGE_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "BGE 重排暂时不可用",
> 53	                documentId, version, source,
> 54	                () -> bgeReranker.rerank(query, source, Math.min(properties.retrieval().resolvedBgeTopK(), source.size())),
> 55	                warnings, diagnostics);
> 56	        List<ChunkRecord> result = bge;
> 57	        if (properties.retrieval().llmRerankEnabled()) {
> 58	            result = stage(LLM_STAGE, "LLM_RERANK_UNAVAILABLE", "LLM 重排暂时不可用",
> 59	                    documentId, version, bge, () -> llmRerank(query, bge),
> 60	                    warnings, diagnostics);
> 61	        }
> 62	        result = result.stream().limit(limit).toList();
> 63	        return new RagOutcome<>(warnings.isEmpty() ? RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS : RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 64	                result, warnings, diagnostics);
> 65	    }
> 66	
> 67	    private List<ChunkRecord> llmRerank(String query, List<ChunkRecord> candidates) {
> 68	        Map<String, ChunkRecord> byId = candidates.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(
> 69	                this::stableId, Function.identity(), (left, right) -> left, LinkedHashMap::new));
> 70	        String passages = byId.entrySet().stream()
> 71	                .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "\n" + entry.getValue().parentText())
> 72	                .collect(Collectors.joining("\n---\n"));
> 73	        RankedIds ranked = chatClient.prompt().system("""
> 74	                        你是需求证据检索重排器。按与检索目标的相关性排列候选段落。
> 75	                        只能返回提供的 ID，不得改写或创建 ID。删除无关、重复和纯目录内容。
> 76	                        """)
> 77	                .user("检索目标：" + query + "\n候选段落：\n" + passages)
> 78	                .options(OpenAiChatOptions.builder()
> 79	                        .model(properties.llm().rerankerModel()).temperature(0.0))
> 80	                .call().entity(RankedIds.class);
> 81	        if (ranked == null || ranked.ids() == null || ranked.ids().isEmpty()) return candidates;
> 82	        List<ChunkRecord> ordered = ranked.ids().stream().map(byId::get).filter(Objects::nonNull).distinct().toList();
> 83	        return ordered.isEmpty() ? candidates : ordered;
> 84	    }

> 92	            List<ChunkRecord> value = action.get();

> 94	            long duration = elapsedMillis(started);
> 95	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, result.size()));
> 96	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.SUCCESS, duration, null, null);

> 100	            warnings.add(new RagWarning(stage, warningCode, warningMessage, duration));
> 101	            diagnostics.add(new RagStageDiagnostic(stage, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED, duration, fallback.size()));
> 102	            observability.outcome(stage, documentId, version, RagOutcomeStatus.DEGRADED,
> 103	                    duration, warningCode, exception);
> 104	            return fallback;
> 105	        }
> 106	    }

> 12	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
> 13	import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.ConditionalOnProperty;
> 14	import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.EnableConfigurationProperties;
> 15	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;

> 20	import java.util.List;

> 23	/** Secures Streamable HTTP and makes the authenticated user available to tools. */
> 24	@Configuration
> 25	@EnableConfigurationProperties(McpProperties.class)
> 26	@ConditionalOnProperty(prefix = "app.mcp", name = "enabled", havingValue = "true", matchIfMissing = true)
> 27	public class McpTransportConfiguration {
> 28	
> 29	    public static final String USER_CONTEXT_KEY = "nexus.user";
> 30	    private static final String LOWERCASE_API_KEY_HEADER = "x-api-key";
> 31	
> 32	    @Bean
> 33	    WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider nexusMcpTransportProvider(
> 34	            @Qualifier("mcpServerJsonMapper") JsonMapper jsonMapper,
> 35	            McpServerStreamableHttpProperties serverProperties,
> 36	            ApiKeyAuthenticationService authenticationService) {
> 37	        return WebMvcStreamableServerTransportProvider.builder()
> 38	                .jsonMapper(new JacksonMcpJsonMapper(jsonMapper))
> 39	                .mcpEndpoint(serverProperties.getMcpEndpoint())
> 40	                .keepAliveInterval(serverProperties.getKeepAliveInterval())
> 41	                .disallowDelete(serverProperties.isDisallowDelete())
> 42	                .securityValidator(securityValidator(authenticationService))
> 43	                .contextExtractor(request -> transportContext(request, authenticationService))
> 44	                .build();
> 45	    }
> 46	
> 47	    private ServerTransportSecurityValidator securityValidator(ApiKeyAuthenticationService authenticationService) {
> 48	        return headers -> {
> 49	            try {
> 50	                authenticationService.authenticate(first(headers.get(LOWERCASE_API_KEY_HEADER)));
> 51	            }
> 52	            catch (UnauthenticatedException exception) {
> 53	                throw new ServerTransportSecurityException(401, "Missing or invalid API key");
> 54	            }
> 55	        };
> 56	    }
> 57	
> 58	    private McpTransportContext transportContext(ServerRequest request,
> 59	                                                 ApiKeyAuthenticationService authenticationService) {
> 60	        UserContext user = authenticationService.authenticate(
> 61	                first(request.headers().header(ApiKeyAuthenticationService.API_KEY_HEADER)));
> 62	        return McpTransportContext.create(Map.of(USER_CONTEXT_KEY, user));
> 63	    }
> 64	
> 65	    private String first(List<String> values) {
> 66	        return values == null || values.isEmpty() ? null : values.getFirst();
> 67	    }

### 本轮完成的主要改进

- Requirement 使用 child-first rerank，重排后再按 parent 聚合。
- BGE passage 加入文件名、parent 上下文和 child 内容，并实施长度与数量上限。
- 扩大代码候选池，增加确定性代码精排和精确符号、路径信号保护。
- 修复并发 embedding miss 重复计算问题。
- 单候选走安全快路径，避免没有排序价值的 CPU BGE 调用。
- 独立验证 Python/Transformers BGE 健康状态和 Java → BGE 实时调用契约。
- 增加分阶段诊断、黄金排名变化和失败归因。
- 修复缺少 retrieval 配置时的旧调用方兼容问题。

你这个质疑是对的。**报告中的 Document Recall@10=1.0 在当前评测规则下确实成立，但它不能说明文档检索质量真的出现了巨大提升。当前文档集和黄金标签过于简单，导致这个指标被明显高估。**

我刚重新核对了原始报告和黄金集。

## 为什么会变成 1.0

当前文档评测有以下特点：

1. 54 个唯一 case 中：
   - 48 个要求命中文档；
   - 6 个要求返回空结果；
   - 重复运行 3 次，所以报告显示 `144/144`。

2. **48 个文档黄金标签全部指向同一个文件：**

```text
shiguang-eval-requirements.md
```

3. 当前需求语料实际上只有：

```text
1 个需求文件
5 个 child chunk
1 个 parent
```

4. 每次文档召回基本都会返回这 5 个 child：

```text
原始候选数：5
parent 聚合后：1
最终排名：1
```

5. 黄金标签没有指定具体的 `parentOrder`，只检查：
   - 文件名是否正确；
   - 返回内容是否包含指定文字。

6. 更关键的是，当前 matcher 会同时匹配：

```java
candidate.parentText() + candidate.childText()
```

而这 5 个 child 的 `parentText` 都包含整个需求文件的父级正文。因此，只要返回这个唯一的需求文件，基本就能匹配任意一条需求黄金文字。

## 所以这个 1.0 应该怎样理解

准确说法应该是：

> 在“单需求文件、单 parent、5 个 child”的固定小语料中，48 个需要文档证据的 case 都成功返回了该需求文件，因此文件级 Document Recall@10 为 1.0。

但不能解释成：

> 系统面对真实多文档、多版本和相似需求时，文档召回准确率已经达到 100%。

换句话说：

- **数字没有算错；**
- **但评测难度不够；**
- 它更接近“有没有成功返回唯一需求文档”，而不是“有没有在许多相似文档和章节中找到正确证据”。

并且这也解释了为什么 candidate 有 144 次 singleton skip：聚合后永远只有一个文档候选，BGE 没有任何排序空间。

## 为什么相对历史 0.8 提升这么大

`0.354167 → 1.000000` 不能全部归因于检索算法。

它混合了：

- 评测语料重新构建；
- 文档过滤和版本过滤修复；
- parent/child 生命周期修复；
- 黄金匹配和报告诊断修复；
- 当前语料只有一个文档造成的低难度。

所以之前文档中“提升 0.645833”的表述虽然满足产品门槛计算，但**容易让人误解成真实语义召回能力提升了 64.58 个百分点**。更严谨的表述应该是：

> 当前固定单文档语料上的文件级 Recall 从 0.354167 恢复到 1.0，主要证明语料构建、过滤和 parent 聚合链路已经正常；尚不能证明复杂多文档场景中的语义召回质量达到 1.0。

## 下一步应该如何修正评测

需要建立一套更有区分度的文档黄金集：

### 1. 增加多文档和多 parent

建议至少包含：

- 30～50 个需求文档；
- 200 个以上 child chunk；
- 每个业务领域多个相似章节；
- 同名功能、相反动作和历史版本作为 hard negative。

### 2. 黄金标签定位到章节，而不只是文件

黄金标签至少增加：

```json
{
  "filename": "user-relation.md",
  "parentOrder": 3,
  "section": "取消关注",
  "mustContain": [
    "取消关注",
    "粉丝数",
    "关注数"
  ]
}
```

最好进一步固定 `parentId` 或稳定的 section ID。

### 3. 分开计算三个指标

以后文档召回应分别报告：

- **File Recall@10**：是否找到了正确文件；
- **Parent/Section Recall@10**：是否找到了正确章节；
- **Child Evidence Recall@10**：是否找到了真正包含答案的 child。

当前的 `1.0` 基本只是第一个指标。

### 4. 修正 matcher

不能让每个 child 都使用完整 `parentText` 匹配黄金标签。建议改为：

- child-level 指标只匹配 `childText`；
- parent-level 指标匹配聚合后的 parent；
- 限制 parent 上下文窗口；
- 黄金标签指定 parent/section；
- 分别记录聚合前和聚合后的命中。

### 5. 使用 hard negative

例如查询“取消关注”时，应加入：

- 关注用户；
- 点赞/取消点赞；
- 收藏/取消收藏；
- 屏蔽用户；
- 修改粉丝计数；
- 旧版本关注逻辑。

只有正确章节进入 Top-10 才算命中。

## 结论

**Document Recall@10=1.0 是当前评测程序算出来的真实结果，但它是一个偏宽松的单文档文件级指标，不能视为文档召回质量已经达到 100%。**

现阶段更可信的整体质量指标是：

- Code Recall@10：`0.809524`
- MRR@10：`0.823951`
- 剩余 8 个唯一代码失败 case

而文档召回需要通过“多文档、章节级、child 级、hard-negative”黄金集重新评测。重新设计后，Document Recall@10 大概率会低于 1.0，但那个数字才真正具有产品参考价值。

> 忘记我刚发的内容，你认为下一步该怎么继续完善

我认为下一步**不要继续调参数，也不要马上上 GraphRAG**。最优先的问题是：先把评测从“能通过”升级成“能真实反映质量”。

## 建议将下一版本定义为 0.8.2

主题：

> **评测可信度增强 + 多文档真实召回优化**

### 第一优先级：修正当前 1.0 的表达

先在评测台账中明确标注：

- 当前 `Document Recall@10=1.0` 是**单文件、单 parent 场景的文件级 Recall**；
- 它证明文档构建、过滤和聚合链路已经正常；
- 它不代表多文档场景下章节级或答案级召回达到 100%；
- 历史 `0.354167 → 1.0` 不能全部归功于检索算法。

这样可以避免后面路线图和汇报继续引用一个容易被误解的数字。

## 第二优先级：重建真正有难度的黄金集

### 语料建议

第一版不需要特别大，但必须有区分度：

| 项目 | 建议数量 |
|---|---:|
| 需求文档 | 30～50 个 |
| Parent/章节 | 100～200 个 |
| Child chunk | 300～800 个 |
| 唯一查询 | 100～150 条 |
| 空结果查询 | 15%～20% |
| Hard negative 查询 | 至少 30% |
| 多版本查询 | 至少 15% |
| 跨项目隔离查询 | 至少 10% |

重点不是单纯增加数量，而是加入容易混淆的内容，例如：

- 关注和取消关注；
- 点赞和取消点赞；
- 发布评论和删除评论；
- 用户搜索和笔记搜索；
- 当前版本和历史版本；
- 相同功能在不同项目中的实现；
- 同义表达、简称、类名和业务名称混合查询。

## 第三优先级：拆分文档召回指标

以后不应该只报告一个 Document Recall。

建议拆成：

### 1. File Recall@10

是否找到了正确文件。

它可以继续保留，但不能单独代表文档质量。

### 2. Section Recall@10

是否找到了正确章节或 parent。

黄金标签需要增加：

```json
{
  "filename": "user-relation.md",
  "sectionId": "unfollow-user",
  "parentOrder": 3
}
```

### 3. Child Evidence Recall@10

是否召回了真正包含答案的 child chunk。

这是最能反映检索质量的指标。

### 4. 排序指标

同时报告：

- MRR@10；
- NDCG@10；
- 平均黄金排名；
- Top-1、Top-3、Top-10 命中率。

### 5. 安全指标

继续保留：

- No-result accuracy；
- 跨项目污染率；
- 跨版本污染率；
- 依赖降级率；
- 无证据回答率。

## 第四优先级：修正 matcher

当前 matcher 使用：

```java
parentText + childText
```

而 `parentText` 可能包含整个需求文件，所以即使召回了错误 child，也可能被判为命中。

建议改成三个独立判定器：

```text
File matcher    → filename
Section matcher → filename + sectionId/parentOrder
Child matcher   → childText + evidenceId
```

具体规则：

- Child Recall 只能匹配 `childText`；
- Section Recall 只能匹配对应 parent 的有界正文；
- 禁止使用整个文件内容帮助任意 child 通过；
- 如果黄金标签指定了 `parentOrder` 或 `sectionId`，必须严格匹配；
- `mustContain` 只用于验证内容，不能替代结构化位置；
- 重复运行三次只参与延迟统计，质量指标按唯一 case 计算一次。

还应该增加一个专门的防回归测试：

> 返回正确文件但错误章节时，File Recall 命中，Section Recall 和 Child Recall 必须失败。

## 第五优先级：在新基线上再优化算法

建立可信基线后，再根据失败阶段逐项优化。

### 如果 Dense 阶段没有黄金结果

优化：

- embedding 输入构造；
- query rewrite；
- 业务同义词；
- 文档标题、章节标题和正文的权重；
- 中文长文本切块。

### 如果 Sparse 阶段没有黄金结果

优化：

- 中文分词；
- 类名、接口名、方法名和路径 token；
- 精确短语；
- 缩写和英文标识符；
- 字段级 boost。

### 如果候选存在，但 RRF 后丢失

优化：

- Dense/Sparse 权重；
- RRF 的 `k`；
- 候选池大小；
- 精确 lexical 命中的保护规则。

### 如果 BGE 把黄金结果降下去

优化：

- passage 模板；
- query 与 passage 的长度；
- parent 上下文窗口；
- BGE candidate Top-K；
- 对标题、章节、符号名增加结构化前缀。

不要笼统地继续增大 Top-K。每次调整都必须由失败归因证明是哪个阶段造成的。

## 第六优先级：继续解决代码召回

当前更真实的瓶颈是代码检索：

- 7 个唯一 case 是 `CODE_CANDIDATE_RECALL_MISS`；
- 1 个唯一 case 是 `CODE_RERANK_LOSS`。

建议按顺序处理：

1. 把这 8 个 case 固定成强制回归集；
2. 检查黄金代码是否进入 Dense Top-50；
3. 检查是否进入 Sparse Top-50；
4. 检查是否在 RRF 融合后丢失；
5. 检查确定性精排是否错误降级；
6. 针对类名、方法名、文件路径增加 query token；
7. 修复唯一的 rerank loss；
8. 不允许用增加特殊 case 硬编码解决。

## 0.8.2 的建议验收方式

因为新的困难黄金集还没有基线，不建议现在先拍脑袋定义绝对 Recall 值。应该分两步：

### 第一步：建立基线

在新黄金集上运行当前 0.8.1，记录：

- File Recall@10；
- Section Recall@10；
- Child Recall@10；
- Code Recall@10；
- MRR@10；
- NDCG@10；
- No-result accuracy；
- 污染率；
- P50/P95；
- 每个阶段的失败分布。

### 第二步：定义增量门槛

推荐初始门槛：

- Section Recall@10 至少提升 `0.05`；
- Child Recall@10 至少提升 `0.05`；
- Code Recall@10 至少提升 `0.03`；
- MRR@10 至少提升 `0.03`；
- File Recall 不回退；
- No-result accuracy 不回退；
- 跨项目、跨版本污染率为 `0`；
- BGE 意外 degradation 为 `0`；
- P95 增长不超过约定预算；
- 所有失败都有明确阶段归因。

如果新基线本身很低，再根据实际数据制定合理的绝对门槛。

## 推荐执行顺序

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["修正文档中的 1.0 解释"] --> B["建立多文档黄金集"]
    B --> C["拆分 File / Section / Child 指标"]
    C --> D["修正 matcher 和防泄漏测试"]
    D --> E["运行当前 0.8.1 真实基线"]
    E --> F["分析各阶段失败"]
    F --> G["优化召回、融合和重排"]
    G --> H["完成 0.8.1 → 0.8.2 正式对照"]
```

**最应该立即做的是前四项。**在可信评测完成之前，继续调 BGE、Top-K、RRF 权重或引入 GraphRAG，都可能只是在优化一个失真的指标。

> 220	    private static String rankMovement(Integer before, Integer after) {
> 221	        if (before == null && after == null) {
> 222	            return "MISSING";
> 223	        }
> 224	        if (before == null) {
> 225	            return "FOUND";
> 226	        }
> 227	        if (after == null) {

> 230	        if (after < before) {

> 239	    private static boolean documentOrderChanged(List<ChunkRecord> raw, List<ChunkRecord> result) {
> 240	        List<String> rawParents = distinctDocumentKeys(raw, result.size());
> 241	        List<String> finalParents = distinctDocumentKeys(result, result.size());
> 242	        return !rawParents.isEmpty() && !finalParents.isEmpty() && !rawParents.equals(finalParents);
> 243	    }

> 245	    private static List<String> distinctDocumentKeys(List<ChunkRecord> values, int limit) {
> 246	        LinkedHashSet<String> keys = new LinkedHashSet<>();
> 247	        for (ChunkRecord value : values) {
> 248	            keys.add(documentKey(value));
> 249	            if (keys.size() >= limit) {
> 250	                break;
> 251	            }
> 252	        }
> 253	        return List.copyOf(keys);
> 254	    }

> 256	    private static String documentKey(ChunkRecord value) {
> 257	        if (value.parentId() != null && !value.parentId().isBlank()) {
> 258	            return value.parentId();
> 259	        }
> 260	        return normalize(value.filename()) + ':' + value.parentOrder();
> 261	    }
> 262	
> 263	    private static boolean codeOrderChanged(List<CodeChunk> raw, List<CodeChunk> result) {
> 264	        int size = Math.min(result.size(), raw.size());
> 265	        if (size == 0) {
> 266	            return false;
> 267	        }
> 268	        List<String> rawKeys = raw.stream().limit(size).map(RetrievalEvaluationMatcher::codeKey).toList();
> 269	        List<String> finalKeys = result.stream().limit(size).map(RetrievalEvaluationMatcher::codeKey).toList();
> 270	        return !rawKeys.equals(finalKeys);
> 271	    }

> 39	    public List<KnowledgeEntry> load(Path zipPath, BiConsumer<Integer, String> progress) throws IOException {
> 40	        if (!Files.isRegularFile(zipPath)) {

> 50	            String text = parseHtml(candidate.bytes(), candidate.entryName());
> 51	            if (text.isBlank()) {

> 372	def source_state(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
> 373	    commit = command("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=root)
> 374	    status = command("git", "status", "--porcelain", cwd=root)
> 375	    relevant = evaluation_source_paths(root)
> 376	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
> 377	    file_hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
> 378	    for path in relevant:
> 379	        data = path.read_bytes()
> 380	        relative = str(path.relative_to(root))
> 381	        file_hashes[relative] = sha256_bytes(data)
> 382	        digest.update(relative.encode("utf-8"))
> 383	        digest.update(b"\0")
> 384	        digest.update(data)
> 385	    return {
> 386	        "gitCommit": commit,
> 387	        "workingTreeDirty": bool(status),
> 388	        "evaluationSourceSha256": digest.hexdigest(),
> 389	        "files": file_hashes,
> 390	    }

> 70	    public IngestResponse ingestEntries(String collection, String documentId, String version, List<KnowledgeEntry> entries) {
> 71	        if (entries.isEmpty()) {
> 72	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("没有可导入的知识条目");
> 73	        }
> 74	
> 75	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();

> 77	        Set<String> seenChildren = new HashSet<>();

> 80	            if (cleaned.isBlank()) {
> 81	                continue;
> 82	            }
> 83	            List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents = observability.observe("parent_child.chunk", documentId, version,

> 87	                    () -> deduplicate(documentId, version, entry.source(), parents, seenParents, seenChildren));
> 88	            int rawChildren = parents.stream().mapToInt(parent -> parent.children().size()).sum();
> 89	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "input", rawChildren);
> 90	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "output", entryChunks.size());
> 91	            observability.items("content.deduplicate", "removed", rawChildren - entryChunks.size());
> 92	            chunks.addAll(entryChunks);

> 100	            observability.observe("qdrant.upsert", documentId, version,
> 101	                    () -> store.replaceVersion(collection, documentId, version, chunks));
> 102	        } else {

> 104	                    () -> store.replaceVersion(documentId, version, chunks));

> 111	    private String readMultipart(MultipartFile file, String id, String version, String filename) throws IOException {
> 112	        byte[] fileBytes = file.getBytes();
> 113	        return observability.observe("document.parse", id, version, () -> {
> 114	            var resource = new NamedByteArrayResource(fileBytes, filename);
> 115	            return new TikaDocumentReader(resource).read().stream().map(Document::getText)
> 116	                    .reduce("", (left, right) -> left + "\n" + right);
> 117	        });
> 118	    }

> 120	    /** 按内容哈希去重父块与子块，生成 ChunkRecord 列表。 */
> 121	    private List<ChunkRecord> deduplicate(String id, String version, String filename,
> 122	                                          List<ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk> parents,
> 123	                                          Set<String> seenParents, Set<String> seenChildren) {
> 124	        List<ChunkRecord> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 125	        for (ParentChildChunker.ParentChunk parent : parents) {
> 126	            String parentHash = Hashing.sha256(parent.text());
> 127	            if (!seenParents.add(parentHash)) continue;
> 128	            String parentId = Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":parent:" + parentHash);
> 129	            for (int childIndex = 0; childIndex < parent.children().size(); childIndex++) {
> 130	                String child = parent.children().get(childIndex);
> 131	                String childHash = Hashing.sha256(child);
> 132	                if (!seenChildren.add(childHash)) continue;
> 133	                chunks.add(new ChunkRecord(Hashing.uuid(id + ":" + version + ":child:" + childHash), id, version,
> 134	                        filename, parentId, parent.text(), child, childHash, parent.order(), childIndex));
> 135	            }
> 136	        }
> 137	        return chunks;
> 138	    }

> 35	    public RequirementDiff compare(String projectId, VersionManifest from, VersionManifest to) {
> 36	        if (!hasReference(from) || !hasReference(to)) return RequirementDiff.unavailable();
> 37	        List<ChunkRecord> before;
> 38	        List<ChunkRecord> after;
> 39	        Optional<Snapshot> beforeSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 40	                from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 41	        Optional<Snapshot> afterSnapshot = snapshots.materialize(projectId,
> 42	                to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 43	        List<RequirementChunkDiff.ParentChange> parentChanges;
> 44	        if (beforeSnapshot.isPresent() && afterSnapshot.isPresent()) {
> 45	            before = chunks(beforeSnapshot.get());
> 46	            after = chunks(afterSnapshot.get());
> 47	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after);
> 48	        } else {
> 49	            String collection = projectRegistry.resolveRequirementCollection(projectId);
> 50	            before = store.scrollVersion(collection, from.requirementDocumentId(), from.requirementVersion());
> 51	            after = store.scrollVersion(collection, to.requirementDocumentId(), to.requirementVersion());
> 52	            parentChanges = RequirementChunkDiff.compare(before, after).stream()
> 53	                    .filter(change -> change.type() != RequirementChunkDiff.Type.REMOVED)
> 54	                    .toList();
> 55	        }
> 56	        List<RequirementChange> changes = parentChanges.stream()
> 57	                .map(item -> change(ChangeType.valueOf(item.type().name()), item.before(), item.after()))
> 58	                .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new));
> 59	        changes.sort(Comparator.comparing(RequirementChange::filename,
> 60	                        Comparator.nullsFirst(String::compareTo))
> 61	                .thenComparingInt(RequirementChange::parentOrder)
> 62	                .thenComparing(change -> change.type().name()));
> 63	        return new RequirementDiff(VersionModels.Availability.AVAILABLE,
> 64	                count(changes, ChangeType.ADDED), count(changes, ChangeType.MODIFIED),
> 65	                count(changes, ChangeType.REMOVED), changes);
> 66	    }

> 14	    static final int PARENT_SIZE = 2_000;

> 19	     * 将文本拆分为父块及其子块列表。

> 21	    public List<ParentChunk> split(String text) {
> 22	        List<String> parents = splitByBoundary(text, PARENT_SIZE, 0);
> 23	        List<ParentChunk> result = new ArrayList<>();
> 24	        for (int parentIndex = 0; parentIndex < parents.size(); parentIndex++) {
> 25	            String parent = parents.get(parentIndex);
> 26	            result.add(new ParentChunk(parentIndex, parent, splitByBoundary(parent, CHILD_SIZE, CHILD_OVERLAP)));

> 31	    /**
> 32	     * 按字符边界（换行、句号、分号）切分，支持块间重叠以保留上下文。
> 33	     */
> 34	    private List<String> splitByBoundary(String text, int size, int overlap) {
> 35	        List<String> chunks = new ArrayList<>();
> 36	        int start = 0;
> 37	        while (start < text.length()) {
> 38	            int end = Math.min(start + size, text.length());
> 39	            if (end < text.length()) {
> 40	                int boundary = Math.max(text.lastIndexOf('\n', end), Math.max(text.lastIndexOf('。', end), text.lastIndexOf('；', end)));
> 41	                if (boundary > start + size / 2) {
> 42	                    end = boundary + 1;
> 43	                }
> 44	            }
> 45	            String chunk = text.substring(start, end).strip();
> 46	            if (!chunk.isBlank()) {
> 47	                chunks.add(chunk);
> 48	            }
> 49	            if (end >= text.length()) {
> 50	                break;
> 51	            }
> 52	            start = Math.max(start + 1, end - overlap);
> 53	        }
> 54	        return chunks;
> 55	    }
> 56

> 59	    }
> 60	}

> 20	    /**
> 21	     * 清洗原始文本：去噪、去重、截断至最大长度。

> 23	    public String clean(String raw) {
> 24	        if (raw == null || raw.isBlank()) {
> 25	            return "";
> 26	        }
> 27	
> 28	        List<String> kept = new ArrayList<>();
> 29	        String previous = null;
> 30	        int totalLength = 0;
> 31	        for (String line : raw.replace('\u00a0', ' ').split("\\R")) {

> 37	                continue;
> 38	            }
> 39	            if (totalLength + value.length() > MAX_TOTAL_LENGTH) {
> 40	                break;
> 41	            }
> 42	            kept.add(value);
> 43	            previous = value;
> 44	            totalLength += value.length() + 1;
> 45	        }
> 46	        return String.join("\n", new LinkedHashSet<>(kept));
> 47	    }

> 52	    private String normalizeLine(String line) {
> 53	        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(Math.min(line.length(), MAX_LINE_LENGTH));
> 54	        boolean previousSpace = false;
> 55	        for (int index = 0; index < line.length() && builder.length() < MAX_LINE_LENGTH; index++) {
> 56	            char ch = line.charAt(index);
> 57	            if (ch == ' ' || ch == '\t') {
> 58	                if (!previousSpace && !builder.isEmpty()) {
> 59	                    builder.append(' ');
> 60	                    previousSpace = true;
> 61	                }
> 62	                continue;
> 63	            }
> 64	            builder.append(ch);
> 65	            previousSpace = false;
> 66	        }
> 67	        return builder.toString().strip();
> 68	    }
